lemmas.def_zh: 蕨类植物
lemmas.def_en: any of numerous flowerless and seedless vascular plants having true roots from a rhizome and fronds that uncurl upward; reproduce by spores

examples.en: Lush green ferns grew abundantly in the damp, shaded areas beneath the forest canopy.
examples.zh: 郁郁葱葱的绿色蕨类植物在林冠下潮湿阴凉的区域茂密生长。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指无花而具羽状叶的蕨类植物，常在园艺、植物学或自然描写中使用。

lemmas.def_zh: 蕨类的
lemmas.def_en: abounding in or covered with ferns

examples.en: the ferny undergrowth

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fern 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 电车, 手推车, 台车
lemmas.def_en: a wheeled vehicle that runs on rails and is propelled by electricity

examples.en: She loaded fresh produce and milk into her trolley as she walked down the supermarket aisle.
examples.zh: 她在超市走道穿行时，把新鲜农产品和牛奶放进了手推车里。

lemmas.usage_note: 英式英语中多指超市手推车或医院小推车，美式英语亦可指有轨电车，搭配 push a trolley。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 trolley 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 铺位, 废话, 逃走
lemmas.def_en: a long trough for feeding cattle

examples.en: The sailor climbed tiredly into his narrow bunk after finishing his night watch.
examples.zh: 结束夜间值班后，水手疲惫地爬上了他那狭窄的铺位。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词指简易铺位或双层床（bunk bed）；不可数俚语指废话（talk bunk）。

lemmas.def_zh: 逃跑，溜走；逃学，旷工；搭铺，睡简易床
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To run away or escape hastily. 2. [I] ('bunk off') (British informal) To stay away from school or work without permission. 3. [I] ('bunk down') To sleep in a simple bed or bunk.

examples.en: During the summer camp, four children had to bunk together in a cozy wooden cabin.
examples.zh: 在夏令营期间，四个孩子不得不合住在一间舒适的木屋里。

lemmas.usage_note: 动词，口语中常与 with 或 down 搭配表示借宿合住，或在英式俚语中表示逃跑、旷课旷工。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bunk 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 讣告
lemmas.def_en: a notice of someone's death; usually includes a short biography

examples.en: The local newspaper published a touching obituary honoring the retired teacher's lifelong dedication.
examples.zh: 当地报纸刊登了一篇感人至深的讣告，向这位奉献了一生的退休教师致敬。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作可数名词，指报纸或网络上刊登的讣告，高频搭配 write/publish an obituary，口语中常略作 obit。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 obituary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 郡
lemmas.def_en: a former administrative district of England; equivalent to a county

examples.en: Historic castles and rolling green hills are scattered throughout the quiet northern shire.
examples.zh: 历史悠久的城堡与起伏的青翠山丘散落在这座宁静的北部郡县各处。

lemmas.usage_note: 专有名词或特指名词，主要用于英国行政区划（郡），常见于地名后缀（如 Yorkshire）或与 county 互换。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shire 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 旋涡, 旋风, 涡流
lemmas.def_en: the shape of something rotating rapidly

examples.en: He felt helpless as he was gradually drawn into a vortex of legal and financial troubles.
examples.zh: 当逐渐被卷入法律与财务麻烦的旋涡时，他感到孤立无援。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指物理旋涡或气流，也常引申为让人无法脱身的情感或混乱旋涡，常用搭配 suck into a vortex。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vortex 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 尖牙, 犬牙
lemmas.def_en: a Bantu language spoken in Cameroon

examples.en: The viper sank its sharp fangs into the rodent's neck, injecting a lethal dose of venom.
examples.zh: 毒蛇将锋利的毒牙刺入啮齿动物的颈部，注入了致命剂量的毒液。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常作复数使用，专指肉食动物（狼、蛇等）的尖牙或毒牙，常见搭配 bare one's fangs（龇牙示威）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fang 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 求和
lemmas.def_en: the 18th letter of the Greek alphabet

examples.en: The teacher used the Greek letter sigma to indicate the summation of all values in the data set.
examples.zh: 老师用希腊字母西格玛来表示数据集中所有数值的总和。

lemmas.usage_note: 学术与技术名词，指希腊字母第18字；在统计学中大写表示求和（∑），小写表示标准差（σ），常用于六西格玛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sigma 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: coming next after the eleventh and just before the thirteenth in position

examples.en: The conference will be held on the twelfth floor of the international trade center.
examples.zh: 会议将在国际贸易中心的第十二层举行。

lemmas.usage_note: 序数词作定语形容词，表示“第十二的”，前通常加定冠词 the，高频修饰 century, edition, floor 等。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 twelfth 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 流行性感冒
lemmas.def_en: an acute febrile highly contagious viral disease

examples.en: Health officials urged the public to get vaccinated against the new strain of influenza.
examples.zh: 卫生官员呼吁公众接种疫苗以抵御这种新的流行性感冒病毒株。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学与正式语体名词，常不可数，日常多简称为 flu，高频搭配 contract/catch influenza 或 influenza virus。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 influenza 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 出声地, 大声地
lemmas.def_en: using the voice; not silently

examples.en: She decided to read the poem aloud so that everyone in the room could hear it.
examples.zh: 她决定把这首诗大声朗读出来，以便房间里的每个人都能听到。

lemmas.usage_note: 副词，意为出声地（区别于在心里默读或私下），高频搭配 read aloud（朗读）、think aloud（自言自语）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 aloud 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 缺点, 退税
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being a hindrance

examples.en: The only major drawback of the new smartphone is its relatively short battery life.
examples.zh: 这款新智能手机唯一的主要缺点就是其相对较短的电池续航。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指某计划、事物的不利条件或缺点，常与介词 to 或 of 连用，高频搭配 major/main drawback。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 drawback 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 斑纹, 条纹
lemmas.def_en: an adornment consisting of a strip of a contrasting color or material

examples.en: A distinctive white stripe runs along the side of the newly designed sports car.
examples.zh: 一条显眼的白色条纹贯穿这款新设计的跑车侧身。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指条纹、斑纹或军衔肩章上的条纹，常与形容词连用如 vertical/horizontal stripes。

lemmas.def_zh: 有条纹的, 有斑纹的
lemmas.def_en: marked or decorated with stripes

examples.en: She wore a bold stripy sweater that made her stand out instantly.
examples.zh: 她穿着一件醒目的条纹毛衣，瞬间在人群中脱颖而出。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stripe 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 化妆美容；大转变
lemmas.def_en: an overall beauty treatment (involving a person's hair style and cosmetics and clothing) intended to change or improve a person's appearance

examples.en: The historic downtown hotel underwent an extensive multimillion-dollar makeover last year.
examples.zh: 这家历史悠久的市中心酒店去年进行了一次耗资数百万美元的全面翻新改造。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指外观容貌、家居风格或整体形象的翻新改造，多与 give 或 receive 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 makeover 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 诽谤，中伤，败坏……名誉
lemmas.def_en: [T] to damage the good reputation of someone by making false or malicious statements

examples.en: The actor filed a lawsuit against the tabloid for attempting to defame his character.
examples.zh: 该演员对这家小报提起诉讼，指控其企图诋毁自己的人格声誉。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式法律与新闻用语，指恶意造谣损害名誉，常与 character 或 reputation 搭配。

lemmas.def_zh: 破坏名誉, 中伤, 诽谤
lemmas.def_en: a false accusation of an offense or a malicious misrepresentation of someone's words or actions

lemmas.def_zh: [法] 诋毁名誉者
lemmas.def_en: one who attacks the reputation of another by slander or libel

lemmas.def_zh: 破坏名誉的, 诽谤的
lemmas.def_en: (used of statements) harmful and often untrue; tending to discredit or malign

examples.en: The actress sued the tabloid over several defamatory statements regarding her career.
examples.zh: 这位女演员就几篇毁坏其职业名誉的诽谤性言论起诉了该小报。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 defame 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 胁迫，强迫，迫使
lemmas.def_en: [T] to force someone to do something by using threats or other unpleasant methods

examples.en: The suspects claimed that police officers coerced them into signing the false confession.
examples.zh: 嫌疑人声称警方强迫他们签署了虚假的供词。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面语，指以威胁或武力强迫他人就范，经典句型为 coerce sb into doing sth。

lemmas.def_zh: 强制的, 强压的, 强迫的
lemmas.def_en: serving or intended to coerce

examples.en: authority is directional instead of coercive

lemmas.def_zh: 强迫, 威压, 高压统治
lemmas.def_en: the act of compelling by force of authority

examples.en: She insisted that she had signed the non-disclosure agreement under extreme coercion.
examples.zh: 她坚称自己是在极端胁迫下才签署保密协议的。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，多用于法律与政论语境，常与介词 under 搭配表示受胁迫状态。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 coerce 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 幽灵, 妖怪, 凶兆
lemmas.def_en: a mental representation of some haunting experience

examples.en: The prolonged drought once again raised the haunting specter of widespread famine.
examples.zh: 旷日持久的干旱再次引发了对大范围饥荒的恐惧阴影。

lemmas.usage_note: 比喻义更为常用，指令人恐惧的阴影或危险凶兆，多作 the specter of sth 搭配。

lemmas.def_zh: 幽灵, 妖怪, 凶兆
lemmas.def_en: a ghostly appearing figure

examples.en: we were unprepared for the apparition that confronted us

family_guide.root_logic: 以 specter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不时打断，间歇打扰；给……加标点
lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. (often passive) To interrupt something repeatedly at intervals. 2. To add punctuation marks to a piece of writing.

examples.en: His impassioned political speech was repeatedly punctuated by thunderous applause.
examples.zh: 他慷慨激昂的政治演说不断被雷鸣般的掌声所打断。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物或不及物动词，除加标点外，多用于比喻某事件被掌声、欢呼等反复打断或衬托。

lemmas.def_zh: 标点, 标点符号
lemmas.def_en: something that makes repeated and regular interruptions or divisions

family_guide.root_logic: 以 punctuate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 章鱼
lemmas.def_en: tentacles of octopus prepared as food

examples.en: The multinational corporation has become a financial octopus controlling local media.
examples.zh: 这家跨国集团已经演变成一只控制着当地媒体的金融巨鳄。

lemmas.usage_note: 具象指海洋软体动物章鱼；政经语境常比喻触角伸向各处、控制力庞大的庞然组织。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 octopus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 大黄蜂
lemmas.def_en: large stinging paper wasp

examples.en: His controversial remark about tax reform unintentionally stirred up a hornet's nest.
examples.zh: 他对税收改革的争议性言论无意中捅了马蜂窝。

lemmas.usage_note: 指大黄蜂，最常用于比喻习语 stir up a hornet's nest，表示捅马蜂窝或惹众怒。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hornet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 字节, 位组
lemmas.def_en: a sequence of 8 bits (enough to represent one character of alphanumeric data) processed as a single unit of information

examples.en: Each character in this simple encoding standard is represented by a single byte.
examples.zh: 在该简易编码标准中，每个字符都由一个单字节表示。

lemmas.usage_note: 计算机度量衡术语，由8个二进制位组成，前常加 kilo-、mega-、giga- 等词缀构成单位。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 byte 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可疑的, 不确定的
lemmas.def_en: fraught with uncertainty or doubt

examples.en: The investment firm has gained a dubious reputation for peddling high-risk products.
examples.zh: 这家投资公司因兜售高风险产品而落得了个不可靠的名声。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，既可表主观上的“怀疑的”（后接 about），亦可表客观上的“靠不住的、可疑的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 怀疑地；可疑地
lemmas.def_en: in a questionable and dubious manner

examples.en: these were estates his father questionably acquired

lemmas.def_zh: dubious（令人怀疑的）的变形
lemmas.def_en: the state of being unsure of something

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dubious 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 阻挠，挫败（企图或计划）
lemmas.def_en: [T] To prevent someone from accomplishing a plan, ambition, or effort; to frustrate.

examples.en: Vigilant airport security officers successfully thwarted the brazen hijacking attempt.
examples.zh: 警惕的机场安保人员成功挫败了那起嚣张的劫机企图。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指彻底阻碍阻止计划、阴谋或企图得逞，宾语多为 attempt、plan 或 effort。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 thwart 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 重新加入，回到（某人处）；反驳，答辩
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To return to or become a member of a group, organization, or companion again after leaving. 2. [I, T] (formal) To reply quickly and sharply to a remark.

examples.en: After taking a brief phone call, she rejoined her colleagues in the conference room.
examples.zh: 接了个简短的电话后，她回到了会议室与同事们汇合。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作及物或不及物动词，既可表“重新加入团体/队伍”，也可用于书面语中表示“机智或敏锐地反驳、回答”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rejoin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 剧作家
lemmas.def_en: someone who writes plays

examples.en: The aspiring playwright spent months revising the final act of his historical drama.
examples.zh: 这位有抱负的剧作家花了数月时间修改他历史剧的最后一幕。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指专门创作舞台剧的剧作家；注意拼写以 -wright 结尾，常与 acclaimed, aspiring 搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 playwright 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 剧烈翻腾，搅动；搅拌（奶制黄油）；大量炮制（churn out）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To move violently and turbulently, or agitate a liquid vigorously. 2. [T] To shake cream in a churn to produce butter. 3. [T] ('churn out') To produce large quantities of something rapidly.

examples.en: The propeller churned the calm water into a thick froth of white foam.
examples.zh: 螺旋桨剧烈搅动着平静的水面，泛起一层厚厚的白色泡沫。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作动词，表剧烈搅动液体，或喻指胃部翻江倒海；固定搭配 churn out 意为“大量粗制滥造”。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 翻腾的；剧烈搅动的；翻江倒海的
lemmas.def_en: moving vigorously, violently, or agitating irregularly
lemmas.usage_note: 常用于修饰水流（churning waters）或因紧张不安而胃部难受（a churning stomach）。

examples.en: The small boat was tossed around by the churning sea.
examples.zh: 小船在翻腾汹涌的大海中被颠簸得东倒西歪。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 churn 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 起漩涡，打旋，旋流
lemmas.def_en: [I] (of water, wind, or smoke) To move in a circular motion, forming a whirlpool or whirlwind.

examples.en: Dry autumn leaves eddied around the courtyard in the sudden gust of wind.
examples.zh: 干枯的秋叶在突如其来的阵风中，在庭院里打着旋儿飞舞。

lemmas.usage_note: 动词多作不及物用，描写水、风、烟或树叶等作漩涡状回旋，常与 around, away 等介副词连用，具文学色彩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 eddy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 乞丐
lemmas.def_en: a pauper who lives by begging

examples.en: An elderly beggar sat quietly on the subway steps, holding out a worn cup.
examples.zh: 一位年迈的乞丐静静地坐在地铁台阶上，伸出一个破旧的杯子。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指以乞讨为生的人；日常口语中也可幽默或戏谑地称呼某人（如 lucky beggar）。

lemmas.def_zh: 使破产，使沦为赤贫；使无法（相信或描述，如 beggar belief/description）
lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. To make someone extremely poor. 2. (beggar belief/description) To be too extreme, unusual, or shocking to be believed or described.

examples.en: The sheer scale of corruption uncovered by the investigation beggars belief.
examples.zh: 调查所揭露的腐败规模之大，简直令人难以置信。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常用于书面语；最经典的固定搭配是 beggar belief / beggar description，意为“令人难以置信/难以言表”。

lemmas.def_zh: 象乞丐的, 赤贫的
lemmas.def_en: marked by poverty befitting a beggar

examples.en: a beggarly existence in the slums
a mean hut

family_guide.root_logic: 以 beggar 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 伪装, 伪装物, 幌子
lemmas.def_en: an outward semblance that misrepresents the true nature of something

examples.en: The sniper wore military camouflage to blend seamlessly into the dense forest.
examples.zh: 狙击手身穿军用迷彩服，完美地融入了茂密的森林中。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数或可数名词，指军事上的伪装、动物保护色或掩盖真相的幌子；常见搭配 wear camouflage。

lemmas.def_zh: 伪装，掩饰；隐藏
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To hide an animal, soldier, or vehicle by coloring or covering it to blend in with its surroundings. 2. [T] To disguise a fact, feeling, or intention to prevent it from being noticed.

examples.en: She deliberately used a cheerful tone to camouflage her growing anxiety.
examples.zh: 她故意用欢快的语调来掩饰自己内心日益加剧的焦虑。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指利用迷彩伪装隐蔽，或在抽象语境中掩饰真实意图、情绪，常接 oneself 或宾语 + with/as。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 camouflage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 进口, 插入物
lemmas.def_en: an arm off of a larger body of water (often between rocky headlands)

examples.en: Small fishing boats sought shelter from the storm in a secluded rocky inlet.
examples.zh: 几艘小型渔船在一处僻静的岩石水湾中躲避风暴。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指狭长深入陆地的水湾，或机械工程中的液体/气体进气口、入口；常与 valve 连用构成复合词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inlet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 在社交场合走动应酬，交际；（使）混合，融合
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. [I] (+ with) to move around and chat with people socially at an event. 2. [I, T] (+ with) to mix or combine together.

examples.en: The host encouraged the guests to mingle with each other over drinks.
examples.zh: 主人鼓励客人们一边饮酒，一边相互交流走动。

lemmas.usage_note: 可作及物或不及物动词；既可指气味、声音混合，也常用于社交场合指在人群中穿梭交际（mingle with sb）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mingle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 生动的, 如画的, 独特的, 别致的, 栩栩如生的
lemmas.def_en: suggesting or suitable for a picture; pretty as a picture

examples.en: We spent our holiday in a picturesque coastal village surrounded by cliffs.
examples.zh: 我们在一个被悬崖环绕、风景如画的沿海小村庄度过了假期。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，常修饰村庄、小镇、风景等，意为“如画般美丽的”；亦可指语言生动独特。常作定语或表语。

lemmas.def_zh: 如画地, 别致地；生动地
lemmas.def_en: in a picturesque manner

examples.en: in the building trade such a trader is picturesquely described as a `brass plate' merchant

lemmas.def_zh: 逼真
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being strikingly expressive or vivid

family_guide.root_logic: 以 picturesque 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 谜, 费解的事物
lemmas.def_en: something that baffles understanding and cannot be explained

examples.en: Despite his international fame, the author's private life remains a complete enigma.
examples.zh: 尽管享誉世界，这位作家的私生活依然是一个彻底的谜。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指难以理解、神秘莫测的人或事物；常作表语，搭配 remain an enigma 或 a complete enigma。

lemmas.def_zh: 费解的, 谜一般的, 高深莫测的
lemmas.def_en: not clear to the understanding

examples.en: I didn't grasp the meaning of that enigmatic comment until much later
prophetic texts so enigmatic that their meaning has been disputed for centuries

lemmas.def_zh: 莫名其妙地, 难以理解地
lemmas.def_en: in a cryptic manner;  he said cryptically

examples.en: we will meet again,

family_guide.root_logic: 以 enigma 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 鼻的, 鼻声的, 尖锐的
lemmas.def_en: of or in or relating to the nose

examples.en: She spoke in a high, nasal voice that immediately irritated everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 她用一种尖锐刺耳的鼻音说话，立刻惹恼了屋里的所有人。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰声音、发音或解剖器官，常用于 nasal voice、nasal cavity 或 nasal spray 等搭配。

lemmas.def_zh: 鼻声地, 尖锐地
lemmas.def_en: in a nasal manner

examples.en: inhaled nasally

lemmas.def_zh: 鼻音性, 鼻声
lemmas.def_en: a quality of the voice that is produced by nasal resonators

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nasal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 禽鸟舌喉炎, 痂, 小毛病, 沮丧, 单根茎, 单瓣花, 果仁, 牌点, 忧郁, 报时信号
lemmas.def_en: a disease of poultry

examples.en: Be careful when chewing the watermelon slice, as you might swallow a hard pip.
examples.zh: 嚼西瓜片时要小心，免得把硬籽给吞下去了。

lemmas.usage_note: 多指苹果、橙子等水果的硬籽，口语中也可指徽章星标或不快情绪，常与 apple、orange 连用。

lemmas.def_zh: （在最后一刻以微弱优势）险胜，击败；破壳而出；唧唧叫
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (chiefly British informal) To defeat someone by a very narrow margin, especially at the last moment. 2. [I] To peck through an eggshell; to chirp.

examples.en: The young runner managed to pip her rival at the post to win the national championship.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的跑步选手在最后关头险胜对手，夺得了全国冠军。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于口语，尤指以微弱优势险胜对手，高频搭配为 pip somebody at the post 或 pip somebody to something。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pip 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 公鸡, 栖息的鸟
lemmas.def_en: adult male chicken

examples.en: Every morning at dawn, the neighbor's rooster crows loudly, waking up the entire village.
examples.zh: 每天拂晓时分，邻居家的公鸡都会高声啼鸣，把整个村子的人都吵醒。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，指成年公鸡，美式英语中常用；常与 crow（啼鸣）连用，也可喻指自负好斗的人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rooster 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 短吻鳄
lemmas.def_en: either of two amphibious reptiles related to crocodiles but with shorter broader snouts

examples.en: The tour guide pointed out a massive gator lurking just beneath the surface of the swamp.
examples.zh: 导游指着一只潜伏在沼泽水面下的巨大短吻鳄。

lemmas.usage_note: 全称 alligator 的非正式口语缩写，常用于美式英语口语中指代短吻鳄及其皮革制品。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gator 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 鳗鱼, 鳝鱼
lemmas.def_en: the fatty flesh of eel; an elongate fish found in fresh water in Europe and America; large eels are usually smoked or pickled

examples.en: The politician dodged every tough question during the interview, proving to be as slippery as an eel.
examples.zh: 这位政客在采访中回避了所有棘手的问题，表现得像条鳗鱼一样滑不留手。

lemmas.usage_note: 指鳗鱼或鳝鱼，常用于习语 as slippery as an eel，形象比喻极其狡猾、难以捉摸的人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 eel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 膨胀，鼓起，凸出；装满，塞满
lemmas.def_en: [I] (+ with/out) To stick out in a round shape, or to swell noticeably because of fullness or pressure.

examples.en: His jacket pockets bulged with old letters, coins, and loose receipts.
examples.zh: 他的夹克口袋里塞满了旧信件、硬币和散乱的收据，鼓鼓囊囊的。

lemmas.usage_note: 作动词表示因填满或受压而鼓起、凸出，常与 with 搭配，如 bulge with cash / groceries。

lemmas.def_zh: 胀, 膨胀
lemmas.def_en: something that bulges out or is protuberant or projects from its surroundings

examples.en: He noticed an unusual bulge under the carpet and bent down to inspect it.
examples.zh: 他注意到地毯下有一块不寻常的凸起，便弯下腰去查看。

lemmas.usage_note: 作名词指隆起物或暂时的暴增，常搭配 unsightly bulge 或 a bulge in something。

lemmas.def_zh: 膨胀的, 凸出的
lemmas.def_en: curving outward

examples.en: He stuffed his passport and wallet into the already bulgy pocket of his coat.
examples.zh: 他把护照和钱包塞进了大衣原本就鼓鼓囊囊的口袋里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bulge 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 建筑物的正面, 外观, 表面
lemmas.def_en: the face or front of a building

examples.en: Behind his polite and smiling facade lay a deeply ambitious and ruthless businessman.
examples.zh: 在他礼貌而微笑的外表背后，隐藏着一个野心勃勃且冷酷无情的商人。

lemmas.usage_note: 可指建筑物临街的正面，也常引申为虚假的外表或掩饰，常搭配 behind a facade of 或 put on a facade。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 facade 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 槽, 水槽, 饲料槽
lemmas.def_en: a narrow depression (as in the earth or between ocean waves or in the ocean bed)

examples.en: The farmhand poured fresh water into the stone trough for the thirsty cattle.
examples.zh: 农工把清凉的水倒进石水槽里，供口渴的牛群饮用。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可指供牲畜饮食的长水槽，也可用于经济或气象领域指波谷、低谷期，常与 peak 构成反义对照。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 trough 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 斑马
lemmas.def_en: any of several fleet black-and-white striped African equines

examples.en: A herd of zebras grazed peacefully alongside the gazelles on the open savanna.
examples.zh: 一群斑马在大草原上与瞪羚一起平静地吃草。

lemmas.usage_note: 指非洲斑马，英式英语中常用来借指 zebra crossing（斑马线），属于具体可数名词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 zebra 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 取消抵押品赎回权
lemmas.def_en: the legal proceedings initiated by a creditor to repossess the collateral for loan that is in default

examples.en: After missing three consecutive mortgage payments, the family sadly faced the foreclosure of their home.
examples.zh: 在连续三个月未能偿还房贷后，这家人不幸面临着房屋被银行取消赎回权的境地。

lemmas.usage_note: 法律与金融专业术语，指借款人违约后银行取消抵押品赎回权的程序，常见搭配 face foreclosure。

lemmas.def_zh: 取消（抵押品）赎回权，没收（抵押财产）；排除，阻止
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (+ on) (law / finance) To take legal possession of an owner's property when they fail to keep up their mortgage payments. 2. [T] (formal) To rule out or prevent something from happening.

examples.en: The bank had no choice but to foreclose on the abandoned property.
examples.zh: 银行别无选择，只能取消那处废弃房产的赎回权。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 foreclosure 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 园艺
lemmas.def_en: the cultivation of plants

examples.en: She decided to study horticulture at university to pursue a career in sustainable agriculture.
examples.zh: 她决定在大学攻读园艺学，以便从事可持续农业方面的工作。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，指园艺学或园艺技术，常与 modern、commercial 连用，多见于农业科技与学术语境。

lemmas.def_zh: 园艺家
lemmas.def_en: an expert in the science of cultivating plants (fruit or flowers or vegetables or ornamental plants)

lemmas.def_zh: 园艺的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the cultivation of plants

lemmas.def_zh: horticultural的变形
lemmas.def_en: by means of horticulture

family_guide.root_logic: 以 horticulture 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 清单, (美)选举人名单, 名册, 目录册
lemmas.def_en: a list of items (names or tasks etc.) to be checked or consulted

examples.en: The pilot went through the pre-flight checklist to ensure all systems were operational.
examples.zh: 飞行员仔细核对了飞行前检查清单，以确保所有系统运行正常。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指检查清单或核对表，常与 create、follow 或 safety 搭配，广泛用于职场与日常任务管理。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 checklist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 乌饭树
lemmas.def_en: any of numerous shrubs of the genus Vaccinium bearing blueberries

examples.en: Wild blueberry bushes thrive naturally in the acidic soil of the northern forest.
examples.zh: 野生乌饭树（蓝莓灌木）在北方森林的酸性土壤中自然茂盛生长。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指蓝莓果实或蓝莓灌木（乌饭树属植物），常以复数形式出现，多用于饮食、园艺及日常语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 blueberry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 起重机, 小偷
lemmas.def_en: a framework erected over an oil well to allow drill tubes to be raised and lowered

examples.en: The towering oil derrick operated continuously on the windswept offshore platform.
examples.zh: 高耸的钻井起重机在海风呼啸的海上平台上持续运转。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指起重机或石油钻塔，常与 oil、drilling 连用，多见于工程、建筑与航运领域。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 derrick 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 生病，患病；使厌恶，使恶心，使作呕
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. [I] To become ill or start to develop a disease. 2. [T] To make someone feel deeply disgusted, shocked, or physically ill.

examples.en: The gruesome details of the crime sickened the jurors during the trial.
examples.zh: 庭审期间，那桩罪行令人作呕的细节让陪审员们感到极度不适。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可作不及物动词表“患病、发病”，亦可作及物动词表“使恶心、使厌恶”，常带强烈的负面情感色彩。

lemmas.def_zh: 令人厌恶地
lemmas.def_en: in a disgusting manner or to a disgusting degree

examples.en: the beggar was disgustingly filthy

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 令人恶心的；令人作呕的；极其震惊反感的
lemmas.def_en: causing feelings of nausea or revulsion; shock or disgust
lemmas.usage_note: 可修饰难闻的气味，也可修饰令人毛骨悚然的撞击声（a sickening crunch/thud）或惨烈暴行。

examples.en: There was a sickening thud as the car hit the lamppost.
examples.zh: 汽车撞上路灯柱时发出了一声令人心惊胆战的沉闷撞击声。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sicken 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 氯
lemmas.def_en: a common nonmetallic element belonging to the halogens; best known as a heavy yellow irritating toxic gas; used to purify water and as a bleaching agent and disinfectant; occurs naturally only as a salt (as in sea water)

examples.en: The maintenance staff added chlorine to the public pool to keep the water sterile.
examples.zh: 维护人员在公共泳池中加入氯，以保持池水无菌卫生。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，指化学元素氯或含氯消毒剂，常与 smell of、level 搭配，多用于游泳池消毒和工业化验。

lemmas.def_zh: 氯化, 用氯处理
lemmas.def_en: the addition or substitution of chlorine in organic compounds

lemmas.def_zh: 用氯消毒，给……加氯处理；使氯化
lemmas.def_en: [T] To treat or disinfect water or another substance with chlorine.

examples.en: chlorinated water

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chlorine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 性质的, 质的, 定性的
lemmas.def_en: involving distinctions based on qualities

examples.en: Researchers relied on qualitative methods like in-depth interviews to understand consumer behavior.
examples.zh: 研究人员依靠深度访谈等定性研究方法来了解消费者行为。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，指“定性的”或“性质上的”，常修饰 analysis、research 或 change，与 quantitative 相对，用于学术及商业报告。

lemmas.def_zh: 质量上
lemmas.def_en: in a qualitative manner

examples.en: this discoloration qualitatively suggests that the substance is low in inorganic iron

family_guide.root_logic: 以 qualitative 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 缺点, 短处
lemmas.def_en: a failing or deficiency

examples.en: Despite its obvious shortcomings, the proposed system is a significant improvement over the old one.
examples.zh: 尽管存在明显的缺点，但拟议的系统相比旧系统仍有重大改进。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指人或事物的缺点、短处，常以复数形式出现，多与 overcome、address 或 identify 搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shortcoming 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无数的, 种种的
lemmas.def_en: too numerous to be counted

examples.en: The tropical rainforest is home to myriad insect species that have yet to be discovered.
examples.zh: 热带雨林是无数尚未被发现的昆虫物种的家园。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，前置直接修饰复数名词，意为“无数的、形形色色的”，带有文学色彩与书面语风格。

lemmas.def_zh: 无数, 无数的人(或物)
lemmas.def_en: a large indefinite number

examples.en: A myriad of stars illuminated the clear night sky above the remote desert.
examples.zh: 浩瀚星海照亮了偏远沙漠上空晴朗的夜空。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，常用结构为 a myriad of 或 myriads of，表示“无数、大量”，多用于正式书面表达或修辞渲染。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 myriad 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 史前学, 史前史, 历史背景
lemmas.def_en: the time during the development of human culture before the appearance of the written word

examples.en: Cave paintings provide crucial clues about human life during European prehistory.
examples.zh: 洞穴壁画为欧洲史前时期的人类生活提供了关键线索。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词指“史前时期/史前学”，可数名词可指事件的“先期背景”，常与 human、European 搭配。

lemmas.def_zh: 历史以前的, 史前的
lemmas.def_en: belonging to or existing in times before recorded history

examples.en: prehistoric settlements
prehistoric peoples

family_guide.root_logic: 以 prehistory 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 陋屋, 棚屋
lemmas.def_en: small crude shelter used as a dwelling

examples.en: They lived in a makeshift wooden shack by the river without running water.
examples.zh: 他们住在河边一间没有自来水的临时简易木棚里。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指简陋、破烂的小木屋或棚屋，多用于描述贫困环境或临时搭建的简易居所。

lemmas.def_zh: 寄居，暂住；（常与up连用）同居
lemmas.def_en: [I] (informal, usually 'shack up') To live or stay in a place; to live together as romantic partners without being married.

examples.en: After college, he decided to shack up with two of his close friends in a small apartment.
examples.zh: 大学毕业后，他决定和两个好友在一家小公寓里合住。

lemmas.usage_note: 口语常用短语 shack up (with sb.)，表示与某人同居或暂住在一起，略带非正式色彩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shack 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 粗糙的, 下等的, 粗俗的
lemmas.def_en: of textures that are rough to the touch or substances consisting of relatively large particles

examples.en: The jacket was made of coarse wool that felt rough against his sensitive skin.
examples.zh: 这件夹克是由粗羊毛制成的，贴着他敏感的皮肤感觉很粗糙。

lemmas.usage_note: 可形容质地粗糙（如沙石、布料），也可指语言举止粗俗无礼，常与 fabric、language 连用。

lemmas.def_zh: 粗糙地, 粗俗地, 鄙俗地
lemmas.def_en: in coarse pieces

examples.en: the surfaces were coarsely granular

lemmas.def_zh: 粗糙, 劣等, 粗
lemmas.def_en: language or humor that is down-to-earth

examples.en: the saltiness of their language was inappropriate
self-parody and saltiness riddled their core genre

family_guide.root_logic: 以 coarse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 爱斯基摩人划子
lemmas.def_en: a small canoe consisting of a light frame made watertight with animal skins; used by Eskimos

examples.en: He strapped the bright yellow kayak to the roof of his car before heading to the lake.
examples.zh: 前往湖边之前，他把亮黄色的皮划艇绑在了汽车车顶上。

lemmas.usage_note: 特指皮划艇或爱斯基摩单人小艇，常搭配 go in a kayak 或 paddle a kayak。

lemmas.def_zh: 划皮划艇，划独木舟
lemmas.def_en: [I] To travel or paddle in a kayak.

examples.en: We plan to kayak down the rapid river during our summer vacation.
examples.zh: 我们计划在暑假期间沿着湍急的河流划皮艇顺流而下。

lemmas.usage_note: 用作不及物动词表示“划皮艇”，常与 down, across 或 through 等介词搭配表示划行轨迹。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kayak 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 同位素
lemmas.def_en: one of two or more atoms with the same atomic number but with different numbers of neutrons

examples.en: Carbon-14 is a radioactive isotope commonly used in dating ancient archaeological artifacts.
examples.zh: 碳-14 是一种放射性同位素，常用于测定古代考古文物的年代。

lemmas.usage_note: 化学与物理学专业术语，常与 radioactive（放射性的）或 stable（稳定的）搭配使用。

lemmas.def_zh: 同位素的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or having the relation of an isotope

family_guide.root_logic: 以 isotope 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 严酷考验, 痛苦经历, 煎熬
lemmas.def_en: a severe or trying experience

examples.en: Surviving the snowstorm on the mountain was a terrifying ordeal for the hikers.
examples.zh: 在山上的暴风雪中幸存下来对登山者而言是一场可怕的折磨。

lemmas.usage_note: 指极其艰苦、痛苦或可怕的磨难与考验，常与 painful, terrible 或 pass through 等连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ordeal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 戏谑, 嘲弄
lemmas.def_en: light teasing repartee

examples.en: Friendly banter between the coworkers made the long shift pass much more quickly.
examples.zh: 同事之间友好的打趣逗乐让漫长的轮班过得快多了。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指朋友或熟人之间轻松幽默、善意的打趣与开玩笑，常作不可数名词使用。

lemmas.def_zh: 打趣，逗乐，开玩笑
lemmas.def_en: [I] (+ with) To exchange humorous, playful, and friendly remarks with someone.

examples.en: The talk show host loved to banter with the studio audience before filming began.
examples.zh: 这位脱口秀主持人喜欢在开拍前与演播室观众插科打诨。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示以轻松戏谑的态度交谈或开玩笑，常与 with sb. 搭配构成不及物动词短语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 banter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 主调音, 基音, 基调
lemmas.def_en: the principal theme in a speech or literary work

examples.en: The keynote of her campaign speech was social equality and economic reform.
examples.zh: 她竞选演说的主基调是社会平等和经济改革。

lemmas.usage_note: 指会议、政策或作品的基调与主旨，最常见搭配为 keynote address/speech（主旨演讲）。

lemmas.def_zh: 作主旨发言；定基调
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (chiefly US) To deliver the main, theme-setting speech at a conference or convention.

examples.en: The renowned scientist was invited to keynote the international climate conference.
examples.zh: 这位著名科学家受邀在国际气候大会上发表主旨演讲。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指在大会上作主旨发言或为活动定调，常接 conference 或 convention 等宾语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 keynote 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (为死者所诵的)晚祷歌, 安慰剂, 安慰的话, 使人宽慰的事
lemmas.def_en: an innocuous or inert medication; given as a pacifier or to the control group in experiments on the efficacy of a drug

examples.en: Half of the patients in the clinical trial received the active drug, while the rest were given a placebo.
examples.zh: 临床试验中一半的患者服用了活性药物，其余人则服用了安慰剂。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学上指无药效的安慰剂，常用于双盲实验；引申指起心理抚慰作用的事物，常连用 placebo effect。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 placebo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 试验, 化验, 分析
lemmas.def_en: an appraisal of the state of affairs

examples.en: An independent assay confirmed that the ore sample contained a high percentage of silver.
examples.zh: 一份独立的化验报告证实，该矿石样本中含有高比例的银。

lemmas.usage_note: 科技或冶金语体，指对矿石、化学物质或生物样本的化验、化验结果或测定报告。

lemmas.def_zh: 化验者, 分析者
lemmas.def_en: an analyst who assays (performs chemical tests on) metals

lemmas.def_zh: 化验，分析（矿石或金属成分）；评定，鉴定；尝试
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To test or analyze a substance, especially metal or ore, to determine its purity or composition. 2. [T] (formal) To assess, evaluate, or analyze someone or something.

examples.en: The lab technicians will assay the blood samples to measure the hormone levels accurately.
examples.zh: 实验室技术人员将化验这些血液样本，以准确测定激素水平。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指对金属、矿物进行化验分析，文学语境中亦可表示尝试、评定或检验。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 assay 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使成麦芽，用麦芽处理；发麦芽
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] to convert barley or other grain into malt by steeping and germinating, or to treat with malt.

examples.en: The distillery continues to malt its own barley using traditional, time-honored methods.
examples.zh: 这家蒸馏厂继续沿用历史悠久的传统方法，自行将大麦制成麦芽。

lemmas.usage_note: 酿造专业术语，既可作及物动词（使大麦等发芽成麦芽），也可作不及物动词（谷物自然发芽）。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 麦乳精
lemmas.def_en: of grain that has not been converted into malt

examples.en: unmalted barley

family_guide.root_logic: 以 malt 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 黑人, 社会地位低下的人, 深棕色
lemmas.def_en: (ethnic slur) extremely offensive name for a Black person

examples.en: Linguists analyze the historical origins and profound racial trauma associated with the word "nigger".
examples.zh: 语言学家分析了与“黑鬼”这一词汇相关的历史渊源和深刻的种族创伤。

lemmas.usage_note: 极具冒犯性与侮辱性的种族禁忌词，现代英语中严禁在常规语境中使用，仅见于历史引述或语言学讨论。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nigger 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 教堂长椅, 会众, 座位
lemmas.def_en: long bench with backs; used in church by the congregation

examples.en: The elderly woman sat quietly in the front pew, listening attentively to the morning sermon.
examples.zh: 老妇人静静地坐在前排教堂长椅上，专注地聆听晨间布道。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，特指教堂中成排固定设置的木质长椅，常与 sit in 或 occupy 连用，属宗教或建筑语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pew 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 纯度检验证明, 品质证明
lemmas.def_en: a distinctive characteristic or attribute

examples.en: Rigorous attention to detail has always been the hallmark of her architectural designs.
examples.zh: 对细节的严格关注一直是她建筑设计的标志性特征。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，原指金银纯度印记，引申为显著特征或标志性品质，常搭配 hallmark of sth。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hallmark 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 界仁巧克力饼
lemmas.def_en: a junior Girl Scout

examples.en: She served a warm chocolate brownie topped with a scoop of vanilla ice cream for dessert.
examples.zh: 她端上一块刚出炉的巧克力布朗尼，上面加了一勺香草冰淇淋作为甜点。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，常指浓郁的方形巧克力坚果蛋糕；作小精灵或女童童子军时首字母大写，日常烘焙高频词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 brownie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 宣布放弃（权利、头衔等）；声明脱离关系，断绝
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To formally and publicly give up a claim, right, title, or position. 2. [T] To state formally that one no longer believes in, follows, or supports something.

examples.en: Under intense political pressure, the monarch decided to renounce all claims to the throne.
examples.zh: 在巨大的政治压力下，这位君主决定放弃对王位的所有主权要求。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，正式语体，指公开声明放弃权利、头衔、信仰或断绝关系，常接 claims, rights, violence 等宾语。

lemmas.def_zh: 放弃, 废弃, 弃权, 脱离关系
lemmas.def_en: rejecting or disowning or disclaiming as invalid

examples.en: His formal renunciation of the royal title surprised everyone across the nation.
examples.zh: 他正式宣布放弃王室头衔，让全国上下大吃一惊。

lemmas.def_zh: 否认, 拒绝
lemmas.def_en: an act (spoken or written) declaring that something is surrendered or disowned

family_guide.root_logic: 以 renounce 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 波浪形鬈发
lemmas.def_en: a hairdo characterized by deep regular waves that are made by a heated curling iron

examples.en: The actress styled her hair into an elegant marcel that perfectly matched her 1920s vintage gown.
examples.zh: 这位女演员将头发梳成优雅的马塞尔波浪鬈发，与她20世纪20年代的复古礼服完美契合。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，指20世纪流行的一种深度波浪形鬈发发型，常作复数或以 marcel wave 形式出现，属复古时尚词汇。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 marcel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 有...腿的
lemmas.def_en: having legs of a specified kind or number

examples.en: A four-legged robot designed for rescue operations navigated easily over the rugged terrain.
examples.zh: 一台专为救援行动设计的四足机器人在崎岖的地形上自如前行。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，极少单独使用，通常以“-legged”复合形式构成，如 four-legged 或 long-legged，指有指定特征的腿。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 legged 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无经验的, 不熟练的
lemmas.def_en: lacking practical experience or training

examples.en: The new manager was inexperienced in dealing with complex labor disputes.
examples.zh: 这位新上任的经理在处理复杂的劳资纠纷方面缺乏经验。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，指缺乏实践经验或技巧，常与介词 in 连用表示在某一领域缺乏经验，也可直接作定语修饰人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inexperienced 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 肺的, 与肺有关的, 有肺的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or affecting the lungs

examples.en: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease remains one of the leading causes of respiratory failure.
examples.zh: 慢性阻塞性肺疾病仍然是导致呼吸衰竭的主要病因之一。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学专业形容词，仅作置于名词前的定语，表示“肺的”，常见搭配如 pulmonary disease, pulmonary artery。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pulmonary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 祖先, 世系, 名门出身
lemmas.def_en: the descendants of one individual

examples.en: She was eager to trace her ancestry through genealogical records and historical archives.
examples.zh: 她非常渴望通过宗谱记录和历史档案来追溯自己的家族世系。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，常用作不可数名词表示祖先世系或血统，常搭配 trace one's ancestry 或 of ... ancestry。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ancestry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 害怕同性恋的
lemmas.def_en: prejudiced against homosexual people

examples.en: The player was suspended after making a homophobic remark during the live broadcast.
examples.zh: 该球员因在直播中发表恐同言论而被停赛。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰 slur, attack, attitude 等词，用于谴责歧视或敌视同性恋者的言行，语体偏正式、严肃。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 homophobic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 花椰菜
lemmas.def_en: plant with dense clusters of tight green flower buds

examples.en: She added steamed broccoli to the pasta to make the dish more nutritious.
examples.zh: 她在意面里加了蒸好的西兰花，让这道菜更有营养。

lemmas.usage_note: 作不可数名词指蔬菜，表示几朵时用 florets of broccoli；搭配动词常用 steam, roast 等。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 broccoli 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 过期的, 未兑的, 迟到的, 早就成熟的
lemmas.def_en: past due; not paid at the scheduled time

examples.en: The library sent an email reminding him to return the overdue books immediately.
examples.zh: 图书馆发来邮件，提醒他立即归还逾期的图书。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰 payment, bill 表示逾期未付；修饰 change, reform 则表示“早就该发生的”，感情色彩强烈。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 overdue 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 大破坏, 蹂躏
lemmas.def_en: violent and needless disturbance

examples.en: The sudden blizzard wreaked havoc on the morning commute across the city.
examples.zh: 突如其来的暴风雪给全城的早高峰通勤造成了严重混乱。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于固定搭配 wreak havoc on/upon，表示对某事物“造成巨大破坏或混乱”，属于书面语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 havoc 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 自由主义
lemmas.def_en: a political orientation that favors social progress by reform and by changing laws rather than by revolution

examples.en: Classical liberalism emphasizes individual liberty, private property, and limited government intervention.
examples.zh: 古典自由主义强调个人自由、私有财产以及有限的政府干预。

lemmas.usage_note: 政治学与社会学核心词，常与 economic, modern, classical 等连用，指强调个人自由与平等的政治哲学。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 liberalism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 左轮手枪
lemmas.def_en: a pistol with a revolving cylinder (usually having six chambers for bullets)

examples.en: The detective slowly drew his revolver from the holster as he approached the door.
examples.zh: 警探走近房门时，缓缓从枪套中拔出了左轮手枪。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，特指带旋转弹巢的左轮手枪；常见动词搭配有 load, draw, fire 等。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 revolver 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 全神贯注于，念念不忘；凝视，注视；使固定
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (+ on/upon) To focus your attention or obsession exclusively on one person, idea, or object. 2. [I, T] To direct your eyes steadily toward something. 3. [T] To make something fixed or stable.

examples.en: It is unhealthy to fixate on minor mistakes instead of looking at the bigger picture.
examples.zh: 过分纠结于微小的错误而忽略大局是不理智的。

lemmas.usage_note: 最常与 on 连用（fixate on sth），表示“过度关注、迷恋或紧盯”，常含病态或不理智的贬义色彩。

lemmas.def_zh: 定置, 固定, 定色
lemmas.def_en: an abnormal state in which development has stopped prematurely

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fixate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 棱镜, 棱柱
lemmas.def_en: a polyhedron with two congruent and parallel faces (the bases) and whose lateral faces are parallelograms

examples.en: The historian analyzed the conflict through the prism of economic inequality.
examples.zh: 这位历史学家从经济不平等的视角剖析了这场冲突。

lemmas.usage_note: 物理上指三棱镜；比喻义常用于搭配 through the prism of...，表示“从……的角度审视”。

lemmas.def_zh: 棱柱的, 折射光的, 灿烂的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or resembling or constituting a prism

examples.en: Sunlight passed through the chandelier, casting prismatic colors across the wall.
examples.zh: 阳光穿过枝形吊灯，在墙上投射出绚丽的折射色彩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 prism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 声乐家, 歌手
lemmas.def_en: a person who sings

examples.en: The lead vocalist of the rock band delivered a stunning performance last night.
examples.zh: 这支摇滚乐队的主唱昨晚带来了令人惊艳的演出。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于音乐行业或乐队语境，常搭配 lead vocalist（主唱）或 guest vocalist，比 singer 更显专业。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vocalist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 世面灵通的人
lemmas.def_en: someone who rejects the established culture; advocates extreme liberalism in politics and lifestyle

examples.en: The old industrial district has become a popular hangout for hipsters and artists.
examples.zh: 这个老工业区已成为潮人和艺术家们经常光顾的聚集地。

lemmas.usage_note: 指追求非主流文化、复古时尚与小众生活方式的时髦年轻人，常带轻微调侃或讽刺色彩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hipster 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 丑恶的, 可憎的, 令人沮丧的
lemmas.def_en: grossly offensive to decency or morality; causing horror

examples.en: The abandoned factory was an eyesore, presenting a hideous contrast to the picturesque village.
examples.zh: 那座废弃的工厂十分碍眼，与风景如画的村庄形成了极其难看的鲜明反差。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰外貌、罪行或环境，表示极度丑陋或骇人听闻；常与crime, scar, noise搭配。

lemmas.def_zh: 可怕地, 非常讨厌地
lemmas.def_en: in a hideous manner

examples.en: her face was hideously disfigured after the accident

lemmas.def_zh: 可怕
lemmas.def_en: dreadful ugliness; horrible repulsiveness

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hideous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (一)群, 游牧部落, 移动群
lemmas.def_en: a vast multitude

examples.en: Hordes of tourists descended on the coastal town as soon as summer began.
examples.zh: 入夏伊始，成群结队的游客便涌入了这座沿海小镇。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于复数或搭配hordes of，多带有贬义或压迫感，指大批涌入的人群、游客或昆虫。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 horde 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 蓝宝石, 刚玉宝石, 天蓝色
lemmas.def_en: a precious transparent stone of rich blue corundum valued as a gemstone

examples.en: She inherited an exquisite ring set with a large natural sapphire.
examples.zh: 她继承了一枚镶嵌着大颗天然蓝宝石的精致戒指。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指贵重宝石蓝宝石，也可指蔚蓝色；作定语时修饰eye, sea等，带有文学色彩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sapphire 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 大厅, 沙龙, 酒吧, 会客室
lemmas.def_en: a room or establishment where alcoholic drinks are served over a counter

examples.en: The cowboy pushed open the swinging doors and stepped into the dimly lit saloon.
examples.zh: 牛仔推开弹簧双开门，走进了昏暗的酒吧间。

lemmas.usage_note: 英式英语中常指轿车（saloon car）或客船大厅；美式英语中多指旧西部风格的酒吧间。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 saloon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 两星期
lemmas.def_en: a period of fourteen consecutive days

examples.en: The company decided to postpone the product launch by a fortnight.
examples.zh: 公司决定将产品发布会推迟两周举行。

lemmas.usage_note: 为英式英语高频日常词汇，指连续两周的时间；常见搭配有in a fortnight或a fortnight ago。

lemmas.def_zh: 每两星期一次的, 隔周发行的
lemmas.def_en: occurring every two weeks

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fortnight 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 疏浚，清淤；捞取；翻出，重提（旧事）
lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. To clean out the bed of a harbor, river, or other area of water by scooping up mud and debris. 2. (usually 'dredge up') To bring up or recall unwelcome memories or facts

examples.en: Engineers were hired to dredge the silted riverbed before the flood season arrived.
examples.zh: 在汛期到来之前，工程师们受聘疏浚已淤塞的河床。

lemmas.usage_note: 本义为用挖泥船清淤或捞取；常引申为dredge up，表示翻出、重提旧事或不快的回忆。

lemmas.def_zh: 疏浚机, 挖泥船, 采捞船
lemmas.def_en: a barge (or a vessel resembling a barge) that is used for dredging

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dredge 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 扫帚, 金雀花
lemmas.def_en: a cleaning implement for sweeping; bundle of straws or twigs attached to a long handle

examples.en: He leaned the broom against the kitchen wall after sweeping up the broken glass.
examples.zh: 清扫完碎玻璃后，他把扫帚靠在了厨房墙边。

lemmas.usage_note: 指长柄扫帚清扫工具，也指植物金雀花；常见习语a new broom指新官上任之人。

lemmas.def_zh: （用扫帚）扫除，清扫
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (dated / regional) To sweep a floor or area clean with a broom.

examples.en: The janitor broomed the fallen leaves off the concrete patio every morning.
examples.zh: 看门人每天早晨都会将混凝土露台上的落叶扫除干净。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物或不及物动词，表示用扫帚打扫或清除；多用于具体作业语境，后接away或off。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 broom 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 首字母缩拼词, 首字母组合词
lemmas.def_en: a word formed from the initial letters of the several words in the name

examples.en: The word 'radar' originated as an acronym for 'radio detection and ranging'.
examples.zh: “雷达”一词最初是“无线电探测与测距”的首字母缩拼词。

lemmas.usage_note: 专指由首字母组成并作为一个完整单词发音的缩略词（如NATO），有别于逐字发音的initialism。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 acronym 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 热心, 热衷, 热诚
lemmas.def_en: a feeling of strong eagerness (usually in favor of a person or cause)

examples.en: Her missionary zeal for reforming the education system inspired all her colleagues.
examples.zh: 她对改革教育系统所倾注的饱满热诚感染了所有同事。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面语色彩较浓，指对某项事业或信仰极大的热忱；常与for或in搭配，如missionary zeal。

lemmas.def_zh: 热衷的, 热诚的, 热心的, 热情的
lemmas.def_en: marked by active interest and enthusiasm

examples.en: an avid sports fan

lemmas.def_zh: (正式)热心, 渴望, 积极, 热诚, 热情
lemmas.def_en: in a zealous manner

examples.en: she worked zealously to raise funds for the literacy project

family_guide.root_logic: 以 zeal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 发出吱吱声（或尖叫声）；侥幸通过，勉强胜出
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To make a short, high-pitched cry or sound. 2. [I] ('squeak by/through') To succeed or get through with difficulty by a narrow margin.

examples.en: The team managed to squeak through to the semi-finals with a last-minute goal.
examples.zh: 该队凭借最后一分钟的进球侥幸勉强闯入了半决赛。

lemmas.usage_note: 指发出短促尖锐的声音；常与through/by连用表示侥幸勉强通过或险胜；也可作俚语指告密。

lemmas.def_zh: 吱吱响的, 发轧声的
lemmas.def_en: having or making a high-pitched sound such as that made by a mouse or a rusty hinge

lemmas.def_zh: 吱吱叫的东西, 小猪, 雏鸽
lemmas.def_en: any artifact that makes a squeaking sound when used

examples.en: those sneakers are squeakers
which hinge is the squeaker?

family_guide.root_logic: 以 squeak 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 五十周年纪念/庆祝, 二十五周年纪念/庆祝, 欢乐的佳节, 欢庆日, 狂欢节
lemmas.def_en: a special anniversary (or the celebration of it)

examples.en: The whole city erupted into vibrant celebrations to mark the monarch's golden jubilee.
examples.zh: 为了庆祝君主登基五十周年金禧纪念，整座城市沉浸在一片热烈的欢庆之中。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作可数名词，多指重大事件或统治时期的特殊周年庆典，常与 silver, golden, diamond 连用。

lemmas.def_zh: 欢呼, 喜欢, 庆祝
lemmas.def_en: a feeling of extreme joy

lemmas.def_zh: 欢呼, 欢喜
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (formal / rare) To rejoice, triumph, and celebrate with great joy.

lemmas.def_zh: 欢呼的, 喜洋洋的
lemmas.def_en: joyful and proud especially because of triumph or success

examples.en: A jubilant crowd gathered in the town square to celebrate their team's championship victory.
examples.zh: 欣喜若狂的人群聚集在城镇广场，庆祝他们的球队夺冠。

lemmas.def_zh: 欢欣地, 喜气洋洋地
lemmas.def_en: in a joyous manner

examples.en: they shouted happily

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jubilee 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 汇出，汇寄（款项）；免除，赦免（债务、惩罚）；提交，下呈（审理）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (+ to) (finance) To send money in payment or transfer funds. 2. [T] (formal) To cancel a debt, penalty, or prison sentence.

examples.en: The migrant worker managed to remit a substantial portion of his monthly wages to his family.
examples.zh: 这名外来务工人员设法将每月工资的很大一部分汇寄给了家人。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式用语，及物时常表“汇寄（款项）”或“免除（债务/惩罚）”，不及物时可表病势“缓解”。

lemmas.def_zh: 宽恕, 豁免, 免罪, 缓和, 减轻
lemmas.def_en: an abatement in intensity or degree (as in the manifestations of a disease)

examples.en: his cancer is in remission

lemmas.def_zh: 汇款
lemmas.def_en: a payment of money sent to a person in another place

examples.en: She sent a monthly remittance to her parents to help cover their living expenses.
examples.zh: 她每月给父母寄一笔汇款，以帮助补贴他们的生活费用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 remit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 缺口, 突出端, 小伙子
lemmas.def_en: a sharp projection on an edge or surface

examples.en: He sustained a deep cut after brushing against the sharp jag of the broken rock.
examples.zh: 他的身体擦到了碎石锋利的尖角上，划出了一道很深的口子。

lemmas.usage_note: 作名词可指锯齿状的尖角或缺口；在口语中也常指短暂沉溺于某种情绪或行为的狂欢期（如 crying jag）。

lemmas.def_zh: 剪（撕）成锯齿状，使产生缺口；刺，戳
lemmas.def_en: [T] To cut, slash, or tear uneven notches or sharp teeth into an edge.

examples.en: The artisan carefully jagged the edge of the parchment to give it an antique appearance.
examples.zh: 工匠小心地把羊皮纸的边缘撕成锯齿状，使其呈现出古旧的质感。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指将边缘撕割或修整成不规则的锯齿状，或用尖锐之物刺戮，多见于文学或手工描述。

lemmas.def_zh: 锯齿状的, 有缺口的, 参差不齐的, (边缘)粗糙的, 凹凸不平的
lemmas.def_en: having an irregularly notched or toothed margin as though gnawed

lemmas.def_zh: 锯齿状地
lemmas.def_en: with a ragged and uneven appearance

examples.en: a long beard, raggedly cut

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jag 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 纵火, 纵火罪
lemmas.def_en: malicious burning to destroy property

examples.en: Police suspect arson after finding traces of an accelerant inside the gutted warehouse.
examples.zh: 警方在被烧毁的仓库内发现助燃剂痕迹后，怀疑这是人为纵火。

lemmas.usage_note: 法律与新闻常用不可数名词，专指故意纵火焚烧财产的犯罪行为，常搭配 commit arson 或 arson attack。

lemmas.def_zh: 纵火犯
lemmas.def_en: a criminal who illegally sets fire to property

family_guide.root_logic: 以 arson 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 咒骂，说粗话（fuck 的委婉说法，常与 off 连用）
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] (slang, euphemistic) to curse or swear, used as a substitute for 'fuck'

examples.en: He was terrified that one simple mistake would eff up the entire operation.
examples.zh: 他极为害怕一个小小的失误就会把整个行动全盘搞砸。

lemmas.usage_note: 极口语与俚语用法，常作为粗俗词汇 fuck 的委婉替代形式，高频短语如 eff up（弄糟/搞砸）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 eff 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 宣判……无罪；表现
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (+ of) (law) To officially decide and state in a court of law that someone is not guilty of a crime. 2. [T] ('acquit oneself') To perform or behave in a specified way.

examples.en: The jury took less than an hour to acquit the defendant of all criminal charges.
examples.zh: 陪审团仅用不到一小时便宣判被告面临的所有刑事指控均不成立。

lemmas.usage_note: 司法语境指“宣判无罪”，常接 of；反身用法 acquit oneself 指在困难场景下“表现优异”。

lemmas.def_zh: 履行, 无罪开释
lemmas.def_en: a judgment of not guilty

examples.en: The high-profile trial ended in a full acquittal due to a lack of decisive evidence.
examples.zh: 由于缺乏决定性证据，这场备受瞩目的审判最终以全案无罪开释告终。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，指法庭对被告人罪名不成立的正式无罪判决，常作可数或不可数名词，动词搭配如 secure an acquittal。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 acquit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 千
lemmas.def_en: one thousand grams; the basic unit of mass adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites

examples.en: She asked the grocer to weigh out two kilos of fresh tomatoes for the sauce.
examples.zh: 她让杂货店老板称两公斤新鲜番茄用来做酱汁。

lemmas.usage_note: 日常口语与商业计量中极高频，为 kilogram 的常用简称，复数形式直接加 -s（kilos）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kilo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （资产、货币等）（使）贬值，跌价；轻视，贬低
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] to decrease in value over time, or to reduce the official value of a currency 2. [T] to treat or represent something as having little value; to belittle

examples.en: A new luxury car begins to depreciate significantly the moment it is driven off the lot.
examples.zh: 一辆崭新的豪华汽车从开出车库的那一刻起，就会开始大幅贬值。

lemmas.usage_note: 可作及物或不及物动词；财会与经济领域指资产或货币“贬值/折旧”，文学语境亦可表“轻视、贬低”。

lemmas.def_zh: 价值减低, 减价, 跌落, 贬低, 折旧
lemmas.def_en: a decrease in price or value

examples.en: depreciation of the dollar against the yen

family_guide.root_logic: 以 depreciate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 垂涎，贪图，渴望（尤指他人之物）
lemmas.def_en: [T] To want very much to have something, especially something that belongs to someone else.

examples.en: The ambitious junior executive openly coveted the position held by her retiring manager.
examples.zh: 这位野心勃勃的基层主管毫不掩饰地觊觎着即将退休的经理所担任的职位。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指强烈渴望占有属于他人的财物或成就，常含不当或贪婪之意，其过去分词 coveted 常作形容词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 covet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 小尖塔, 尖峰, 高峰, 极点
lemmas.def_en: (architecture) a slender upright spire at the top of a buttress of tower

examples.en: Winning the Nobel Prize was universally considered the absolute pinnacle of her scientific career.
examples.zh: 荣获诺贝尔奖被公认为她科学职业生涯的绝对巅峰。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，本义指哥特式建筑的小尖塔或山岩尖峰；多用于比喻事业、权力或成就的“巅峰”（the pinnacle of）。

lemmas.def_zh: 给……加顶塔；置于尖塔之上
lemmas.def_en: [T] (architecture / literary) To crown or furnish a building with pinnacles; to place on a high point.

examples.en: The architect pinnacled the cathedral towers with ornate stone spires to accentuate their verticality.
examples.zh: 建筑师用华丽的石制尖顶为大教堂的双塔饰以尖塔，以突显其高耸入云的线条感。

lemmas.usage_note: 罕见及物动词，指在建筑上建造尖塔，或比喻将某人、某物推上极高的地位/顶端，多用于被动语态或文学修辞。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pinnacle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 对……洗脑，强行灌输思想
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (+ into) To force someone to abandon their beliefs and accept new ones through intense psychological pressure and repetition.

examples.en: Cult members were systematically brainwashed into believing that the outside world was evil.
examples.zh: 邪教成员被系统性地洗脑，进而相信外面的世界是邪恶的。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于被动语态或跟into doing搭配，指通过反复灌输或精神控制迫使某人接受特定思想。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 brainwash 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 教会的, 神职的, 牧师的
lemmas.def_en: of or associated with a church (especially a Christian Church)

examples.en: The museum houses a rare collection of medieval ecclesiastical vestments and sacred vessels.
examples.zh: 该博物馆收藏了一批罕见的中世纪教会祭披与圣器。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面语，用于修饰与基督教教会组织、教职人员或宗教礼仪直接相关的制度、建筑及服饰。

lemmas.def_zh: 基督教地, （与）教会（有关）地
lemmas.def_en: in an ecclesiastic manner

examples.en: the candidate was ecclesiastically endorsed

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ecclesiastical 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 人造阴茎
lemmas.def_en: a vibrating device that substitutes for an erect penis to provide vaginal stimulation

examples.en: Silicone is one of the most popular body-safe materials used to manufacture a dildo.
examples.zh: 硅胶是用于制作人造阴茎的最受欢迎的人体安全材质之一。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指情趣用品中的人造阴茎，日常口语或专业性健康语境中使用，亦可用作俚语侮辱词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dildo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 强健的, 健全的
lemmas.def_en: having rugged physical strength; inured to fatigue or hardships

examples.en: You will need a pair of sturdy hiking boots to tackle the rocky mountain trails.
examples.zh: 你需要一双结实的登山靴来应对崎岖不平的山路。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰人（身体结实健壮）或物品（结构坚固耐用），亦可形容立场或原则坚定不移。

lemmas.def_zh: 强健, 坚固, 强壮
lemmas.def_en: the state of being vigorous and robust

lemmas.def_zh: 强壮地, 坚强地, 坚毅地
lemmas.def_en: in a sturdy manner

examples.en: feet sturdily apart

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sturdy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 华尔兹舞, 圆舞曲
lemmas.def_en: an assured victory (especially in an election)

examples.en: The orchestra concluded the elegant evening with a lively Strauss waltz.
examples.zh: 管弦乐团以一首轻快的施特劳斯圆舞曲结束了这个优雅的夜晚。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指三拍子的圆舞曲或华尔兹舞步，常与动词dance、play搭配使用。

lemmas.def_zh: 跳华尔兹舞的人; 行驶的路程
lemmas.def_en: a dancer who waltzes

lemmas.def_zh: 跳华尔兹舞，与……跳华尔兹舞；轻快地走，昂首阔步；轻而易举地获得（成功）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To dance a waltz, or dance a waltz with someone. 2. [I] (+ in/into/through) (informal) To walk somewhere briskly and confidently, or accomplish something easily.

examples.en: He just waltzed into the office an hour late as if nothing had happened.
examples.zh: 他迟到了一个小时，却像什么事都没发生一样大摇大摆地晃进了办公室。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指跳华尔兹，也常引申为轻快自信、毫不在乎地走动，常与in、into、out搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 waltz 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 任务, 差使, 使命
lemmas.def_en: a short trip that is taken in the performance of a necessary task or mission

examples.en: I spent the entire Saturday morning running errands such as grocery shopping and mailing parcels.
examples.zh: 我周六一整个上午都在跑腿办杂事，比如买菜和寄包裹。

lemmas.usage_note: 极常用于run errands（跑腿办事）搭配，指短途外出办理的日常琐事或公差差使。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 errand 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 逆火, 回火, 放火
lemmas.def_en: the backward escape of gases and unburned gunpowder after a gun is fired

examples.en: A sudden, loud backfire from the old truck startled everyone on the sidewalk.
examples.zh: 那辆旧卡车突然发出一声巨大的逆火巨响，吓了人行道上的所有人一跳。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指内燃机或火器的逆火、回火声，林火控制中亦指迎面逆火防线。

lemmas.def_zh: 产生事与愿违的不良后果；（引擎等）发生逆火
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (+ on) to have the opposite and adverse effect from what was originally intended 2. [I] (of an engine or vehicle) to undergo a mistimed explosion in the cylinder or exhaust system

examples.en: The company's aggressive marketing campaign backfired on them, causing widespread consumer backlash.
examples.zh: 该公司激进的营销活动适得其反，引发了消费者的广泛抵制。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，引申义极高频，指计划或行动产生适得其反的严重意外后果，常与on连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 backfire 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 披，搭；悬挂（布帘等），覆以褶帘
lemmas.def_en: [T] To hang or place cloth, clothing, or a body part loosely and gracefully over or around something.

examples.en: She draped a warm wool blanket over her grandmother's trembling shoulders.
examples.zh: 她把一条温暖的羊毛毯披在祖母微微颤抖的肩膀上。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与over、around或with搭配，指将布料、衣物等悬挂、覆盖或随意搭在某物表面。

lemmas.def_zh: 帏帐, 布料
lemmas.def_en: hanging cloth used as a blind (especially for a window)

examples.en: Heavy velvet drapery hung over the tall windows to block the morning light.
examples.zh: 高大的窗户上挂着厚重的丝绒窗帘，以遮挡晨光。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 披覆的；裹着的；悬垂褶皱的
lemmas.def_en: covered or wrapped loosely with cloth or another material; arranged in graceful folds
lemmas.usage_note: 常与介词 in 或 with 搭配，如 draped in a flag / draped with velvet。

examples.en: She entered the ballroom draped in an elegant silk shawl.
examples.zh: 她身披一条优雅的丝绸披肩走进了宴会厅。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 drape 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 轻拍，轻按；轻涂
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To touch, wipe, or apply something gently and quickly with small strokes.

examples.en: She gently dabbed her tear-stained eyes with a soft cotton handkerchief.
examples.zh: 她用柔软的棉质手帕轻轻擦拭着满含泪水的眼睛。

lemmas.usage_note: 指用海绵、毛巾等轻触、轻拍或轻敷，常与at、on连用，多见于化妆、伤口处理语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dab 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 堤
lemmas.def_en: (slang) offensive term for a lesbian who is noticeably masculine

examples.en: Engineers reinforced the coastal dyke to protect the low-lying farmland from flooding.
examples.zh: 工程师加固了沿海大堤，以保护低洼农田免受洪水侵袭。

lemmas.usage_note: 拼写同dike，工程语境指防水筑造的堤坝、土堤；地质学指岩脉；俚语指女同性恋（需注意冒犯性）。

lemmas.def_zh: 筑堤防守，给…筑堤
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (chiefly British) To enclose, defend, or protect land with a dyke or embankment.

examples.en: Centuries ago, the Dutch began to dyke out the North Sea to reclaim fertile land.
examples.zh: 几个世纪前，荷兰人开始筑堤阻拦北海以开垦肥沃的土地。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指修建堤防以拦水、筑堤防护某区域，多与in或out构成固定短语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dyke 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 竞技表演
lemmas.def_en: an exhibition of cowboy skills

examples.en: Thousands of spectators gathered to watch the annual rodeo in Texas.
examples.zh: 数以千计的观众聚集在一起观看德克萨斯州一年一度的牛仔竞技表演。

lemmas.usage_note: 指牛仔竞技表演或比赛，常与 hold、attend、annual 搭配，具有浓厚的北美西部文化色彩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rodeo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 副主祭, 执事, 行会会长
lemmas.def_en: a Protestant layman who assists the minister

examples.en: After years of dedicated service, he was ordained as a deacon in the local church.
examples.zh: 经过多年的热心服务，他被任命为当地教会的执事。

lemmas.usage_note: 宗教专有名词，指基督教教会中的执事或助祭，常作称谓或与 ordain（任命）搭配使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 deacon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 突击队, 突击队员, (南非)布尔人部队
lemmas.def_en: a member of a military unit trained as shock troops for hit-and-run raids

examples.en: The commando slipped silently behind enemy lines to gather crucial intelligence.
examples.zh: 这名突击队员悄无声息地潜入敌后收集关键情报。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指突击队员或特种突击队，多用于军事语境，常见搭配有 commando raid（突击队袭击）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 commando 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 教条
lemmas.def_en: a religious doctrine that is proclaimed as true without proof

examples.en: The scientist urged his students to question established dogma and seek empirical evidence.
examples.zh: 这位科学家敦促他的学生质疑既定教条并寻求实证依据。

lemmas.usage_note: 多含贬义，指不容置疑的教条或教义，常与 religious、political 或 challenge 搭配使用。

lemmas.def_zh: 武断, 教条主义
lemmas.def_en: the intolerance and prejudice of a bigot

examples.en: His rigid dogmatism made it almost impossible to hold a reasonable debate.
examples.zh: 他那顽固的教条主义使得理性辩论几乎无法进行。

lemmas.def_zh: 教条的, 武断的
lemmas.def_en: characterized by assertion of unproved or unprovable principles

lemmas.def_zh: 非教条的, 非武断的
lemmas.def_en: unwilling to accept authority or dogma (especially in religion)

lemmas.def_zh: 武断地；教条主义地
lemmas.def_en: in a narrow-minded dogmatic manner

examples.en: he is a dogmatically opinionated critic of Modern Art

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dogma 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 脚注
lemmas.def_en: a printed note placed below the text on a printed page

examples.en: Detailed references and additional explanations are provided in the footnote.
examples.zh: 详细的参考文献和补充说明均在脚注中列出。

lemmas.usage_note: 学术写作高频词，指页面底部的脚注，也常比喻为微不足道的小事或历史附注。

lemmas.def_zh: 为…加附注，给…加脚注
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To add explanatory or source notes at the bottom of pages in a text; to document with footnotes.

examples.en: The editor carefully footnoted the historical manuscript to clarify archaic terms.
examples.zh: 编辑仔细地为这份历史手稿添加了脚注，以阐明生僻词汇。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指为文章或书籍添加脚注，常以被动语态或过去分词修饰名词形式出现。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 footnote 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 昏睡状态, 恍惚, 着迷
lemmas.def_en: a psychological state induced by (or as if induced by) a magical incantation

examples.en: She sat staring out the window, lost in a deep trance.
examples.zh: 她呆坐在窗前凝视着外面，陷入了深深的出神状态。

lemmas.usage_note: 指催眠状态、恍惚或出神，常与介词 in、into 或 fall into、go into 连用。

lemmas.def_zh: 使入迷，使沉醉；使发呆，使恍惚
lemmas.def_en: [T] To put someone into a trance, or enchant and captivate someone completely.

examples.en: The hypnotic melody seemed to trance the entire audience into silence.
examples.zh: 那令人如痴如醉的旋律仿佛让全场观众陷入恍惚，鸦雀无声。

lemmas.usage_note: 较为文学化的及物动词，意为“使恍惚、使入迷”，现多使用过去分词 tranced 作表语或定语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 trance 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 伸开四肢坐（或躺）；（城市、植物等）杂乱无章地蔓延，随意扩展
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To sit or lie with arms and legs spread out untidily or carelessly. 2. [I] To spread out in an irregular or uncontrolled way over a large area.

examples.en: The modern city continues to sprawl into the surrounding countryside.
examples.zh: 这座现代化城市继续向周围的乡村区域无序蔓延。

lemmas.usage_note: 可指人四肢摊开懒散躺坐（常与 out 连用），也可指城市或建筑杂乱无序地蔓延扩展。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sprawl 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 蛤, 沉默寡言的人
lemmas.def_en: burrowing marine mollusk living on sand or mud; the shell closes with viselike firmness

examples.en: We ordered a steaming bowl of fresh clam chowder at the seaside restaurant.
examples.zh: 我们在海滨餐馆点了一碗热气腾腾的新鲜蛤蜊浓汤。

lemmas.usage_note: 指蛤蜊等双壳类软体动物；也可用作习语 as happy as a clam（非常快乐）或比喻沉默寡言的人。

lemmas.def_zh: 闭口不言，守口如瓶；捞蛤
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] ('clam up') (informal) To suddenly become silent and refuse to talk or disclose information. 2. [I] To dig for or gather clams.

examples.en: Every summer, local families go to the muddy beach to clam at low tide.
examples.zh: 每年夏天，当地家庭都会在退潮时去泥滩上捞蛤蜊。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，指在海滩挖蛤蜊；口语中常构成短语 clam up（突然闭口不言、拒不开口）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 clam 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （使）起褶痕，（使）起皱；（使）折叠
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To make or develop folds, lines, or wrinkles in cloth, paper, or skin.

examples.en: Packing the silk shirt carelessly will crease the fabric badly.
examples.zh: 把丝绸衬衫马虎地塞进包里会使面料起严重的褶皱。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可用作及物动词表示弄皱，也可作不及物动词表示起皱痕，常用于衣物、纸张或面部神情。

lemmas.def_zh: crease（皱褶）的变形
lemmas.def_en: used especially of fabrics

examples.en: uncreased trousers

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crease 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 铜锣, 皿形钟
lemmas.def_en: a percussion instrument consisting of a metal plate that is struck with a softheaded drumstick

examples.en: The monk struck the heavy gong, signaling the start of the evening meditation.
examples.zh: 僧人敲响了沉重的铜锣，标志着晚间冥想的开始。

lemmas.usage_note: 指金属铜锣或碟形钟，常见搭配有 hit the gong（敲锣）或 sound the gong。

lemmas.def_zh: 敲锣，鸣锣
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To strike a gong to produce a resonant sound, often as a signal.

examples.en: The warden gonged the scattered prisoners back to their cells for the night.
examples.zh: 狱警鸣锣召唤分散的囚犯返回牢房过夜。

lemmas.usage_note: 动词，指鸣锣发信号以召唤或警告某人，常带动作宾语或与介词短语连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gong 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 精明的, 谨慎的, 节约的
lemmas.def_en: showing self-interest and shrewdness in dealing with others

examples.en: Through a series of canny investments, she built a multimillion-dollar empire in less than a decade.
examples.zh: 凭借一系列精明的投资，她在不到十年的时间里建立起了一个资产数百万美元的商业帝国。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于商业或政治语境，形容人精明、机敏且判断准确，多修饰 investor、politician 或 move。

lemmas.def_zh: 怪诞的, 可怕的, 离奇的, 神秘的
lemmas.def_en: suggesting the operation of supernatural influences; ; ; - John Galsworthy; ; - Henry Kingsley

examples.en: an eldritch screech
the three weird sisters

lemmas.def_zh: 奇怪地, 神秘地, 危险地
lemmas.def_en: in an uncanny manner

examples.en: uncannily human robots

lemmas.def_zh: 精明地, 机灵地, 节约地
lemmas.def_en: with foresight

examples.en: more presciently than they superiors, these workers grasped the economic situation

family_guide.root_logic: 以 canny 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 重申，再确认
lemmas.def_en: [T] to state something again strongly and clearly to confirm a belief, agreement, or decision

examples.en: Both nations issued a joint statement to reaffirm their commitment to maintaining regional stability.
examples.zh: 两国发表联合声明，重申维护地区稳定的承诺。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面语动词，后常接 commitment、support 或 belief，表示公开重申原则、立场或誓言。

lemmas.def_zh: 再断言, 再确认
lemmas.def_en: renewed affirmation

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reaffirm 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （车辆、车轮等）打滑，侧滑
lemmas.def_en: [I] (of a vehicle or wheel) To slide uncontrollably sideways on a wet, icy, or loose surface.

examples.en: The delivery van skidded on the black ice and collided with the roadside barrier.
examples.zh: 那辆送货车在暗冰上打滑，撞上了路边的护栏。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作不及物动词，描述车辆或人在湿滑地面失控滑移，常与 on、across 或 into 连用。

lemmas.def_zh: [林]集材工,集材机,集材道横木
lemmas.def_en: a person who slips or slides because of loss of traction

lemmas.def_zh: 不滑的
lemmas.def_en: designed to reduce or prevent skidding

examples.en: nonskid tires

family_guide.root_logic: 以 skid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 到处存在, 普遍存在
lemmas.def_en: the state of being everywhere at once (or seeming to be everywhere at once)

examples.en: The growing ubiquity of mobile devices has completely transformed how people consume news.
examples.zh: 移动设备的日益普及彻底改变了人们获取新闻的方式。

lemmas.usage_note: 学术与书面语名词，指无处不在的状态，常搭配 the ubiquity of...（如智能手机、数字媒体）。

lemmas.def_zh: 普遍存在, 处处存在, 随遇
lemmas.def_en: the state of being everywhere at once (or seeming to be everywhere at once)

lemmas.def_zh: 无所不在的, 到处存在的, 普遍存在的
lemmas.def_en: being present everywhere at once

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ubiquity 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 发电所, 动力室, 精力旺盛的人, 办事效率高的机构
lemmas.def_en: a highly energetic and indefatigable person

examples.en: The city has evolved from an industrial hub into a leading financial powerhouse of the continent.
examples.zh: 这座城市已从一个工业枢纽转变为该大陆领先的金融重地。

lemmas.usage_note: 本义为发电厂，现多引申为充满活力、极具实力的组织、国家或个人，如 economic powerhouse。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 powerhouse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 布商, 绸缎商人, 呢绒布商
lemmas.def_en: a dealer in textiles (especially silks)

examples.en: The wealthy mercer imported rare silks from the Orient to supply the royal court with luxurious fabrics.
examples.zh: 这位富有的绸缎商人从东方进口珍稀丝绸，为宫廷提供奢华面料。

lemmas.usage_note: 历史或传统英式英语名词，指经销丝绸、呢绒等高档布料的商人，现代多见于历史文本或店名。

lemmas.def_zh: 作丝光处理
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (textiles) To treat cotton thread or fabric chemically to give it greater strength and a silky luster.

examples.en: mercerize cotton

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mercer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 狼人, 豺狼般的人
lemmas.def_en: a monster able to change appearance from human to wolf and back again

examples.en: According to ancient folklore, a werewolf could only be slain by a bullet made of pure silver.
examples.zh: 根据古老的民间传说，狼人只能被纯银制造的子弹杀死。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，源于民间传说，指月圆之夜变身成狼的妖怪；复数形式为 werewolves。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 werewolf 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 突出部分, 暗礁, 矿层
lemmas.def_en: a projecting ridge on a mountain or submerged under water

examples.en: A small mountain goat stood fearlessly on a narrow rocky ledge hundreds of feet above the valley.
examples.zh: 一只小山羊毫无惧色地站在山谷上方数百英尺狭窄的岩石挑台上。

lemmas.usage_note: 具体名词，指岩壁、悬崖突出的狭窄横面，或窗台（window ledge），常作介词 on 的宾语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ledge 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 优秀策划者, 才子
lemmas.def_en: someone who creates new things

examples.en: Police suspect that an infamous criminal mastermind orchestrated the daring museum heist.
examples.zh: 警方怀疑一名臭名昭著的犯罪头目策划了这起大胆的博物馆盗窃案。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指幕后总策划者、主谋（尤指策划复杂计划或犯罪者），常构成 the mastermind behind...。

lemmas.def_zh: 策划，谋划，幕后操纵
lemmas.def_en: [T] To plan and direct an elaborate, complex, or secret project, campaign, or crime.

examples.en: The seasoned campaign manager masterminded a stunning election victory for the underdog candidate.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的竞选经理精心策划，使处于劣势的候选人赢得了令人惊叹的选举胜利。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指精明周密地策划、操纵重大行动、策略或战役，宾语常为 campaign、plan 等。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mastermind 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 小组委员会
lemmas.def_en: a subset of committee members organized for a specific purpose

examples.en: The Senate subcommittee convened a hearing to investigate allegations of price-gouging in the pharmaceutical sector.
examples.zh: 参议院下属专门委员会召开听证会，调查制药行业哄抬物价的指控。

lemmas.usage_note: 政治及行政正式用语，指委员会下设的分委会或专项工作小组，常与 on 连用表明职责。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 subcommittee 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 催讨（债款），逼索；反复索求
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To persistently demand payment of a debt from someone.

examples.en: Creditors began to dun him incessantly for the overdue payments.
examples.zh: 债权人开始接二连三地向他催讨逾期的欠款。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指反复、坚持不懈地向某人催讨债务，多带烦扰意味，常与介词 for 连用，属书面及正式语体。

lemmas.def_zh: 暗褐色的, 微暗的
lemmas.def_en: of a dull greyish brown to brownish grey color

examples.en: A dun mist hung heavily over the marshland at dawn.
examples.zh: 黎明时分，一层暗褐色的薄雾沉沉地笼罩着沼泽地。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于文学或描写性语境，形容灰褐色、暗褐色或阴暗沉闷的颜色，常修饰动物毛皮或天空、烟雾等。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dun 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 替代者, 代用品
lemmas.def_en: someone who takes the place of another person

examples.en: She agreed to act as a surrogate for her sister, who was unable to carry a child.
examples.zh: 她同意为无法生育的姐姐充当代孕母亲。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示替代某人、某物或充当代孕母亲的个体，常见搭配如 surrogate for 或 act as a surrogate，多用于正式或法律医学语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 surrogate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 致病的, 病态的, 疾病的, 可怕的
lemmas.def_en: suggesting an unhealthy mental state

examples.en: He had a morbid curiosity about the gruesome details of the murder.
examples.zh: 他对这起谋杀案令人毛骨悚然的细节有着病态的好奇心。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可指思想对死亡等消极事物的病态着迷，也可指医学上的病理状态，常与 curiosity、fascination 搭配。

lemmas.def_zh: 病态, 发病, 罹病率
lemmas.def_en: the relative incidence of a particular disease

lemmas.def_zh: 疾病, 患部, 致病, 生病, 病理学, 不健康, 忧闷, 病态, 可怕, 令人毛骨悚然
lemmas.def_en: in a morbid manner or to a morbid degree

examples.en: he was morbidly fascinated by dead bodies

family_guide.root_logic: 以 morbid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 粉瘤, 拥挤不堪的城市
lemmas.def_en: a common cyst of the skin; filled with fatty matter (sebum) that is secreted by a sebaceous gland that has been blocked

examples.en: The surgeon successfully excised a small, benign wen from the back of the patient's neck.
examples.zh: 外科医生成功切除了患者颈部后侧的一个小型良性粉瘤。

lemmas.usage_note: 可指皮脂腺囊肿（粉瘤），历史文献中亦比喻过度膨胀臃肿的城市（如旧时的伦敦），多属旧式或书面表达。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 技术
lemmas.def_en: a style of fast heavy electronic dance music usually without vocals

examples.en: The warehouse party featured underground DJs playing fast-paced techno until sunrise.
examples.zh: 仓库派对上，地下DJ们演奏着快节奏的铁克诺电音直至日出。

lemmas.usage_note: 在现代语境中通常指高节拍的电子舞曲风格，亦可作为合成词前缀或非正式代指科技技术，多用于口语与流行文化。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 techno 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 镁
lemmas.def_en: a light silver-white ductile bivalent metallic element; in pure form it burns with brilliant white flame; occurs naturally only in combination (as in magnesite and dolomite and carnallite and spinel and olivine)

examples.en: Dark leafy greens and nuts are excellent dietary sources of magnesium.
examples.zh: 深绿色叶菜和坚果是膳食中极佳的镁元素来源。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，指化学元素镁，常用于科技、医学及日常营养语境，常见搭配如 magnesium deficiency（缺镁）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 magnesium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 渔夫, 钓鱼者, 渔船
lemmas.def_en: someone whose occupation is catching fish

examples.en: The old fisherman steered his wooden boat back to the harbor before the storm broke.
examples.zh: 老渔夫在暴风雨来临前将木船驶回了港口。

lemmas.usage_note: 指从事捕鱼职业者或钓鱼爱好者，复数形式为 fishermen，常与 commercial、local 等词连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fisherman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 世袭的, 遗传的
lemmas.def_en: occurring among members of a family usually by heredity

examples.en: Huntington's disease is a severe hereditary condition that damages nerve cells in the brain.
examples.zh: 亨廷顿病是一种损害大脑神经细胞的严重遗传性疾病。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰通过基因代代相传的生理特征/疾病，或依法世袭的爵位/特权，常与 disease、title、peerage 连用。

lemmas.def_zh: 遗传, 形质遗传
lemmas.def_en: the biological process whereby genetic factors are transmitted from one generation to the next

examples.en: Eye color and height are traits determined largely by heredity rather than environmental factors.
examples.zh: 眼睛的颜色和身高主要是由遗传而非环境因素决定的特征。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hereditary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 摊牌, 暴露, 紧要关头
lemmas.def_en: a hostile disagreement face-to-face

examples.en: The two presidential candidates are preparing for a final showdown in tonight's debate.
examples.zh: 两位总统候选人正为今晚辩论中的最终决战做准备。

lemmas.usage_note: 指通过直接对抗或公开摊牌以终结长期争端的决胜时刻，常见搭配如 have a showdown、lead to a showdown。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 showdown 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 草根的；基层的；乡村的
lemmas.def_en: fundamental

examples.en: The environmental policy was changed largely due to a relentless grassroots campaign.
examples.zh: 这项环保政策之所以得以改变，很大程度上得益于一场坚持不懈的民间基层运动。

lemmas.usage_note: 修饰由底层民众自发发起、非官方推动的行动、组织或支持，常见搭配如 grassroots campaign、grassroots movement。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 grassroots 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 民俗学, 民间风俗, 民间传说
lemmas.def_en: the unwritten lore (stories and proverbs and riddles and songs) of a culture

examples.en: According to local folklore, the ancient ruins are protected by a slumbering dragon.
examples.zh: 根据当地的民间传说，这处古老遗迹受到一条沉睡巨龙的庇护。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，常用于文化、人类学语境，常见搭配有 local folklore、Irish folklore 等。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 folklore 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 舞蹈艺术, 舞台舞蹈
lemmas.def_en: a show involving artistic dancing

examples.en: The musical received critical acclaim for its intricate choreography and vibrant score.
examples.zh: 这部音乐剧因其复杂的编舞和充满活力的配乐而广受好评。

lemmas.usage_note: 作名词表示编舞艺术或具体舞蹈动作设计，常与 intricate、dynamic 等形容词搭配使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 choreography 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 伊斯兰教教法
lemmas.def_en: the code of law derived from the Koran and from the teachings and example of Mohammed

examples.en: Certain commercial contracts in the region are structured to comply with Sharia.
examples.zh: 该地区的某些商业合同在架构设计上遵循了伊斯兰教教法。

lemmas.usage_note: 专有名词性概念，常作不可数名词，常见搭配为 Sharia law 或 under Sharia。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sharia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 裂缝, 中断, 空隙, 间隙, 裂孔, (稿件)脱字, 漏句
lemmas.def_en: an interruption in the intensity or amount of something

examples.en: After a three-year hiatus, the rock band returned to the stage with a brand new album.
examples.zh: 在暂别乐坛三年之后，这支摇滚乐队携全新专辑重返舞台。

lemmas.usage_note: 多指工作、演出或进程的暂时中断或间歇，高频搭配有 go on a hiatus、brief hiatus。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hiatus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 类似的, 准的
lemmas.def_en: having some resemblance

examples.en: The committee acts as a quasi-judicial body with the power to investigate regulatory breaches.
examples.zh: 该委员会作为一个准司法机构运作，有权调查违规行为。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词常作前置定语，表示半...的或准...的，常通过连字符连接名词构成复合词，具正式语体色彩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 quasi 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 助产士, 接生婆
lemmas.def_en: a woman skilled in aiding the delivery of babies

examples.en: The experienced midwife remained calm and guided the mother through a smooth natural delivery.
examples.zh: 那位经验丰富的助产士十分镇定，引导产妇顺利完成了自然分娩。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指受过专业培训的助产士，常与 certified、hospital midwife 连用，语体正式中立。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 midwife 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 值得注目的, 显著的
lemmas.def_en: worthy of notice

examples.en: One noteworthy aspect of the report is the sudden surge in renewable energy investment.
examples.zh: 该报告中一个值得关注的方面是可再生能源投资的突然激增。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词常作定语或表语，意为值得注意的，常搭配 feature、achievement、fact 等词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 noteworthy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 女高音, 最高音部, 女高音歌手
lemmas.def_en: a female singer

examples.en: The talented soprano captivated the entire auditorium with her effortless high notes.
examples.zh: 那位才华横溢的女高音歌手以毫不费力的高音征服了全场观众。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，既可指女高音歌手，也可指女高音声部，复数形式常写作 sopranos。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 soprano 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 大麦
lemmas.def_en: a grain of barley

examples.en: Farmers in this valley cultivate high-grade barley primarily for the craft brewing industry.
examples.zh: 这个山谷里的农民主要为精酿啤酒行业种植优质大麦。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，专指谷物大麦，常用于农业、酿酒及饮食搭配，如 pearl barley、grow barley。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 barley 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可怕地, 非常地
lemmas.def_en: of a dreadful kind

examples.en: Their ambitious rescue plan went horribly wrong when unexpected storms rolled in.
examples.zh: 当突如其来的暴风雨席卷而来时，他们雄心勃勃的救援计划彻底搞砸了。

lemmas.usage_note: 副词修饰动词或形容词，可表示可怕地，也可口语化地表达程度极其严重，如 horribly wrong。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 horribly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 马力
lemmas.def_en: a unit of power equal to 746 watts

examples.en: The sports car's turbocharged engine delivers over 400 horsepower.
examples.zh: 这辆跑车的涡轮增压发动机可输出超过400马力的功率。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作不可数名词，缩写为 hp，用于度量发动机功率；高频搭配如 develop/produce horsepower。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 horsepower 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 加拿大白鲑
lemmas.def_en: cold-water fish caught in Lake Superior and northward

examples.en: Fishermen netted large schools of cisco in the cold waters of Lake Superior.
examples.zh: 渔民们在苏必利尔湖冰冷的水域中捕获了大量加拿大白鲑。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词（复数多为 ciscos 或同形），指北美淡水白鲑，常见于水产、渔业或生态学语境中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cisco 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 讨伐异教徒, 拥护运动
lemmas.def_en: a holy war waged by Muslims against infidels

examples.en: The environmental group launched a nationwide jihad against corporate pollution.
examples.zh: 该环保组织发起了一场针对企业污染的全民抵制运动。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常作可数或不可数名词，原指伊斯兰圣战，引申为对抗某种社会弊端或推动某项事业的狂热斗争运动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jihad 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 海上的, 航海的, 船员的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or involving ships or shipping or navigation or seamen

examples.en: The navigator carefully plotted our course on the nautical chart.
examples.zh: 领航员在海图上仔细绘制了我们的航行路线。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作定语修饰航海、船只或海员相关的名词，核心搭配如 nautical mile（海里）、nautical charts（海图）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nautical 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 动物学, 动物区系
lemmas.def_en: all the animal life in a particular region or period

examples.en: After graduating with a degree in zoology, she joined a wildlife conservation project.
examples.zh: 动物学专业毕业后，她加入了一个野生动物保护项目。

lemmas.usage_note: 作不可数名词，指生物学分支动物学，也可指特定区域的动物群系；常与 degree in zoology、study 等搭配。

lemmas.def_zh: 动物学家
lemmas.def_en: a specialist in the branch of biology dealing with animals

lemmas.def_zh: 动物学的
lemmas.def_en: concerning the study of animals and their classification and properties

examples.en: zoological research

family_guide.root_logic: 以 zoology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 年鉴
lemmas.def_en: a book published annually by the graduating class of a high school or college usually containing photographs of faculty and graduating students

examples.en: The students spent weeks signing each other's high school yearbooks before graduation.
examples.zh: 毕业前，学生们花了几周时间在彼此的高中毕业纪念册上签名留念。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指按年出版的资料年鉴，或学校毕业时分发的毕业纪念册；常与 school yearbook 搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 yearbook 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 再注满, 替换物
lemmas.def_en: a prescription drug that is provided again

examples.en: The waitress offered me a free refill on my iced tea.
examples.zh: 服务员为我的冰红茶提供了免费续杯。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，重音在首音节，常指笔芯、替换装或续杯饮料；常见搭配如 a pen refill、ask for a refill。

lemmas.def_zh: 再注满，重新装满；续杯；再配（药）
lemmas.def_en: [T] To fill a container again after it has been emptied, or to replenish a medical prescription.

examples.en: He refilled his water bottle before continuing the mountain hike.
examples.zh: 在继续登山之前，他把水壶重新装满了水。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物或不及物动词，重音在第二音节，表示再度装满或注满容器；常见搭配 refill A with B。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 refill 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 异性的, 异性爱的
