lemmas.def_en: sexually attracted to members of the opposite sex

examples.en: The survey explored attitudes across both heterosexual and homosexual communities.
examples.zh: 这项调查探讨了异性恋与同性恋群体内部的态度差异。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，指异性恋的或涉及男女两性的，书面语与口语中常略作 straight；常修饰 relationship、orientation。

lemmas.def_zh: 异性恋的人
lemmas.def_en: a heterosexual person; someone having a sexual orientation to persons of the opposite sex

examples.en: The study compared the social habits of heterosexuals and homosexuals in urban areas.
examples.zh: 该研究比较了城市地区异性恋者与同性恋者的社交习惯。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指异性恋者，多见于社会学、心理学或统计学等较正式的语境中。

lemmas.def_zh: 异性爱
lemmas.def_en: a sexual attraction to (or sexual relations with) persons of the opposite sex

family_guide.root_logic: 以 heterosexual 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 窃贼
lemmas.def_en: a thief who enters a building with intent to steal

examples.en: The burglar broke in through the kitchen window while the family was asleep.
examples.zh: 趁全家人熟睡时，入室窃贼从厨房窗户潜入了屋内。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，特指破门潜入室内行窃的入室窃贼；常见搭配如 catch a burglar、burglar alarm（防盗警报器）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 burglar 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 颗粒状物, 小子弹, 小药丸
lemmas.def_en: a small sphere

examples.en: The automated feeder dispenses plastic pellets of fish food twice a day.
examples.zh: 自动喂食器每天分发两次颗粒状的鱼饲料。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指压缩成微小硬球状的物体，如药丸、饲料粒、铅弹；常与 food/wood pellets 搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pellet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 滋味, 风味, 美味, 爱好, 食欲, 调味品
lemmas.def_en: vigorous and enthusiastic enjoyment

examples.en: He devoured the freshly baked pie with immense relish.
examples.zh: 他津津有味地吞下了刚烤好的馅饼。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指享受某事的乐趣或开胃的佐料、风味，常搭配 with relish（津津有味地）。

lemmas.def_zh: 尽情享受，品味，玩味；渴望
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To enjoy an experience, prospect, or food with great pleasure and anticipation.

examples.en: She relishes the challenge of managing such a complex project.
examples.zh: 她很享受管理这样一个复杂项目所带来的挑战。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，表示极度喜欢、享受或渴望某事，后接名词或动名词，多用于书面或正式语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 relish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 眼球
lemmas.def_en: the ball-shaped capsule containing the vertebrate eye

examples.en: The optician carefully examined the patient's damaged eyeball.
examples.zh: 验光师仔细检查了患者受损的眼球。

lemmas.usage_note: 解剖学指眼球；现代商业语境中复数常引申指受众注意力或点击率。

lemmas.def_zh: 打量，盯着看；粗略估计
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (informal) to look closely or stare directly at someone or something. 2. [T] to estimate without measuring tools.

examples.en: Instead of using a scale, the chef just eyeballed the flour.
examples.zh: 厨师没有用秤，只是目测估算了一下面粉的分量。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式及物动词，意为盯着看、审视或目测估计，常用于口语及美式英语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 eyeball 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 前灯, 桅灯
lemmas.def_en: a powerful light with reflector; attached to the front of an automobile or locomotive

examples.en: He flashed his headlights to warn the oncoming traffic of the hazard.
examples.zh: 他闪烁车前大灯以提醒对向车辆注意危险。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常用复数 headlights 指机动车前大灯，常与 turn on、dip 等动词连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 headlight 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 仙人掌
lemmas.def_en: any succulent plant of the family Cactaceae native chiefly to arid regions of the New World and usually having spines

examples.en: This particular species of cactus can survive for months without rain.
examples.zh: 这种仙人掌可以在无雨的情况下存活数月。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指仙人掌，复数形式可为 cactuses 或更正式的 cacti。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cactus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 粗毛, 蓬乱一团
lemmas.def_en: a strong coarse tobacco that has been shredded

examples.en: She decided to get a retro shag cut at the salon.
examples.zh: 她决定在发廊剪一个复古的蓬松碎发造型。

lemmas.usage_note: 可指粗毛、蓬乱发型或长毛绒地毯，常用于搭配 shag carpet 或 shag haircut。

lemmas.def_zh: 毛发蓬乱的, 粗浓的, 草木丛生的
lemmas.def_en: used of hair; thick and poorly groomed

examples.en: bushy locks
a shaggy beard

lemmas.def_zh: 与……性交，交配
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (British taboo slang) To have sexual intercourse with someone. 2. [T] (baseball) To chase and catch fly balls during practice.

examples.en: The strong sea breeze shagged his thick hair within minutes.
examples.zh: 猛烈的海风几分钟就把他浓密的头发吹得杂乱蓬松。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示使毛发变蓬松杂乱；在棒球术语中表示捡球（shag flies），在英式俚语中含义敏感需慎用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shag 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 验尸官
lemmas.def_en: a public official who investigates by inquest any death not due to natural causes

examples.en: The coroner ruled that the victim died of accidental drowning.
examples.zh: 验尸官裁定受害者死于意外溺水。

lemmas.usage_note: 官方司法或行政用词，指负责调查非正常死亡原因的验尸官、法医官。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 coroner 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 奴才, 宠臣
lemmas.def_en: a servile or fawning dependant

examples.en: The dictator sent his minions to suppress the peaceful protest.
examples.zh: 独裁者派出他的爪牙去镇压和平抗议。

lemmas.usage_note: 带轻蔑贬义，指唯命是从的仆从、爪牙或走卒，常与 powerful figure 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 minion 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 雪片, 雪花, 雪片莲
lemmas.def_en: a crystal of snow

examples.en: Every delicate snowflake melted instantly as it touched the warm ground.
examples.zh: 每一片精致的雪花一落到温暖的地面就瞬间融化了。

lemmas.usage_note: 本义为雪花；现代俚语中常作贬义词，指玻璃心、经不起批评且自命不凡的人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 snowflake 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 恋童癖者
lemmas.def_en: an adult who is sexually attracted to children

examples.en: The convicted pedophile was sentenced to life imprisonment without parole.
examples.zh: 被定罪的恋童癖者被判处终身监禁且不得假释。

lemmas.usage_note: 法律与医学用词，指恋童癖患者或犯有侵害儿童罪行的罪犯，拼写亦作 paedophile。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pedophile 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 欢喜的, 高兴的, 令人高兴的
lemmas.def_en: full of or producing joy

examples.en: The birth of their first child was a joyful occasion for the whole family.
examples.zh: 第一个孩子的降生对全家人来说是一件充满喜悦的大事。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容人心情极度喜悦或事物充满欢乐，语体较为正式高雅，常修饰 occasion、news 等。

lemmas.def_zh: 高兴地, 喜悦地
lemmas.def_en: in a joyous and gleeful manner

examples.en: the old man had greeted her gleefully

lemmas.def_zh: 欢喜;高兴;快乐
lemmas.def_en: the emotion of great happiness

family_guide.root_logic: 以 joyful 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 出庭律师, 律师
lemmas.def_en: a British or Canadian lawyer who speaks in the higher courts of law on behalf of either the defense or prosecution

examples.en: The defense barrister argued persuasively that there was insufficient evidence to convict his client.
examples.zh: 辩方出庭律师极具说服力地辩称，现有证据不足以给他的当事人定罪。

lemmas.usage_note: 英式英语法律专门词汇，特指有资格在高等法院出庭辩护的律师，常与solicitor（事务律师）相对。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 barrister 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 扼杀，压制；（使）窒息，（使）喘不上气
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. [T] To prevent something from happening, continuing, or developing; to suppress feelings or reactions. 2. [I, T] To be unable to breathe freely, or prevent someone from breathing.

examples.en: She tried hard to stifle a yawn during the monotonous three-hour board meeting.
examples.zh: 在长达三小时枯燥乏味的董事会上，她极力忍住不打哈欠。

lemmas.usage_note: 可作及物或不及物动词，常与yawn、laughter、creativity或dissent连用，表示抑制、扼杀或使窒息。

lemmas.def_zh: 窒息物, 绞索
lemmas.def_en: a person who stifles or smothers or suppresses

examples.en: he is a real conversation stifler
I see from all the yawn smotherers that it is time to stop

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stifle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 肿胀病人
lemmas.def_en: swelling of the rumen or intestinal tract of domestic animals caused by excessive gas

examples.en: The veterinary surgeon was called immediately to treat severe bloat in the prize dairy cow.
examples.zh: 兽医立刻被召来为那头优质奶牛治疗严重的腹胀病。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，通常指反刍动物或人体的腹胀病症，在计算领域也可引申指软件臃肿膨胀的现象。

lemmas.def_zh: （使）膨胀，（使）肿胀；使自大
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To swell or puff up with fluid, gas, or food, or cause to do so.

examples.en: Excessive sodium intake can cause the body to retain water and bloat the abdomen.
examples.zh: 摄入过量钠盐会导致身体水分滞留并使腹部发胀。

lemmas.usage_note: 可作及物或不及物动词，多用于被动语态或形容词化，常接stomach、budget或workforce表示膨胀、浮肿或过度扩充。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bloat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 雄蕊, 雄性花蕊
lemmas.def_en: the male reproductive organ of a flower

examples.en: Under the microscope, pollen grains could be clearly seen clinging to the tip of each stamen.
examples.zh: 在显微镜下，可以清楚地看到花粉粒附着在每个雄蕊的顶端。

lemmas.usage_note: 植物学专业名词，指花朵的雄蕊，通常由花丝（filament）与花药（anther）组成，常用于学术描写。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stamen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 再次选出，使连任
lemmas.def_en: [T] To vote someone back into the same public office for another term.

examples.en: Voters overwhelmingly decided to reelect her as mayor for a second consecutive term.
examples.zh: 选民以压倒性优势决定再次选举她连任第二任市长。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，用于政治与选举语境，常用结构为reelect sb. as/to或被动语态be reelected，表示再次当选。

lemmas.def_zh: 再选, 改选
lemmas.def_en: election again

examples.en: he did not run for reelection

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reelect 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 论文, 专著
lemmas.def_en: a formal exposition

examples.en: The philosopher published a seminal treatise on human understanding that influenced generations.
examples.zh: 这位哲学家发表了一部关于人类理解力的开创性专著，影响了数代人。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面正式用语，指系统全面阐述某一专题的学术专著或长篇论文，常与on/upon搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 treatise 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 小妖精
lemmas.def_en: (folklore) a small grotesque supernatural creature that makes trouble for human beings

examples.en: In folklore, the mischievous goblin was blamed whenever milk turned sour overnight.
examples.zh: 在民间传说中，每当牛奶一夜之间变酸，人们就会归咎于淘气的小妖精。

lemmas.usage_note: 民间传说与奇幻文学常见名词，指丑陋、矮小且通常怀有恶意的妖怪或地精，多用于虚构描写。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 goblin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 腱
lemmas.def_en: a cord or band of inelastic tissue connecting a muscle with its bony attachment

examples.en: The sprinter was forced to withdraw from the competition after tearing an ankle tendon.
examples.zh: 该短跑选手在撕裂踝部肌腱后被迫退出了比赛。

lemmas.usage_note: 解剖与医学用词，指连接肌肉与骨骼的肌腱，常见搭配如Achilles tendon（跟腱）及tear/rupture a tendon。

lemmas.def_zh: 腱的
lemmas.def_en: consisting of tendons or resembling a tendon

examples.en: The athlete suffered a painful tendinous injury during the final sprint of the race.
examples.zh: 这名运动员在比赛的最后冲刺阶段遭遇了痛苦的肌腱损伤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tendon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 枪乌贼, 鱿鱼, 反潜水雷发射装置
lemmas.def_en: (Italian cuisine) squid prepared as food

examples.en: The restaurant is famous for serving grilled squid seasoned with garlic and lemon juice.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅以供应佐以大蒜和柠檬汁的烤鱿鱼而闻名。

lemmas.usage_note: 生物与烹饪常用词，指海洋软体动物枪乌贼或食材鱿鱼；作食物时通常不可数，作个体时复数可用squid或squids。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 squid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 突然一阵, 趣味, 爱好
lemmas.def_en: a strong current of air

examples.en: A sudden gust of wind caught the open umbrella and turned it inside out instantly.
examples.zh: 一阵突如其来的狂风吹中撑开的雨伞，瞬间将其吹得翻了过去。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指突发的强阵风，固定搭配如a gust of wind，也可隐喻突发的情感爆发如gusts of laughter。

lemmas.def_zh: 刮风的, 阵阵猛急的, 突发的, 津津有味的
lemmas.def_en: blowing in puffs or short intermittent blasts

examples.en: puffy off-shore winds
gusty winds

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gust 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （利益、利息等）自然增加，逐渐累积；生息
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (+ to/from) (finance / formal) To accumulate or increase gradually over a period of time, especially of interest, benefits, or debts.

examples.en: Interest will accrue on the account at a rate of four percent per year.
examples.zh: 该账户的利息将按年利率百分之四逐日累计。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作不及物动词，后接介词 to（归于）或 from（源于），多用于利息、收益或权利的自然累积。

lemmas.def_zh: 自然增长, 自然增长额
lemmas.def_en: the act of accumulating

family_guide.root_logic: 以 accrue 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不完美的, 不完整的, 减弱的, 未完成过去时的
lemmas.def_en: not perfect; defective or inadequate

examples.en: We live in an imperfect world where compromises are sometimes necessary.
examples.zh: 我们生活在一个并不完美的世界里，有时妥协是必要的。

lemmas.usage_note: 用于修饰人、事物或系统存在瑕疵；在语法中作定语，专指“未完成过去时的”体貌。

lemmas.def_zh: 不完全地, 有缺点地, 不完备地
lemmas.def_en: in an imperfect or faulty way; ; - Jane Austen

examples.en: The lobe was imperfectly developed
Miss Bennet would not play at all amiss if she practiced more

family_guide.root_logic: 以 imperfect 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 盐湖, 盐田, 碱盐泻药, 生理盐水
lemmas.def_en: an isotonic solution of sodium chloride and distilled water

examples.en: The nurse cleaned the patient's wound thoroughly with sterile saline.
examples.zh: 护士用无菌生理盐水彻底清洗了患者的伤口。

lemmas.usage_note: 多指医疗用的“生理盐水”，常用作不可数名词，常见搭配有 normal saline 或 saline drip。

lemmas.def_zh: 盐性, 盐度
lemmas.def_en: the taste experience when common salt is taken into the mouth

family_guide.root_logic: 以 saline 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 斗败了的狗, 失败者, 受害者
lemmas.def_en: one at a disadvantage and expected to lose

examples.en: Against all expectations, the underdog defeated the reigning champion.
examples.zh: 出乎所有人的意料，处于劣势的一方击败了卫冕冠军。

lemmas.usage_note: 指比赛、竞争中处于劣势的一方，常用搭配为 root for the underdog（支持弱者）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 underdog 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 古怪的人, 奇怪的人
lemmas.def_en: someone unpleasantly strange or eccentric

examples.en: Ignore that weirdo yelling at traffic on the street corner.
examples.zh: 别理街角那个对着过往车辆大喊大叫的怪人。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式口语表达，带轻微贬义或戏谑色彩，指行为怪异、举止反常的人；复数形式加 -s。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 weirdo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 肉欲的, 感觉的, 感觉论的
lemmas.def_en: marked by the appetites and passions of the body

examples.en: She danced with a slow, sensual grace that captivated the audience.
examples.zh: 她伴着缓慢而性感动人的风姿起舞，吸引了全场观众。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰声音、外表或感官体验，强调身体或肉体感受的美感与诱惑，注意与 sensuous 区分。

lemmas.def_zh: 耽于声色, 淫荡, 好色
lemmas.def_en: desire for sensual pleasures

lemmas.def_zh: 耽于声色地; 好色地; 淫荡地; 官能地
lemmas.def_en: in a sultry and sensual manner

examples.en: the belly dancer mover sensually among the tables

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sensual 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (水、电、煤)断供, 储运损耗
lemmas.def_en: the amount of something (as whiskey or oil) lost in storage or transportation

examples.en: A sudden power outage plunged the entire neighborhood into darkness.
examples.zh: 突如其来的停电使整个街区陷入了一片黑暗。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指电力、网络或水源的中断期，高频搭配包括 power outage（断电）等。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 outage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 花圈, 花环, 圈状物
lemmas.def_en: flower arrangement consisting of a circular band of foliage or flowers for ornamental purposes

examples.en: The president laid a wreath at the memorial to honor the fallen soldiers.
examples.zh: 总统在纪念碑前敬献了花圈，以悼念阵亡的将士。

lemmas.usage_note: 指环状花饰，常用于节庆装饰（如门环）或悼念仪式，常用搭配为 lay a wreath（敬献花圈）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wreath 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 用梭结花边，梭织花边
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To make delicate lace or ornamental edging by knotting thread with a small shuttle.

examples.en: My grandmother taught me how to tat delicate lace collars by hand.
examples.zh: 我祖母教我如何用手工梭编精致的蕾丝衣领。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物或不及物动词，专指用梭子编结蕾丝或饰边等手工艺，常用于传统手工艺语境中。

lemmas.def_zh: 穿破的, 粗糙的, 不值钱的
lemmas.def_en: showing signs of wear and tear

examples.en: a ratty old overcoat
shabby furniture

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 政治家
lemmas.def_en: a man who is a respected leader in national or international affairs

examples.en: He earned a reputation as a wise statesman during the peace negotiations.
examples.zh: 在和平谈判期间，他赢得了睿智政治家的美誉。

lemmas.usage_note: 褒义词，指富有远见、受人尊敬的资深政治领袖，常与 elder statesman 连用。

lemmas.def_zh: 治国之才, 政治家的才能, 政治家风度
lemmas.def_en: wisdom in the management of public affairs

family_guide.root_logic: 以 statesman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不能征服的, 无敌的
lemmas.def_en: incapable of being overcome or subdued

examples.en: Years of rigorous training made the champion feel completely invincible in the ring.
examples.zh: 多年的严格训练让这位冠军在拳击台上感到自己是不可战胜的。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰军队、意志或优势，搭配'feel/seem invincible'，强调不可战胜或不可动摇的力量。

lemmas.def_zh: 无敌, 绝对不败
lemmas.def_en: the property being difficult or impossible to defeat

family_guide.root_logic: 以 invincible 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 饮剂, 饮料, 一次饮用量, 一服, 一剂
lemmas.def_en: a medicinal or magical or poisonous beverage

examples.en: The wicked witch brewed a lethal potion from rare woodland herbs.
examples.zh: 那个邪恶的女巫用稀有的森林草药熬制了一种致命的药剂。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于奇幻或幽默语境，多指具魔力或剧毒的药水，常见搭配如'magic potion'或'sleeping potion'。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 potion 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 路旁, 路边
lemmas.def_en: edge of a way or road or path

examples.en: We pulled over to the roadside to check the punctured tire.
examples.zh: 我们把车靠在路边停下，检查被扎破的轮胎。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指公路或小道两侧的狭长区域，常与介词'by/on the roadside'或作定语修饰'attraction/assistance'。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 roadside 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 狡猾的, 巧妙的, 可爱的
lemmas.def_en: attractive especially by means of smallness or prettiness or quaintness

examples.en: The cunning fox slipped through the narrow fence before the hounds could react.
examples.zh: 那只狡猾的狐狸在猎犬反应过来之前就从狭窄的栅栏间溜走了。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指人或计策狡黠精明，常修饰'plan/opponent'，含贬义或赞叹其机敏；美语中偶指灵巧小巧。

lemmas.def_zh: 巧妙地, 狡猾地
lemmas.def_en: in an attractive manner

examples.en: how cunningly the olive-green dress with its underskirt of rose-brocade fitted her perfect figure

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cunning 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 地球的, 陆生的, 陆地的, 人间的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or inhabiting the land as opposed to the sea or air

examples.en: Scientists study the adaptation of terrestrial animals to extreme desert climates.
examples.zh: 科学家们研究陆生动物对极端沙漠气候的适应能力。

lemmas.usage_note: 学术与正式语境常用，指陆栖的或地球相关的，常搭配'terrestrial species/ecosystem/broadcasting'。

lemmas.def_zh: terrestrial（地球的, 陆地的）的变形
lemmas.def_en: in a worldly manner

examples.en: terrestrially changeable

family_guide.root_logic: 以 terrestrial 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 超级强权, 超级大国
lemmas.def_en: a state powerful enough to influence events throughout the world

examples.en: Tensions escalated rapidly between the two rival superpowers during the prolonged dispute.
examples.zh: 在旷日持久的争端中，这两个相互敌对的超级大国之间的紧张局势迅速升级。

lemmas.usage_note: 政治语境指在国际事务中有极大影响力的超级大国；科幻或流行文化中指超能力。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 superpower 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 浴缸
lemmas.def_en: a relatively large open container that you fill with water and use to wash the body

examples.en: After a stressful day at work, she filled the bathtub with warm, scented water.
examples.zh: 在经历了一整天紧张的工作后，她在浴缸里放满了温热的香氛水。

lemmas.usage_note: 指供人洗澡的固定浴缸，多见于日常家居会话，常见搭配'fill the bathtub'或'soak in the bathtub'。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bathtub 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 铺在……上面，在……上加饰层（或保护层）；在（图像或文本）上覆叠
lemmas.def_en: [T] (+ with) 1. To cover the surface of something with a layer of a different material. 2. To place a digital image, text, or pattern over another.

examples.en: Thick slabs of weathered slate overlay the soft clay beneath the ancient path.
examples.zh: 厚重的风化石板压在古道下方的松软黏土之上。

lemmas.usage_note: 此处为动词overlie的过去式，表示'平躺在……上面'或'重压其上'，需用于过去时态句子中。

lemmas.def_zh: 覆盖，覆在……表面；重叠（overlay的过去式和过去分词）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] Past tense and past participle of overlay: covered the surface of something with a layer or coating.

examples.en: cover the meat with a lot of gravy

family_guide.root_logic: 以 overlay 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 青春期, 春情发动期
lemmas.def_en: the time of life when sex glands become functional

examples.en: Adolescents undergo rapid emotional and physical changes when they reach puberty.
examples.zh: 青少年进入青春期时，心理和生理都会经历巨大的变化。

lemmas.usage_note: 指人生理发育的青春期，常用于心理学、医学及日常健康讨论，常搭配'reach/hit puberty'。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 青春期的
lemmas.def_en: of or related to puberty

family_guide.root_logic: 以 puberty 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 枪眼, 小窗, 换气孔
lemmas.def_en: an ambiguity (especially one in the text of a law or contract) that makes it possible to evade a difficulty or obligation

examples.en: The medieval archer drew his longbow and aimed through a narrow loophole in the stone tower.
examples.zh: 中世纪的弓箭手拉满长弓，透过石塔上狭窄的枪眼向外瞄准。

lemmas.usage_note: 原指城堡或防御墙上的枪眼，现多引申指法律漏洞；本义在建筑或军事历史中作具象名词使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 loophole 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 照料者, 护理者
lemmas.def_en: a person who helps in identifying or preventing or treating illness or disability

examples.en: Being a primary caregiver for an elderly relative can be emotionally demanding.
examples.zh: 作为照顾年迈亲属的主要照料者，在心理上往往承受着巨大的压力。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指照料病患、老人或幼童的护理人员或亲属，多用于医疗照护与社会福利语境，常与 primary 搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 caregiver 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 地狱, 地狱似的地方
lemmas.def_en: any place of pain and turmoil

examples.en: Firefighters battled for hours to contain the blazing inferno that engulfed the warehouse.
examples.zh: 消防员奋战数小时，才控制住吞噬整个仓库的冲天大火。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面语或新闻体中常指无法控制的熊熊大火，亦可比喻混乱恐怖如地狱般的场景，常作单数使用。

lemmas.def_en: an inhabitant of Hell

examples.en: his roar made the infernals quake

lemmas.def_zh: 恶魔似地, 可憎地
lemmas.def_en: extremely

examples.en: infernally clever
hellishly dangerous

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inferno 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 安静的
lemmas.def_en: (of a body of water) free from disturbance by heavy waves

examples.en: The village offers a tranquil retreat away from the noise and bustle of the city.
examples.zh: 这座村庄远离城市的喧嚣与纷扰，是一处宁静的避世之所。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面与文学语境中形容环境宁静安详或心境平和，修饰 scene, waters, atmosphere 等名词。

lemmas.def_zh: 宁静
lemmas.def_en: a disposition free from stress or emotion

lemmas.def_zh: 心神稳定
lemmas.def_en: an untroubled state; free from disturbances

lemmas.def_zh: 安静地, 平静地
lemmas.def_en: without emotional agitation

examples.en: tranquilly she went on with her work

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tranquil 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不毛的, 不孕的, 无菌的, 贫瘠的, 无效的, 枯燥的
lemmas.def_en: incapable of reproducing

examples.en: Surgeons must perform operations in a strictly sterile environment to prevent infection.
examples.zh: 外科医生必须在严格无菌的环境下进行手术，以防感染。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可指医学上的“无菌”，也可引申为无成效的讨论或贫瘠的土地，常修饰 environment, debate 等词。

lemmas.def_zh: 不毛, 不孕, 内容贫乏
lemmas.def_en: (of non-living objects) the state of being free of pathogenic organisms

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sterile 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 辐射学, 放射学
lemmas.def_en: the branch of medical science dealing with the medical use of X-rays or other penetrating radiation

examples.en: He was referred to the radiology department for a comprehensive chest CT scan.
examples.zh: 他被转诊到放射科进行全面的胸部CT扫描。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学专业名词，指利用射线成像进行诊断治疗的放射学，常用搭配为 radiology department。

lemmas.def_zh: 放射学者
lemmas.def_en: a medical specialist who uses radioactive substances and X-rays in the treatment of disease

lemmas.def_zh: 放射学的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to radiology

family_guide.root_logic: 以 radiology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 畜生, 残忍或好色之人
lemmas.def_en: a cruelly rapacious person

examples.en: Anyone who could inflict such harm on a defenseless animal is a heartless brute.
examples.zh: 能对毫无防备的动物造成这种伤害的人，简直是个冷酷无情的畜生。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词指粗暴残忍的人或野兽，带有明显的贬义色彩，口语中亦可幽默地称呼淘气粗鲁的人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 brute 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 用力拉（或举、推、掷）；（沉重地）起伏；喘息，叹气
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. [I, T] To lift, haul, or pull something heavy with great physical effort. 2. [T] To throw or fling something with effort. 3. [I] To rise and fall rhythmically or breathlessly.

examples.en: The workers managed to heave the heavy concrete slab onto the back of the truck.
examples.zh: 工人们合力把沉重的混凝土板吃力地搬上了卡车后厢。

lemmas.usage_note: 常表示吃力地推拉、举起重物，或形容胸膛剧烈起伏、深叹气，常与 sigh, chest 等连用。

lemmas.def_zh: 显现，出现（hove into sight/view，heave的过去式及过去分词）
lemmas.def_en: [I] (nautical / literary) Past tense and past participle of heave; used in 'hove into sight/view' meaning to come into view or appear gradually.

examples.en: After hours in the fog, a distant lighthouse finally hove in sight.
examples.zh: 在大雾中航行数小时后，一座遥远的灯塔终于映入眼帘。

lemmas.usage_note: heave 的古旧/航海用过去式及分词，最常用于固定航海短语 hove in sight（显露）或 hove to（停船）。

lemmas.def_zh: 举物者, 挑夫, 举物装置
lemmas.def_en: a bar used as a lever (as in twisting rope)

family_guide.root_logic: 以 heave 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 调制解调器
lemmas.def_en: (from a combination of MOdulate and DEModulate) electronic equipment consisting of a device used to connect computers by a telephone line

examples.en: Try resetting your modem if you experience a sudden drop in internet connectivity.
examples.zh: 如果网络连接突然中断，请尝试重启你的调制解调器。

lemmas.usage_note: 计算机与通信技术常用名词，指调制解调器，常与 cable, broadband, wireless 搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 modem 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: coming next after the tenth and just before the twelfth in position

examples.en: The agreement was rescued at the eleventh hour after days of deadlock.
examples.zh: 在陷入数天的僵局后，该协议在最后关头得以挽回。

lemmas.usage_note: 序数词作形容词，表示“第十一的”，修饰名词，习语 the eleventh hour 特指“最后关头”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 eleventh 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: coming next after the seventeenth in position

examples.en: Classical music underwent rapid evolution during the eighteenth century in Europe.
examples.zh: 古典音乐在十八世纪的欧洲经历了飞速的发展。

lemmas.usage_note: 序数词作形容词，意为“第十八的”，常用于修饰世纪（century）、楼层或生日等时间概念。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 eighteenth 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 肉汁, 外快
lemmas.def_en: a sauce made by adding stock, flour, or other ingredients to the juice and fat that drips from cooking meats

examples.en: She poured a generous ladle of rich onion gravy over the mashed potatoes.
examples.zh: 她把满满一勺浓郁的洋葱肉汁浇在土豆泥上。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作不可数名词指肉汁，搭配pour gravy；口语中常作名词比喻意外收获或美差，如gravy train。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gravy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 菠菜, 货币, 胡说八道
lemmas.def_en: southwestern Asian plant widely cultivated for its succulent edible dark green leaves

examples.en: The chef tossed fresh baby spinach with olive oil and garlic in a hot pan.
examples.zh: 大厨在热锅中将新鲜的嫩菠菜与橄榄油和大蒜一起翻炒。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用作不可数名词指蔬菜菠菜，常与fresh、baby搭配；在某些俚语中可指纸币或毫无价值的废话。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 spinach 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 协同作业, 协力
lemmas.def_en: cooperative work done by a team (especially when it is effective)

examples.en: Completing the complex engineering project on time required close teamwork.
examples.zh: 按时完成这个复杂的工程项目需要紧密的团队合作。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，强调团队成员间的协调配合，常与foster、require、effective搭配使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 teamwork 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 湖, 海湾
lemmas.def_en: a long narrow inlet of the sea in Scotland (especially when it is nearly landlocked)

examples.en: Early morning mist slowly drifted across the cold, still waters of the loch.
examples.zh: 清晨的薄雾在湖泊冰冷而平静的水面上缓缓飘散。

lemmas.usage_note: 苏格兰英语特有用词，可数名词，专指苏格兰的湖泊或狭长海湾，常与专有名词连用如Loch Ness。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 loch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 蒸馏酒, 龙舌兰酒
lemmas.def_en: Mexican liquor made from fermented juices of an agave plant

examples.en: He ordered a shot of tequila with salt and a slice of lime at the bar.
examples.zh: 他在酒吧点了一杯搭配食盐和青柠片的龙舌兰酒。

lemmas.usage_note: 指产自墨西哥的龙舌兰酒，表示酒液时不可数，表示“一杯酒”时可数，常与shot搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tequila 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无论如何, 至少
lemmas.def_en: used to indicate that a statement explains or supports a previous statement

examples.en: It was raining heavily, but we decided to go hiking anyhow.
examples.zh: 外面下着大雨，但我们无论如何还是决定去徒步。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于口语或非正式文体，作状语表转折、修正语气或结束话题，常置于句首或句末，近义于anyway。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 anyhow 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 军火, 弹药
lemmas.def_en: projectiles to be fired from a gun

examples.en: The soldiers were completely out of food and running low on ammo.
examples.zh: 士兵们的粮食已经彻底耗尽，弹药也所剩无几。

lemmas.usage_note: ammunition的非正式口语缩写，不可数名词，字面指弹药，引申用于辩论中指有力的反驳论据或把柄。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ammo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无法停止的, 不可阻碍的
lemmas.def_en: not capable of being stopped

examples.en: The technological revolution gained an unstoppable momentum across the globe.
examples.zh: 这场科技革命在全球范围内形成了势不可挡的势头。

lemmas.usage_note: 定语或表语形容词，修饰势头、力量或趋势等，表示势不可挡、无法阻挠，常与momentum搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unstoppable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 弹道的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or characteristic of the motion of objects moving under their own momentum and the force of gravity

examples.en: Military experts tracked the trajectory of the experimental ballistic missile.
examples.zh: 军事专家追踪了这枚试验性弹道导弹的飞行轨迹。

lemmas.usage_note: 专业语境作定语修饰弹道或弹道学；非正式习语go ballistic表示极其愤怒、勃然大怒。

lemmas.def_zh: 弹道学, 发射学
lemmas.def_en: the trajectory of an object in free flight

examples.en: Forensic experts used advanced ballistics to match the recovered bullet to the suspect's gun.
examples.zh: 法医专家利用先进的弹道学技术将找到的子弹与嫌疑人的枪支相匹配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ballistic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 麻痹, 停顿, 瘫痪
lemmas.def_en: loss of the ability to move a body part

examples.en: The sudden transit strike caused complete paralysis in the city's transport network.
examples.zh: 突如其来的公交大罢工导致整个城市的交通网络完全陷入瘫痪。

lemmas.usage_note: 可指医学上的瘫痪，也常引申指组织运转或决策停滞，常构成analysis paralysis（过度思考导致的决策瘫痪）。

lemmas.def_zh: 麻痹的, 患麻痹的, 中风的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or of the nature of paralysis

examples.en: The dangerous neurotoxin induced a paralytic state throughout the victim's entire body.
examples.zh: 这种危险的神经毒素在受害者全身引发了麻痹状态。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 paralysis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 尽管
lemmas.def_en: despite anything to the contrary (usually following a concession)

examples.en: Notwithstanding the bad weather, the construction of the bridge proceeded on schedule.
examples.zh: 尽管天气恶劣，大桥的建设工作仍按期进行。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面语，常置于名词前或后表示让步，相当于 in spite of，多用于法律或论述文体。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 notwithstanding 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 正直的, 坦率的; 最前面的, 首要的; 在前面的; 预先的
lemmas.def_en: frank and honest

examples.en: The landlord requires an upfront payment of two months' rent before signing the lease.
examples.zh: 房东要求在签署租赁合同前预付两个月的租金。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于口语与商业语境，既可表示“坦率直接的”，也常作定语表示“预先支付的费用”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 upfront 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可钦佩的, 极好的, 令人惊奇的
lemmas.def_en: deserving of the highest esteem or admiration

examples.en: Her admirable dedication to public service has earned her widespread respect across the community.
examples.zh: 她在公共服务方面的卓越奉献赢得了整个社区的广泛尊敬。

lemmas.usage_note: 褒义形容词，常与 courage, effort 或 quality 连用，多见于书面评价与表彰语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 admirable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 排印(或打字)错误, 印刷工, 排字工
lemmas.def_en: a mistake in printed matter resulting from mechanical failures of some kind

examples.en: I quickly spotted a minor typo in the report before sending it to the client.
examples.zh: 在将报告发给客户之前，我迅速发现了一处微小的打印错误。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式日常名词，指打字或排版中的微小笔误，常与 fix, spot, make a typo 等搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 typo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 自助餐厅
lemmas.def_en: a restaurant where you serve yourself and pay a cashier

examples.en: Most of the employees grab a quick and healthy lunch in the company cafeteria.
examples.zh: 大多数员工在公司食堂吃一顿快捷健康的午餐。

lemmas.usage_note: 常见名词，指学校、医院或公司内自选自取的餐厅，常与 school, hospital 搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cafeteria 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 显著的, 显眼的, 出众的
lemmas.def_en: obvious to the eye or mind

examples.en: His brightly colored jacket made him conspicuous in the somber crowd.
examples.zh: 他色彩鲜艳的夹克让他在神情肃穆的人群中格外显眼。

lemmas.usage_note: 用于形容物体或行为极为显眼，常与 by one's absence 或 consume 构成固定搭配。

lemmas.def_zh: 显著地, 超群地
lemmas.def_en: in a manner tending to attract attention

examples.en: there have been plenty of general declarations about willingness to meet and talk, but conspicuously no mention of time and place

lemmas.def_zh: 显着显眼
lemmas.def_en: the state of being conspicuous

family_guide.root_logic: 以 conspicuous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 推测, 猜想, 揣摩
lemmas.def_en: a hypothesis that has been formed by speculating or conjecturing (usually with little hard evidence)

examples.en: Without any concrete evidence, the theory remains pure conjecture at this point.
examples.zh: 由于没有任何确凿证据，该理论目前纯属推测。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面语，指缺乏确凿根据的揣测，常与 pure, mere 连用，或作 subject to conjecture。

lemmas.def_zh: 推测，猜想，推断
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To form an opinion or conclusion based on incomplete evidence or guesswork.

examples.en: Scientists conjecture that the ancient lake dried up due to prolonged climate change.
examples.zh: 科学家们推测，这座古老的湖泊是因为长期的气候变化而干涸的。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式动词，后接 that 从句或直接宾语，表示根据有限信息进行推断或猜测。

lemmas.def_zh: 推测的, 好推测的
lemmas.def_en: based primarily on surmise rather than adequate evidence

examples.en: theories about the extinction of dinosaurs are still highly conjectural
the supposed reason for his absence

lemmas.def_zh: 推测的
lemmas.def_en: in a manner involving or inclined to conjecture and supposition

family_guide.root_logic: 以 conjecture 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 屋子与花园之间的一片供晴天休息用的石砌空地
lemmas.def_en: usually paved outdoor area adjoining a residence

examples.en: We spent the warm summer evening having a barbecue on the back patio.
examples.zh: 我们在温暖的夏夜里坐在后露台上烧烤。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，指房屋后侧连通花园的石板或铺砖露台，常与 furniture, dining 搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 patio 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 部分的, 部门的, 节的, 截面的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or based upon a section (i.e. as if cut through by an intersecting plane)

examples.en: The committee was urged to prioritize national welfare over narrow sectional interests.
examples.zh: 委员会被敦促将国家福祉置于狭隘的部门利益之上。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式形容词，常与 interests 或 view 连用，多指“部门的、局部的、狭隘的利益”。

lemmas.def_zh: 组合式家具
lemmas.def_en: a piece of furniture made up of sections that can be arranged individually or together

examples.en: They bought a large leather sectional to fit the entire family in the living room.
examples.zh: 他们买了一张大型皮质组合沙发，以便全家人都能在客厅坐下。

lemmas.usage_note: 日常家具词汇，专指由多个模块拼装而成的组合式沙发，口语中广泛使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sectional 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 长期以来梦寐以求的东西
lemmas.def_en: the object of any prolonged endeavor

examples.en: Finding a clean and limitless energy source remains the ultimate grail of modern physics.
examples.zh: 寻找清洁且无限的能源依然是现代物理学界终极追求的圣杯。

lemmas.usage_note: 常大写作 the Holy Grail 或隐喻使用，指行业或科学界梦寐以求、极难攻克的目标。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 grail 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使筋疲力竭（常作 fag out）；苦干，辛劳工作
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (British dated, often fag out) To exhaust someone with hard work, or to tire oneself out. 2. [I] To work hard and tirelessly.

examples.en: He had to fag away at his desk all evening to finish the report.
examples.zh: 他整个晚上都不得不坐在书桌前拼命苦干以完成报告。

lemmas.usage_note: 英式口语，常与away连用表示苦干，或以fag out表示使筋疲力尽，多用于口语或非正式文体。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fag 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 背的, 背部的, 背侧的
lemmas.def_en: belonging to or on or near the back or upper surface of an animal or organ or part

examples.en: The shark sliced through the water, revealing its sharp dorsal fin.
examples.zh: 鲨鱼划破水面，露出了锋利的背鳍。

lemmas.usage_note: 解剖学与生物学专业词汇，常修饰fin、surface或vertebra，用于正式书面或学术语境。

lemmas.def_zh: [医]adv.背侧地
lemmas.def_en: in a dorsal location or direction

lemmas.def_zh: 背, 背状部分, 背部
lemmas.def_en: the posterior part of a human (or animal) body from the neck to the end of the spine

examples.en: The nurse applied a sterile bandage to the dorsum of the patient's hand.
examples.zh: 护士在患者的手背上敷了一块无菌绷带。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dorsal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 粮草, 饲料, 搜寻粮草
lemmas.def_en: bulky food like grass or hay for browsing or grazing horses or cattle

examples.en: The severe drought left the livestock with barely enough forage to survive the winter.
examples.zh: 严重的干旱让牲畜几乎没有足够的草料来度过严冬。

lemmas.usage_note: 作不可数名词指牲畜的草料或饲料，常与crops、shortage搭配，用于农业或生态学语境。

lemmas.def_zh: 搜寻（食物、物资等）；搜寻粮草
lemmas.def_en: [I] (+ for) To search widely across an area for food or wild provisions.

examples.en: Small birds forage for insects among the fallen leaves on the forest floor.
examples.zh: 小鸟在森林地面的落叶堆中觅食昆虫。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与for搭配表示搜寻食物或物资，亦可接介词among/in表示翻找，用于自然描写或日常口语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 forage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （轻蔑或愤怒地）哼鼻子，嗤之以鼻；喷鼻息；（通过鼻子）吸入（毒品）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To force air loudly through your nose to express contempt, anger, or amusement; to say something while doing this. 2. [T] (informal) To inhale a powdered drug through the nose.

examples.en: She snorted with laughter when she heard his ridiculous excuse.
examples.zh: 听到他那荒谬的借口时，她忍不住嗤笑出声。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示用鼻子哼气或轻蔑作声，常接with laughter/derision，或接宾语引语，用于文学或叙事语境。

lemmas.def_zh: 鼻息粗的人, 表示轻蔑的人, 表示愤怒的人, 令人咋舌的人, 大风
lemmas.def_en: someone who expresses contempt or indignation by uttering a snorting sound

family_guide.root_logic: 以 snort 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 煨，文火慢炖；即将爆发，按捺（怒火）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (cooking) To cook food gently in liquid just below boiling point. 2. [I] To be in a state of suppressed anger, excitement, or tension.

examples.en: Lower the heat and let the soup simmer gently for thirty minutes.
examples.zh: 调低火候，让汤用文火慢炖三十分钟。

lemmas.usage_note: 烹饪时指文火慢炖，引申指愤怒或冲突酝酿即将爆发，常与with anger或simmer down连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 simmer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 再次出现，重现
lemmas.def_en: [I] To appear or become visible again after being absent or hidden for a time.

examples.en: The sun briefly disappeared behind the clouds, only to reappear brighter than before.
examples.zh: 太阳短暂隐入云层之后，再次显现时比之前更加明亮。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，表示消失后再次显现或问题复发，常与after、in连用，适用于各类书面与口语语境。

lemmas.def_zh: 再现
lemmas.def_en: the event of something appearing again

examples.en: the reappearance of Halley's comet

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reappear 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 自然而然的, 无意识的, 不知不觉的, 偶然的, 不随意的
lemmas.def_en: not subject to the control of the will; ; ; ; - John F.Kennedy

examples.en: An involuntary shudder ran through his body as the cold wind blew past.
examples.zh: 当寒风吹过时，他身体不由自主地打了个寒战。

lemmas.usage_note: 指非自愿的或身体不受控的本能反应，常修饰reflex、shudder、manslaughter，语体较正式。

lemmas.def_zh: 不知不觉地, 无意识地
lemmas.def_en: against your will

examples.en: he was involuntarily held against his will

family_guide.root_logic: 以 involuntary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 溃疡, 腐烂物
lemmas.def_en: a circumscribed inflammatory and often suppurating lesion on the skin or an internal mucous surface resulting in necrosis of tissue

examples.en: Chronic stress and poor diet contributed to the development of his stomach ulcer.
examples.zh: 长期的压力和不良饮食导致了他胃溃疡的形成。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学名词，指溃疡，常与stomach、peptic、mouth搭配，用于健康医疗咨询或病理描述。

lemmas.def_zh: 溃疡
lemmas.def_en: a circumscribed inflammatory and often suppurating lesion on the skin or an internal mucous surface resulting in necrosis of tissue

lemmas.def_zh: (使)形成溃疡, (使)溃烂, (使)腐败
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or characterized by ulceration

examples.en: ulcerative colitis

lemmas.def_zh: 溃疡性的, 患溃疡的
lemmas.def_en: having an ulcer or canker

lemmas.def_zh: （使）溃烂，（使）形成溃疡
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] (of skin or tissue) To develop an ulcer, or cause an ulcer to develop.

examples.en: Her stomach ulcerated

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ulcer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 丙烯酸的
lemmas.def_en: polymerized from acrylonitrile

examples.en: The artist preferred working with acrylics because they dry much faster than oils.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家更喜欢用丙烯颜料作画，因为它们比油画颜料干得快得多。

lemmas.usage_note: 作名词常指丙烯酸纤维或丙烯酸颜料（常用复数acrylics），主要用于艺术、纺织及化工语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 acrylic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 外卖食品的餐馆, 外卖食品的商店
lemmas.def_en: prepared food that is intended to be eaten off of the premises

examples.en: We were too tired to cook, so we decided to get an Indian takeaway.
examples.zh: 我们太累了不想做饭，于是决定点一份印度外卖。

lemmas.usage_note: 英式英语中指外卖餐馆或外带食品，可作可数名词，常与order、Chinese takeaway搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 takeaway 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 蓄意破坏者
lemmas.def_en: someone who willfully destroys or defaces property

examples.en: Police are searching for the vandals who sprayed graffiti all over the historic church.
examples.zh: 警方正在搜捕那些在历史悠久的教堂上到处喷涂鸦的破坏公物者。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指蓄意破坏公物或艺术品的人，多含贬义；常见搭配有 mindless vandals 或 acts by vandals。

lemmas.def_zh: 肆意破坏，蓄意毁坏（公私财物）
lemmas.def_en: [T] To deliberately destroy or damage public or private property.

examples.en: vandalize the park

lemmas.def_zh: 肆意破坏，蓄意毁坏（公私财物，vandalize 的英式拼写）
lemmas.def_en: [T] (chiefly British English) To deliberately destroy or damage public or private property.

examples.en: vandalize the park

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vandal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 任性的, 故意的, 有意的
lemmas.def_en: done by design

examples.en: The company was fined heavily for its willful violation of safety regulations.
examples.zh: 该企业因故意违反安全法规而被处以巨额罚款。

lemmas.usage_note: 可指固执任性的，也可在法律或正式语境中指故意的；常修饰 neglect、damage 或 disobedience。

lemmas.def_zh: 故意地；任性固执地
lemmas.def_en: in a willful manner

examples.en: she had willfully deceived me

lemmas.def_zh: 任性；故意
lemmas.def_en: the trait of being prone to disobedience and lack of discipline

family_guide.root_logic: 以 willful 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 高视阔步, 支柱, 压杆
lemmas.def_en: a proud stiff pompous gait

examples.en: He walked into the boardroom with a confident strut that annoyed his rivals.
examples.zh: 他迈着自信而趾高气扬的步伐走进会议室，这让他的对手们颇为恼火。

lemmas.usage_note: 可表示趾高气扬的步态，工程中指承受压力的支撑杆；常作单数指步态，或以复数指建筑构件。

lemmas.def_zh: 昂首阔步，趾高气扬地走；支撑
lemmas.def_en: [I] (+ around/about) To walk proudly and stiffly with your chest out, trying to look important.

examples.en: The models strutted down the runway showcasing the designer's latest autumn collection.
examples.zh: 模特们在T台上大步走秀，展示设计师最新的秋季系列。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用作不及物动词，表示昂首阔步以炫耀自己，常与 along, around 或 down 连用，多含讽刺意味。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 strut 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [生态]雨林
lemmas.def_en: a forest with heavy annual rainfall

examples.en: Deforestation continues to threaten the unique biodiversity of the tropical rainforest.
examples.zh: 滥伐森林继续威胁着热带雨林独特的生物多样性。

lemmas.usage_note: 指热带或温带雨林，常与 tropical、Amazon 搭配，多出现于环保、地理及科普类说明文体。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rainforest 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 清除, 暴利
lemmas.def_en: a very large profit

examples.en: Volunteers organized a massive cleanup along the coast after the oil spill.
examples.zh: 漏油事故发生后，志愿者们沿海岸组织了一次大规模的清理行动。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指环境污染清理或机构整顿行动；高频搭配包括 environmental cleanup 与 cleanup operation。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cleanup 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 反应过度，反作用过强
lemmas.def_en: [I] To react more strongly, angrily, or emotionally than a situation justifies.

examples.en: Try to stay calm and not overreact to every negative comment online.
examples.zh: 尽量保持冷静，不要对网上的每一条负面评论都反应过度。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，表示反应过激，常与介词 to 搭配构成 overreact to sth，多用于口语与新闻评论。

lemmas.def_zh: [经] 反应过度
lemmas.def_en: an excessive reaction; a reaction with inappropriate emotional behavior

family_guide.root_logic: 以 overreact 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 科林斯的, 古希腊科林斯式的, 科林斯人的
lemmas.def_en: or pertaining to the Corinthian style of architecture

examples.en: The museum entrance is framed by towering Corinthian columns adorned with acanthus leaves.
examples.zh: 博物馆入口由饰有爵床叶图案的高耸科林斯式立柱环绕。

lemmas.usage_note: 常大写首字母，特指古希腊科林斯式建筑风格（以卷叶柱头为特征），也形容奢华典雅的风格。

lemmas.def_zh: 科林斯人, 花花公子, 业余运动家
lemmas.def_en: a man devoted to the pursuit of pleasure

examples.en: In 19th-century England, a true Corinthian was expected to excel at both rowing and boxing.
examples.zh: 在19世纪的英国，一个真正的业余运动名流被期望在赛艇和拳击上都表现出色。

lemmas.usage_note: 可指古希腊科林斯城邦居民，引申指热爱运动的富家子弟或业余运动家，现多见于历史与文学语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 corinthian 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 黑色半身侧面影, 影子, 轮廓, 剪影
lemmas.def_en: an outline of a solid object (as cast by its shadow)

examples.en: The mountain's sharp silhouette was clearly visible against the orange sunset sky.
examples.zh: 在橙色晚霞的映衬下，山峰清晰的轮廓分明可见。

lemmas.usage_note: 指剪影或明亮背景前映出的暗色轮廓；高频搭配为 in silhouette 或 cast a silhouette。

lemmas.def_zh: 使显出剪影（或轮廓）
lemmas.def_en: [T] (usually passive) To cast someone or something as a dark shape against a lighter background.

examples.en: The lonely oak tree was silhouetted against the rising full moon.
examples.zh: 那棵孤独的橡树在升起的满月映衬下显出了黑色剪影。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常用于被动语态，表示使呈现暗色轮廓，常见搭配为 be silhouetted against。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 silhouette 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 早午餐
lemmas.def_en: combination breakfast and lunch; usually served in late morning

examples.en: We usually meet our friends for Sunday brunch at a cafe near the park.
examples.zh: 我们通常周日会和朋友在公园附近的一家咖啡馆吃早午餐。

lemmas.usage_note: 合成词，指早午餐，常见搭配包括 have brunch、brunch spot，极具现代休闲生活语体色彩。

lemmas.def_zh: 吃早午餐
lemmas.def_en: [I] To eat brunch, a meal eaten late in the morning as a combination of breakfast and lunch.

examples.en: They brunched leisurely on eggs Benedict and mimosas all morning.
examples.zh: 他们整个上午都在悠闲地享用班尼迪克蛋和含羞草鸡尾酒早午餐。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式不及物动词，表示吃早午餐，常与 on 或 with 连用，多用于日常口语闲聊情境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 brunch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 管闲事，干涉，干预；瞎弄，擅自乱动
lemmas.def_en: [I] (disapproving) to interfere in something that is not your concern, or touch things without permission.

examples.en: I wish my neighbors would stop meddling in my private family affairs.
examples.zh: 我希望我的邻居们不要再插手干涉我的私人家庭事务了。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，含贬义，指多管闲事或擅动他人之物；固定搭配为 meddle in 或 meddle with。

lemmas.def_zh: 爱管闲事的人, 干涉者
lemmas.def_en: an officious annoying person who interferes with others

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 爱管闲事的；瞎插手的
lemmas.def_en: intrusive in a meddling, interfering, or offensive manner
lemmas.usage_note: 多含贬义，常用于形容亲戚、官僚或邻居等，如 meddling relatives / meddling busybody。

examples.en: He blamed his meddling mother-in-law for interfering in their marriage.
examples.zh: 他抱怨爱管闲事的岳母插手他们的婚姻。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 meddle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 温顺的, 逆来顺受的
lemmas.def_en: humble in spirit or manner; suggesting retiring mildness or even cowed submissiveness

examples.en: Instead of arguing back, he offered a meek apology and looked down at the floor.
examples.zh: 他没有反驳，而是温顺地道了歉，低头看着地板。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰人的性格或神态，含缺乏主见或屈从之意；常用搭配如 meek manner、meek and mild。

lemmas.def_zh: 温顺地, 柔和地, 忠厚地
lemmas.def_en: in a submissive or spiritless manner

examples.en: meekly bowed to his wishes

lemmas.def_zh: 温顺, 柔和
lemmas.def_en: the feeling of patient, submissive humbleness

family_guide.root_logic: 以 meek 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 举起，升高，吊起
lemmas.def_en: [T] To raise or pull something up, especially by means of ropes, pulleys, or mechanical equipment.

examples.en: The crew used a crane to hoist the heavy cargo onto the deck.
examples.zh: 船员们使用起重机将沉重的货物吊运到甲板上。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于使用机械、绳索或费力拉起重物、旗帜等；常见搭配为 hoist a flag、hoist onto。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hoist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 纠正，矫正；整流；精馏
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (formal) To correct a mistake, fault, or unfair situation.

examples.en: The management took immediate action to rectify the accounting error before the audit.
examples.zh: 管理层在审计前立即采取行动纠正了这一会计错误。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面语动词，多用于纠正错误、弥补过失或理顺局势；常接 mistake、situation 或 error。

lemmas.def_zh: 改正, 矫正, 整流
lemmas.def_en: (chemistry) the process of refinement or purification of a substance by distillation

examples.en: The engineer suggested a prompt rectification of the flawed structural design.
examples.zh: 工程师建议立即对有缺陷的结构设计进行纠正。

lemmas.def_zh: 改正者, 矫正者, 整流器
lemmas.def_en: electrical device that transforms alternating into direct current

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rectify 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 发射体, 抛射物
lemmas.def_en: a weapon that is forcibly thrown or projected at a targets but is not self-propelled

examples.en: The damaged cannon was unable to fire another projectile accurately.
examples.zh: 受损的大炮无法再精准地发射一枚炮弹。

lemmas.usage_note: 指被发射或投掷到空中的物体（如子弹、炮弹、飞石）；常见搭配如 lethal projectile、launch a projectile。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 projectile 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 搬运架, 手推车, 古墓
lemmas.def_en: the quantity that a barrow will hold

examples.en: The gardener loaded the dry leaves into a barrow and wheeled them away.
examples.zh: 园丁把枯叶装进手推车里推走了。

lemmas.usage_note: 多指园艺手推车（wheelbarrow）或街头叫卖车，在考古中指古冢；常作可数名词使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 barrow 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使随机化，将……打乱排序
lemmas.def_en: [T] To arrange, choose, or organize items, numbers, or experimental subjects in an unpredictable and completely random order.

examples.en: Researchers used a computer algorithm to randomize the sequence of test questions.
examples.zh: 研究人员使用计算机算法来打乱测试题目的顺序。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于科学实验、统计学和计算语境，指打乱顺序或随机分组；常搭配 randomized trial、randomize participants。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 随机性
lemmas.def_en: a deliberately haphazard arrangement of observations so as to simulate chance

family_guide.root_logic: 以 randomize 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 愚蠢, 荒唐事, 讽刺剧
lemmas.def_en: the trait of acting stupidly or rashly

examples.en: It would be sheer folly to invest all your savings in such a risky venture.
examples.zh: 把你所有的积蓄都投在这样一个高风险的投机项目中完全是愚蠢之举。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指缺乏理智的荒唐行为或思想，书面色彩浓；常见搭配为 the folly of doing sth、sheer folly。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 folly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 蟾蜍, 癞蛤蟆, 讨厌的家伙
lemmas.def_en: any of various tailless stout-bodied amphibians with long hind limbs for leaping; semiaquatic and terrestrial species

examples.en: A large toad sat motionlessly beside the damp garden wall.
examples.zh: 一只大蟾蜍一动不动地趴在潮湿的花园围墙边。

lemmas.usage_note: 指两栖动物蟾蜍，口语中亦可贬指卑鄙讨厌的人；常见搭配如 a poisonous toad、despicable toad。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 toad 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （使）喷出，喷射（细流）；向……喷射液体
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To force liquid out in a thin, fast stream, or to be emitted in this way.

examples.en: She squirted some lemon juice over the grilled fish.
examples.zh: 她在烤鱼上挤喷了些柠檬汁。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示（使）液体细流喷射而出，可作及物或不及物动词；常与 at、into 或 out 连用。

lemmas.def_zh: 喷射者
lemmas.def_en: plaything consisting of a toy pistol that squirts water

family_guide.root_logic: 以 squirt 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 口交
lemmas.def_en: slang for fellatio

examples.en: The movie featured explicit adult dialogue that was heavily censored on television.
examples.zh: 这部电影包含在电视上被大幅删剪的露骨成人对白。

lemmas.usage_note: 极为非正式的粗俗俚语名词，指口交性行为；常见搭配为 give sb a blowjob。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 blowjob 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 下垂，下陷；萧条，萎靡
lemmas.def_en: [I] To sink, bend, or hang down in the middle under weight, pressure, or fatigue; to decrease or weaken.

examples.en: The wooden bookshelves began to sag under the weight of hundreds of thick law books.
examples.zh: 由于承载着数百本厚重的法律书籍，那些木质书架开始向下弯曲。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指因重量、压力或老化而下弯或下垂，亦可引申指经济衰退或士气低落；常与 under 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sag 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 挡开，避开（攻击）；回避，巧妙避开（提问）
lemmas.def_en: [T] To block or deflect a blow or weapon in fighting, or to skillfully avoid answering a difficult question.

examples.en: The politician skillfully parried reporters' awkward questions about the ongoing budget deficit.
examples.zh: 这位政客巧妙地回避了记者们关于当前预算赤字的尴尬提问。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可指在击剑或格斗中挡开武器，也可比喻巧妙回避尴尬提问或批评；常接 blow 或 question。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 parry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 一丝不苟的, 精确的, 过细的
lemmas.def_en: marked by precise accordance with details

examples.en: The forensic investigator conducted a meticulous search of the crime scene for trace evidence.
examples.zh: 法医调查员对犯罪现场进行了极其细致的搜查，以寻找微量物证。

lemmas.usage_note: 褒义形容极度注重细节、严谨精确，常修饰 research、planner 或 attention，常与 in/about 连用。

lemmas.def_zh: 过细地, 细致地
lemmas.def_en: in a meticulous manner

examples.en: the set was meticulously authentic

lemmas.def_zh: 谨小慎微
lemmas.def_en: strict attention to minute details

family_guide.root_logic: 以 meticulous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: very close and convivial

examples.en: The two veterans remained boon companions long after they retired from active military service.
examples.zh: 两位老兵从军队退役很久之后，依然是一起谈天说地的亲密挚友。

lemmas.usage_note: 现仅作古旧或文学用语，几乎专用于定语固定搭配 boon companion，表示亲密无间的挚友。

lemmas.def_zh: 恩惠
lemmas.def_en: a desirable state

examples.en: The extended period of warm sunshine proved to be a real boon to local fruit farmers.
examples.zh: 持续的晴暖天气对当地果农而言真是一场莫大的及时雨。

lemmas.usage_note: 指在困境中带来巨大帮助的恩惠或福祉，常作单数，高频搭配为 be a boon to/for 某人或群体。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 boon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 积聚，积累（财富、信息等）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To collect or accumulate a large amount of wealth, information, or objects over time.

examples.en: Over the course of three decades, the investor managed to amass a colossal private fortune.
examples.zh: 在长达三十年的时间里，这位投资者成功积累了一笔巨额的个人财富。

lemmas.usage_note: 指通过长期持续的努力积聚大量财富、信息或收藏品，宾语多为 wealth、fortune 或 evidence。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 amass 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 母亲
lemmas.def_en: an informal use of the Latin word for mother; sometimes used by British schoolboys or used facetiously

examples.en: "I must head home soon, or the mater will worry," said the young aristocrat with a smile.
examples.zh: “我得赶快回家了，不然老妈该担心了，”那个年轻的贵族笑着说道。

lemmas.usage_note: 英式英语中的老派、诙谐口语，专指母亲，或见于解剖学拉丁借词硬脑膜/软脑膜搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mater 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 打哈欠；裂开，敞开
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To open your mouth wide and breathe in deeply because you are tired or bored. 2. [I] (of a hole or chasm) To open wide or gape.

examples.en: A deep and treacherous crevasse yawned across the icy path right ahead of the hikers.
examples.zh: 一道深邃而险恶的冰缝就在徒步旅行者正前方的冰道上赫然裂开。

lemmas.usage_note: 指因疲倦或无聊而打哈欠，引申指裂口或鸿沟大张；可作不及物或接引语表示打着哈欠说。

lemmas.def_zh: 哈欠；裂口 (yawn的变形)
lemmas.def_en: a person who yawns

family_guide.root_logic: 以 yawn 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 咕哝，哼哼；（尤指猪等动物）发出呼噜声
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To make a short, low, rough sound in the throat, or speak in an irritable or tired voice. 2. [I] (of an animal, especially a pig) To make a short, low grunt.

examples.en: The weightlifter grunted with exertion as he hoisted the barbell above his broad shoulders.
examples.zh: 举重运动员咬牙发出一声闷哼，将杠铃吃力地举过宽阔的双肩。

lemmas.usage_note: 指猪等动物发出呼噜声，或人因用力、不耐烦发出咕哝声；常接 in pain 或接简短答语。

lemmas.def_zh: 呼噜声, 咕哝
lemmas.def_en: the short low gruff noise of the kind made by hogs

examples.en: The manager answered my request with a brief grunt of approval and turned back to his screen.
examples.zh: 经理只是含糊地咕哝了一声表示同意，便转过头继续看他的屏幕。

lemmas.usage_note: 指喉咙深处发出的沉闷咕哝声；在军事俚语中常代指普通步兵，职场中指基层苦力工作者。

lemmas.def_zh: 作猪哼者, 猪
lemmas.def_en: a person who grunts

family_guide.root_logic: 以 grunt 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 形而上学, 玄学, 空头理论
lemmas.def_en: the philosophical study of being and knowing

examples.en: Her latest academic paper examines how classical metaphysics shaped modern ethical frameworks.
examples.zh: 她最新的学术论文探讨了古典形而上学是如何构建现代伦理学框架的。

lemmas.usage_note: 哲学核心分支，研究存在、现实本质与因果等终极问题，形式虽为复数但通常作单数名词使用。

lemmas.def_zh: 形而上学的, 纯粹哲学的, 抽象的
lemmas.def_en: pertaining to or of the nature of metaphysics

examples.en: metaphysical philosophy

lemmas.def_zh: metaphysical的变形
lemmas.def_en: in a metaphysical manner

examples.en: he thinks metaphysically

family_guide.root_logic: 以 metaphysics 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 山坡, 山腹
lemmas.def_en: the side or slope of a hill

examples.en: Rows of lush green vineyards stretch across the sunny hillside facing the blue lake.
examples.zh: 成排郁郁葱葱的葡萄园绵延在正对蔚蓝湖泊的向阳山坡上。

lemmas.usage_note: 指小山的山坡或倾斜侧面，常与 steep、rocky 搭配，介词多连用 on the hillside。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hillside 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不可抵抗的, 不能压制的
lemmas.def_en: impossible to resist; overpowering

examples.en: She felt an irresistible urge to open the mysterious letter before anyone else arrived.
examples.zh: 在其他人到达之前，她感到一种无法抗拒的冲动想拆开那封神秘的信。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰charm、urge或force，表示诱人到无法抗拒或力量强大无法阻挡，语气强烈。

lemmas.def_zh: 不能抵抗, 不能压制
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being overpowering and impossible to resist

family_guide.root_logic: 以 irresistible 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 磷酸盐, 磷酸酯
lemmas.def_en: a salt of phosphoric acid

examples.en: Overuse of phosphate fertilizers can lead to serious pollution in local river systems.
examples.zh: 过度使用磷肥可能会对当地河流系统造成严重污染。

lemmas.usage_note: 化学与农学常用名词，常用于phosphate fertilizer（磷肥）或phosphate rock（磷矿石）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 phosphate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (一名)职员(尤指编辑或记者)
lemmas.def_en: an employee who is a member of a staff of workers (especially a member of the staff that works for the President of the United States)

examples.en: A senior White House staffer leaked details of the upcoming trade policy to the press.
examples.zh: 一名白宫高级职员向媒体透露了即将出台的贸易政策细节。

lemmas.usage_note: 美式英语常用，指机构、政界或媒体内的一名全职雇员，常与campaign、White House连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 staffer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 大主教, 灵长目动物
lemmas.def_en: a senior clergyman and dignitary

examples.en: Chimpanzees and bonobos are our closest living relatives among the primates.
examples.zh: 黑猩猩和倭黑猩猩是我们在灵长类动物中现存亲缘关系最近的亲属。

lemmas.usage_note: 生物学中指灵长目动物，宗教学中指大主教；学术语境下通常以复数primates指代灵长类。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 primate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 极小之物, 针尖, 立锥之地, 精确位置
lemmas.def_en: a very brief moment

examples.en: Through the dense fog, we could barely see a pinpoint of light coming from the lighthouse.
examples.zh: 穿过浓雾，我们隐约能看到灯塔发出的一点微光。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与of搭配（如a pinpoint of light），指微小的光点、极小之物或极精确的点。

lemmas.def_zh: 查明，精确指出；准确确定（位置或时间）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To find, identify, or explain the exact position, cause, or time of something.

examples.en: Technicians worked through the night to pinpoint the exact cause of the power outage.
examples.zh: 技术人员彻夜工作，以查明停电的确切原因。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，后接cause、location或problem，表示精准查明位置、原因或性质。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pinpoint 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 向日葵
lemmas.def_en: any plant of the genus Helianthus having large flower heads with dark disk florets and showy yellow rays

examples.en: Vast fields of bright sunflowers were in full bloom beneath the summer sun.
examples.zh: 夏日的阳光下，大片明艳的向日葵竞相绽放。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用植物名词，高频搭配包括sunflower oil（葵花籽油）和sunflower seeds（葵花籽）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sunflower 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 食谱
lemmas.def_en: a book of recipes and cooking directions

examples.en: Her latest cookbook features dozens of simple, healthy recipes for busy weeknights.
examples.zh: 她最新的食谱收录了数十道适合忙碌工作日夜晚的简单健康菜肴。

lemmas.usage_note: 指烹饪书或食谱；引申可表示按部就班的操作指南，常用作书目分类或生活词汇。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cookbook 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 生物医学
lemmas.def_en: relating to the activities and applications of science to clinical medicine

examples.en: The university secured a major government grant to expand its biomedical research facility.
examples.zh: 该大学获得了一笔巨额政府拨款，用于扩建其生物医学研究设施。

lemmas.usage_note: 前置定语，多用于学术及科技语境，常见搭配有biomedical research或biomedical engineering。

lemmas.def_zh: 生物医学
lemmas.def_en: the branch of medical science that applies biological and physiological principles to clinical practice

examples.en: Recent advances in biomedicine have paved the way for highly personalized cancer treatments.
examples.zh: 生物医学的最新进展为高度个性化的癌症治疗铺平了道路。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 biomedical 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 未成年的, 未及法定年龄的
lemmas.def_en: not of legal age

examples.en: The store owner was heavily fined for selling alcoholic beverages to underage customers.
examples.zh: 店主因向未成年顾客出售酒精饮料而被处以重罚。

lemmas.usage_note: 法律与社会语境常用形容词，多作定语修饰underage drinking（未成年饮酒）或underage smoking。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 underage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 间谍活动
lemmas.def_en: the systematic use of spies to get military or political secrets

examples.en: The former intelligence officer was charged with espionage for selling state secrets to a foreign power.
examples.zh: 这名前情报官员因向外国势力出卖国家机密而被控间谍罪。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，政治与安全用语，常见搭配如industrial espionage（商业间谍）或act of espionage。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 espionage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 生物多样性
lemmas.def_en: the diversity of plant and animal life in a particular habitat (or in the world as a whole)

examples.en: Deforestation poses a severe threat to the region's rich biodiversity.
examples.zh: 森林砍伐对该地区丰富的生物多样性构成了严重威胁。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作不可数名词，用于生态与环保语境，常见搭配有 preserve/protect/conserve biodiversity。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 biodiversity 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: Frances 的爱称；[口]屁股；女子救护队队员
lemmas.def_en: the fleshy part of the human body that you sit on

examples.en: He slipped on the icy sidewalk and landed squarely on his fanny.
examples.zh: 他在结冰的人行道上滑了一跤，结结实实地摔了个屁墩儿。

lemmas.usage_note: 美式口语中指臀部（如 fanny pack 意为腰包）；英式俚语中指女性阴部，极具冒犯性，使用时须严格区分语域。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fanny 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 宽度
lemmas.def_en: the capacity to understand a broad range of topics

examples.en: The interviewers were deeply impressed by the breadth of her international experience.
examples.zh: 考官们对她丰富的国际经历广度留下了深刻的印象。

lemmas.usage_note: 可指物理宽度，也常引申为知识、经验等的“广度”，高频搭配如 breadth of knowledge/experience。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 breadth 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 雷盖
lemmas.def_en: popular music originating in the West Indies; repetitive bass riffs and regular chords played on the off beat by a guitar

examples.en: The cafe played relaxing reggae music in the background all afternoon.
examples.zh: 整整一个下午，咖啡馆的背景音都播放着轻松惬意的雷鬼音乐。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，指源于牙买加的雷鬼音乐风格，常作定语修饰 band, artist, rhythm 等。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reggae 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 在前台的
lemmas.def_en: situated or taking place on the area of a stage visible to the audience

examples.en: Her confident onstage persona is completely different from her shy everyday self.
examples.zh: 她在舞台上自信的台风与日常生活中害羞的自己截然不同。

lemmas.usage_note: 只作前置定语，修饰演员或音乐人在舞台上的表现或状态，常与 persona, chemistry 等搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 onstage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 超过正常的, 超过科学可知范围的
lemmas.def_en: seemingly outside normal sensory channels

examples.en: A team of researchers arrived to investigate reports of paranormal activity in the old mansion.
examples.zh: 一个研究团队赶来调查这栋老宅中有关超自然现象的报告。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，指超自然的、科学无法解释的，常与 activity, phenomena, investigator 等连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 paranormal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 花粉
lemmas.def_en: the fine spores that contain male gametes and that are borne by an anther in a flowering plant

examples.en: During spring, the high pollen count often triggers severe hay fever for many residents.
examples.zh: 在春季，偏高的花粉指数往往会引发许多居民严重的花粉热。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，指花粉；常见搭配包括 pollen count（花粉指数）及 pollen allergy（花粉过敏）。

lemmas.def_zh: 授粉
lemmas.def_en: transfer of pollen from the anther to the stigma of a plant

lemmas.def_zh: 传粉者, 传粉媒介, 传粉昆虫; 授花粉器
lemmas.def_en: an insect that carries pollen from one flower to another

lemmas.def_zh: 给……授粉，传粉
lemmas.def_en: [T] (of insects, wind, or humans) To carry pollen to a flower or plant so that it can produce seeds or fruit.

examples.en: Bees and butterflies help pollinate flowering plants as they search for sweet nectar.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂和蝴蝶在寻找甜美花蜜的同时协助开花植物授粉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pollen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 威严的；奥林匹克竞赛的；奥林匹斯山的
lemmas.def_en: of the region of Olympia in Greece or its inhabitants

examples.en: The committee held an Olympian calm in the face of rising public criticism.
examples.zh: 面对外界日益高涨的批评声，委员会表现出一种泰然自若的冷漠态度。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，常大写，可指奥林匹克的；亦可小写引申指超然的、威严冷漠的（如 Olympian detachment）。

lemmas.def_en: an athlete who participates in the Olympic games

examples.en: After years of rigorous training, she finally realized her dream of becoming an Olympian.
examples.zh: 经过多年的刻苦训练，她终于实现了成为一名奥运选手的梦想。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，首字母通常大写，指“奥林匹克运动员”或神话中的“奥林匹斯神祗”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 olympian 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 神父, 随军牧师
lemmas.def_en: a chaplain in one of the military services

examples.en: The soldiers often turned to the regimental padre for spiritual guidance before deployment.
examples.zh: 在奔赴前线之前，士兵们常常向团里的随军神父寻求心灵的慰藉与指引。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，非正式或军队语境中常用于称呼随军牧师或天主教神父，通常带有一种亲近或尊重的语气。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 padre 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 修改，修订；重做，重新加工
lemmas.def_en: [T] To revise, rewrite, or reshape a piece of writing, music, or material to improve it.

examples.en: The director asked the screenwriter to rework the ending to make it more dramatic.
examples.zh: 导演要求编剧重写结局，使其更具戏剧张力。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指对文本、设计、法案等进行“重做、修订或彻底改写”，常接 draft, proposal 等宾语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rework 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 惊人的事物, 奇迹, 不凡的人, 奇才, 神童, 预兆
lemmas.def_en: an unusually gifted or intelligent (young) person; someone whose talents excite wonder and admiration

examples.en: Mozart was recognized as a musical prodigy from a very young age.
examples.zh: 莫扎特从小就被公认为音乐奇才。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指在音乐、数学等领域展现惊人天赋的“神童”，常见搭配如 child prodigy，语体偏书面。

lemmas.def_zh: 庞大的, 惊人的, 异常的
lemmas.def_en: so great in size or force or extent as to elicit awe

examples.en: colossal crumbling ruins of an ancient temple
has a colossal nerve

lemmas.def_zh: 异常地, 惊人地, 巨大地
lemmas.def_en: to a prodigious degree

examples.en: the prices of farms rose prodigiously

family_guide.root_logic: 以 prodigy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 有恶意的, 恶性的, 有害的
lemmas.def_en: dangerous to health; characterized by progressive and uncontrolled growth (especially of a tumor)

examples.en: The biopsy confirmed that the tumor was malignant and required immediate surgery.
examples.zh: 活检证实该肿瘤为恶性，需要立即手术。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学上指恶性肿瘤（与 benign 相对），文学语体中亦可形容怀有极大恶意的意图或影响。

lemmas.def_zh: 恶意, 邪恶, 恶性肿瘤
lemmas.def_en: (medicine) a malignant state; progressive and resistant to treatment and tending to cause death

lemmas.def_zh: 怀恶意地;  恶毒地;  有害地; 恶性地
lemmas.def_en: in a malignant manner, as of a tumor that spreads

family_guide.root_logic: 以 malignant 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 大汤匙
lemmas.def_en: as much as a tablespoon will hold

examples.en: Add one tablespoon of olive oil to the pan and heat it gently.
examples.zh: 往平底锅里加入一汤匙橄榄油，慢慢加热。

lemmas.usage_note: 指大汤匙或烹饪中的容量计量单位（大匙），缩写为 tbsp，常用于食谱及日常口语。

lemmas.def_zh: 一餐匙容量, 一大汤匙容量
lemmas.def_en: as much as a tablespoon will hold

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tablespoon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 探究，钻研，深入查考；翻找，翻寻
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (delve into) To investigate, research, or examine something deeply and thoroughly. 2. [I] (delve into/in) To reach into a container to search for something.

examples.en: The journalist decided to delve into the company's financial records to uncover the truth.
examples.zh: 这名记者决定深入调查该公司的财务记录以揭开真相。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与 into 连用构成 delve into，表示深入调查、钻研或在包中翻找，常用于书面及学术语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 delve 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 精神病患者, 精神变态者
lemmas.def_en: someone with a sociopathic personality; a person with an antisocial personality disorder (`psychopath' was once widely used but has now been superseded by `sociopath')

examples.en: The forensic psychologist evaluated the suspect to determine if he was a psychopath.
examples.zh: 法医心理学家对嫌疑人进行了评估，以确定他是否属于精神变态者。

lemmas.usage_note: 指缺乏同理心和道德感的变态心理者，用于心理学学术语境或日常夸张口语，需注意语境严肃性。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 psychopath 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 序, 绪言, 前言
lemmas.def_en: a short introductory essay preceding the text of a book

examples.en: The author explained his motivation for writing the book in the preface.
examples.zh: 作者在序言中阐述了他撰写这本书的动机。

lemmas.usage_note: 指书籍、文章的前言或绪言，常与 to 搭配（a preface to sth），多见于正式书面语。

lemmas.def_zh: 为……作序；以……作为开场白（或前奏）
lemmas.def_en: [T] (+ with) To introduce a book, speech, or action with an opening statement or preliminary event.

examples.en: She prefaced her speech with a humorous anecdote to put the audience at ease.
examples.zh: 她在演讲开始前讲了一则幽默的小故事，以缓解听众的紧张情绪。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常与 with/by 连用，表示“以……作为开场白或前言”，多用于演讲及正式叙述。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 preface 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 十万, 十万卢比, 多数
lemmas.def_en: the cardinal number that is the fifth power of ten

examples.en: The renovation project is estimated to cost more than fifty lakhs of rupees.
examples.zh: 这项翻新工程估计要耗资五百万（五十拉客）卢比以上。

lemmas.usage_note: 南亚英语专有计量单位，表示“十万”（常用于统计人数或卢比金额），常作 lakh of sth。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lakh 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 细细地流，滴流；使缓缓流淌；缓慢移动
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (+ down/into/out) When liquid, people, or money trickle, they flow slowly in a very thin stream or small numbers. 2. [T] To make a liquid flow in a thin stream.

examples.en: Tears began to trickle down her cheeks as she heard the touching news.
examples.zh: 听到这个感人的消息时，泪水开始顺着她的脸颊缓缓流下。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可指液体细细流淌，也可比喻人流、信息缓慢零星地移动，常与 down/in/out 等介词连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 trickle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使停止运转，停用，使无效；解除（军事单位等）编制
lemmas.def_en: [T] To make something stop functioning or to deactivate a device, account, or chemical.

examples.en: You can easily deactivate your social media account in the privacy settings.
examples.zh: 你可以在隐私设置中轻松停用你的社交媒体账户。

lemmas.usage_note: 指使设备、账户、炸弹或化学物质失去活性或停止运转，常用于科技、网络及军事语境。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 释放, 不激活
lemmas.def_en: breaking up a military unit (by transfers or discharges)

family_guide.root_logic: 以 deactivate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 商务载重, 工资负担, 净载重量, 有效负荷, 弹头
lemmas.def_en: the front part of a guided missile or rocket or torpedo that carries the nuclear or explosive charge or the chemical or biological agents

examples.en: The rocket is capable of carrying a heavy satellite payload into low Earth orbit.
examples.zh: 该火箭能够将较重的卫星有效载荷送入近地轨道。

lemmas.usage_note: 指飞机、火箭的商载或有效载荷，在计算机中指数据包中的实际载荷，在军事中指弹头装药量。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 payload 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 结实的；矮胖的；勇敢的；激烈的
lemmas.def_en: dependable

examples.en: He laced up a pair of stout hiking boots before heading into the rugged mountains.
examples.zh: 在走向险峻的山区之前，他系紧了一双结实的徒步鞋。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可指人身材粗壮矮胖，也可形容物体结实耐用或意志坚定，常用于描述人的体格或鞋靴、防卫等。

lemmas.def_zh: 刚强地, 坚决地
lemmas.def_en: in a resolute manner

examples.en: he was stoutly replying to his critics

lemmas.def_zh: 坚固, 刚毅
lemmas.def_en: the property of being strong and resolute

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stout 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 正式脱离，退出（联邦、组织等）
lemmas.def_en: [I] (+ from) to formally break away from a country, federation, or political organization in order to become independent

examples.en: Several southern states voted to secede from the Union, triggering the Civil War.
examples.zh: 南部几个州投票决定脱离联邦，从而引发了内战。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作不及物动词，后接介词 from，用于指国家、联邦、政党或教会等组织正式分裂或脱离出去。

lemmas.def_zh: 脱离, 分离
lemmas.def_en: an Austrian school of art and architecture parallel to the French art nouveau in the 1890s

family_guide.root_logic: 以 secede 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 溜冰场, 室内溜冰场
lemmas.def_en: building that contains a surface for ice skating or roller skating

examples.en: Families gathered at the local ice rink to enjoy skating during the winter holiday.
examples.zh: 寒假期间，各家各户聚集在当地的滑冰场享受滑冰的乐趣。

lemmas.usage_note: 专指溜冰场或轮滑场，常见搭配包括 ice rink（滑冰场）和 skating rink（旱冰场），属日常名词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rink 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 雌激素
lemmas.def_en: a general term for female steroid sex hormones that are secreted by the ovary and responsible for typical female sexual characteristics

examples.en: During menopause, a sharp drop in estrogen levels can cause various physical symptoms.
examples.zh: 更年期期间，雌激素水平的急剧下降会引起各种身体症状。

lemmas.usage_note: 生物学和医学专业名词，不可数，常用于讨论内分泌、激素替代疗法（HRT）及激素水平波动等语境。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 动情的, 雌激素的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or caused by estrogen

family_guide.root_logic: 以 estrogen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 封建制度的, 封地的, 领地的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or characteristic of feudalism

examples.en: Peasants in the feudal society were legally bound to cultivate the land for their lords.
examples.zh: 封建社会的农民在法律上受束缚，必须为领主耕种土地。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰 system, society, lord 等，指封建制度的；也可引申为比喻义，形容观念或做法陈旧过时。

lemmas.def_zh: 封建制度的, 封建性的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or characteristic of feudalism

lemmas.def_zh: 封建主义, 封建制度
lemmas.def_en: the social system that developed in Europe in the 8th century; vassals were protected by lords who they had to serve in war

family_guide.root_logic: 以 feudal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 迈纳(古希腊单位)
lemmas.def_en: tropical Asian starlings

examples.en: According to ancient records, the merchant paid thirty minas of silver for the shipment of grain.
examples.zh: 根据古代记录，这位商人为这批粮食支付了三十迈纳的银子。

lemmas.usage_note: 历史学与考古学专有名词，指古希腊、近东及两河流域使用的古代重量单位或货币单位，常作可数名词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mina 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 犹太人的离散, 离散的犹太人
lemmas.def_en: the body of Jews (or Jewish communities) outside Palestine or modern Israel

examples.en: The global African diaspora continues to exert a powerful cultural influence around the world.
examples.zh: 遍布全球的非洲离散社群继续在世界范围内发挥着强大的文化影响力。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作单数名词（首字母大写时特指犹太人离散），泛指任何离开本国散居在外的族群群体，常与 the 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 diaspora 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 层积塑胶板, 薄片制品
lemmas.def_en: a sheet of material made by bonding two or more sheets or layers

lemmas.def_zh: 薄板, 薄片, 薄层, 叶片
lemmas.def_en: a thin plate or layer (especially of bone or mineral)

examples.en: The microscopic examination revealed damage to the basal lamina of the blood vessel.
examples.zh: 显微镜检查显示血管的基底膜薄层受到了损伤。

lemmas.usage_note: 解剖学、植物学及地质学专业术语，指薄层、薄板或叶片，复数形式常写作 laminae，具学术语体特征。

lemmas.def_zh: 层积, 薄板
lemmas.def_en: a layered structure

lemmas.def_zh: 层合机
lemmas.def_en: a person who makes laminates (especially plastic laminates)

lemmas.def_zh: 压膜，层压；把……制成薄板
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To cover paper or a flat surface with a protective layer of plastic. 2. [T] To bond thin layers of material together to make a composite.

lemmas.def_zh: 板, 薄层, 薄片, 层
lemmas.def_en: arranged in or consisting of laminae

examples.en: The engineer optimized the pipe design to ensure smooth and steady laminar flow.
examples.zh: 工程师优化了管道设计以确保平稳稳定的层流。

lemmas.def_zh: 薄板[薄片]状的, 由薄板组成的
lemmas.def_en: arranged in or consisting of laminae

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lamina 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 学者, 梵文学者, 博学的印度人, 权威
lemmas.def_en: someone who has been admitted to membership in a scholarly field

examples.en: Political pundits debated the potential outcome of the upcoming presidential election on television.
examples.zh: 政治评论员们在电视上就即将到来的总统选举的潜在结果展开了辩论。

lemmas.usage_note: 媒体与新闻常用词，常与 political, media, sports 搭配，多指频繁在公开媒介发表观点的评论家或专家。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pundit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 引渡，将…引渡回国
lemmas.def_en: [T] (law) to officially hand over an accused or convicted person to another country or jurisdiction where the crime was committed

examples.en: The government refused to extradite the suspect until guaranteed a fair trial.
examples.zh: 在该嫌疑人获得公正审判的保证之前，政府拒绝引渡他。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常用于正式法律与外交新闻语境，核心搭配为 extradite sb. from/to 或 be extradited to face charges。

lemmas.def_zh: 引渡逃犯, 亡命者送还本国
lemmas.def_en: the surrender of an accused or convicted person by one state or country to another (usually under the provisions of a statute or treaty)

family_guide.root_logic: 以 extradite 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （使）扭动，（使）摆动
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To move, or make something move, with small, quick movements from side to side or up and down.

examples.en: The puppy was so excited to see its owner that it began to wiggle its tail frantically.
examples.zh: 小狗见到主人兴奋极了，开始拼命地摇摆尾巴。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指短促、快速地轻微摆动身体部位，常见搭配有 wiggle one's toes/fingers 或用于脱困语境。

lemmas.def_zh: 摇摆的人, 蠕动的东西, 孑孓
lemmas.def_en: one who can't stay still (especially a child)

examples.en: the toddler was a real wiggler on plane trips

lemmas.def_zh: 左右摇摆的, 蠕动的, 起伏的
lemmas.def_en: curved or curving in and out

examples.en: The toddler giggled while watching the wiggly worm crawl across the wet sidewalk.
examples.zh: 蹒跚学步的孩子看着蠕动的蠕虫爬过潮湿的人行道，咯咯直笑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wiggle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （英国作家J R R Tolkien笔下的）
lemmas.def_en: an imaginary being similar to a person but smaller and with hairy feet; invented by J.R.R. Tolkien

examples.en: The brave hobbit set out on a perilous journey to destroy the powerful ring.
examples.zh: 这位勇敢的霍比特人踏上了销毁那枚强大魔戒的险途。

lemmas.usage_note: 托尔金奇幻文学中虚构的矮小种族，常用于文学评论、流行文化及影视相关的讨论语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hobbit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 值得一读的, 易读的, 读起来津津有味的
lemmas.def_en: easily deciphered

examples.en: Despite covering complex scientific concepts, the author made the book remarkably readable.
examples.zh: 尽管涉及复杂的科学概念，作者却把这本书写得极为通俗易读。

lemmas.usage_note: 作形容词，既可指字迹或排版“清晰易认的”，也可指文章内容“引人入胜、通俗易懂的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 不能读的, 难辩认的, 平淡无味的, 不值一读的
lemmas.def_en: not easily deciphered

examples.en: indecipherable handwriting

lemmas.def_zh: 易读, 可读性
lemmas.def_en: the quality of written language that makes it easy to read and understand

family_guide.root_logic: 以 readable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 恸哭，哀号，嚎啕；呼啸，发出长而尖厉的声音
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To cry out with a long, high, mournful sound of pain or grief; to utter with wailing. 2. [I] To make a prolonged, high-pitched mournful sound.

examples.en: The distraught mother began to wail when she heard the tragic news.
examples.zh: 听到这个噩耗时，心碎的母亲痛哭失声。

lemmas.usage_note: 指因极度悲痛而发出长声嚎哭，亦可拟人化指警报声或风声呼啸，常搭配 wail in grief/pain。

lemmas.def_zh: 恸哭, 哀号, 嚎啕, 呼啸(声)
lemmas.def_en: a cry of sorrow and grief

examples.en: A long, mournful wail echoed through the empty corridors of the hospital.
examples.zh: 一声悠长悲戚的哀号在医院空荡的走廊里回荡。

lemmas.usage_note: 指哀号声、嚎啕声或警笛呼啸声，为可数名词，常见搭配有 let out a wail 或 the wail of sirens。

lemmas.def_zh: 哀悼者, 恸哭者
lemmas.def_en: a mourner who utters long loud high-pitched cries

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wail 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 傻子
lemmas.def_en: an aimless drawing

examples.en: In the eighteenth-century ballad, the word was used to mock a simple-minded doodle.
examples.zh: 在那首十八世纪的民谣中，这个词被用来嘲笑一个头脑简单的傻瓜。

lemmas.usage_note: 现代主流指心不在焉时画的涂鸦；作为古旧俚语指“笨蛋、傻子”，多见于历史民谣（如 Yankee Doodle）。

lemmas.def_zh: （心不在焉地）乱涂，涂鸦
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To draw lines, shapes, or pictures absentmindedly while thinking about something else.

examples.en: Bored by the lengthy lecture, she began to doodle flowers in the margin of her notebook.
examples.zh: 由于冗长的讲座令人厌倦，她开始在笔记本的空白边缘涂鸦花朵。

lemmas.usage_note: 指无意识地信手涂鸦、乱写乱画，也可引申为无聊消磨时间，常搭配 doodle in the margins。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 doodle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 轻柔低语，温柔地说；（鸽子等）咕咕叫
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. To speak in a soft, gentle, and loving voice. 2. (of a dove or pigeon) To make a soft low murmur.

examples.en: The young mother leaned over the crib to coo soothing words to her infant.
examples.zh: 年轻的母亲俯身在婴儿床边，轻言细语地安抚着她的宝宝。

lemmas.usage_note: 指鸽子咕咕叫，亦常用于描写人用轻柔、甜美的声音说话，常见搭配如 coo softly 或 coo to the baby。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 coo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （尤指不情愿地）放弃，交出（权力、权利或财产）；松开
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (formal) To give up power, control, a claim, or possession of something, often reluctantly. 2. [T] To let go of a hold on something.

examples.en: Under immense pressure from the board, the CEO agreed to relinquish his control over the company.
examples.zh: 在董事会的巨大压力下，首席执行官同意放弃对公司的控制权。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面用语，多指被迫或自愿放弃权力、职位、控制权或所有物，常接 power, control, claim 等宾语。

lemmas.def_zh: [法] 放弃, 放弃权利, 放弃继承权
lemmas.def_en: a verbal act of renouncing a claim or right or position etc.

family_guide.root_logic: 以 relinquish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 拱顶石, 楔石, 重点
lemmas.def_en: a central cohesive source of support and stability

examples.en: Freedom of the press is universally regarded as the keystone of a democratic society.
examples.zh: 新闻自由被普遍视为民主社会的基石。

lemmas.usage_note: 原指石拱门顶部的楔形拱顶石，多用于比喻体系、政策或论点的“核心、基石”，常与 of 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 keystone 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 工匠, 技工, 手艺人
lemmas.def_en: a professional whose work is consistently of high quality

examples.en: The wooden cabinet was meticulously carved by a skilled craftsman in Florence.
examples.zh: 这个木柜是由佛罗伦萨一位技艺精湛的手艺人精心雕刻而成的。

lemmas.usage_note: 指技艺精湛的手工艺人或在特定领域技艺超群的大师，常与 skilled, master 等形容词搭配。

lemmas.def_zh: 技术, 技艺
lemmas.def_en: skill in an occupation or trade

family_guide.root_logic: 以 craftsman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 茶匙
lemmas.def_en: as much as a teaspoon will hold

examples.en: Add one teaspoon of vanilla extract to the batter before baking the cake.
examples.zh: 在烘焙蛋糕之前，向面糊中加入一茶匙香草精。

lemmas.usage_note: 指调羹、茶匙，在烹饪或制药中常作计量单位（约合5毫升），常见结构为 a teaspoon of something。

lemmas.def_zh: 一茶匙的容量
lemmas.def_en: as much as a teaspoon will hold

family_guide.root_logic: 以 teaspoon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 猛犸似的, 巨大的
lemmas.def_en: so exceedingly large or extensive as to suggest a giant or mammoth

examples.en: Cleaning up the oil spill has turned into a mammoth task for local authorities.
examples.zh: 清理这次漏油事故已成为当地政府一项极其艰巨的任务。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作前置定语修饰 task, project, effort 等抽象名词，强调规模或难度极其巨大，书面及新闻常见。

lemmas.def_zh: 猛犸, 庞然大物
lemmas.def_en: any of numerous extinct elephants widely distributed in the Pleistocene; extremely large with hairy coats and long upcurved tusks

examples.en: Scientists recently discovered well-preserved frozen remains of a woolly mammoth.
examples.zh: 科学家最近发现了一具保存完好的长毛猛犸象冰冻遗骸。

lemmas.usage_note: 作可数名词，本义指已灭绝的古生物猛犸象，引申指行业巨头或极其庞大的事物，前常加冠词或定语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mammoth 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （因惊讶、激动或愤怒而）高声呼喊，惊呼，感叹
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To cry out or speak suddenly and loudly because of surprise, strong emotion, or pain.

examples.en: "What a wonderful surprise!" she exclaimed in delight.
examples.zh: “真是个天大的惊喜！”她高兴地惊呼道。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物或及物动词，常用于引出直接引语或接 that 从句，常伴随 with/in surprise, delight 等介词短语。

lemmas.def_zh: 惊呼, 激烈言词, 惊叹词
lemmas.def_en: an abrupt excited utterance

examples.en: He let out a sharp exclamation of pain when the heavy box dropped on his foot.
examples.zh: 当重箱子砸到脚上时，他发出一声痛苦的尖叫。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指突然发出的呼喊、叫声或感叹词，常见搭配有 an exclamation of surprise/pain。

lemmas.def_zh: 感叹的, 惊叹的
lemmas.def_en: sudden and strong

examples.en: Her speech ended with an exclamatory remark that surprised everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 她的演讲以一句感叹语结尾，令房间里的所有人大吃一惊。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 exclaim 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 杂乱
lemmas.def_en: a confused multitude of things

examples.en: She spent the entire afternoon clearing the clutter off her desk.
