examples.zh: 她花了一整个下午清理书桌上的杂物。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作不可数名词，指乱七八糟散落的物品或混乱状态，常见搭配 a desk full of clutter, clear away the clutter。

lemmas.def_zh: 塞满，乱堆在，使凌乱
lemmas.def_en: [T] (+ up/with) To fill a place or surface with an untidy collection of things.

examples.en: Old magazines and empty boxes cluttered up the small garage.
examples.zh: 旧杂志和空盒子把狭小的车库塞得乱七八糟。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常与 up 连用（clutter up），后接空间名词，多用于被动语态 be cluttered with，表示堆满杂物。

lemmas.def_zh: 清理，使整洁，清除……的杂物
lemmas.def_en: [T] To remove unnecessary objects or clutter from a space to make it tidy.

examples.en: Clear your desk

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 凌乱的；堆满杂物的
lemmas.def_en: filled or scattered with a disorderly accumulation of objects or rubbish
lemmas.usage_note: 常用于修饰桌面、房间或心绪，如 a cluttered desk / a cluttered mind。

examples.en: His desk was so cluttered that he couldn't find the important documents.
examples.zh: 他的桌子太乱了，以至于找不到重要文件。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 clutter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 尼龙
lemmas.def_en: a thermoplastic polyamide; a family of strong resilient synthetic fibers

examples.en: The lightweight jacket is made of durable nylon that repels water.
examples.zh: 这件轻便夹克由防水且耐磨的尼龙制成。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词指尼龙材质（前置修饰 rope, jacket 等）；复数形式 nylons 特指女式尼龙长丝袜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nylon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 椭圆, 椭圆形
lemmas.def_en: a closed plane curve resulting from the intersection of a circular cone and a plane cutting completely through it

examples.en: Planets in our solar system travel around the sun in the shape of an ellipse.
examples.zh: 太阳系中的行星以椭圆形轨道绕太阳运行。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，几何学与天文学专业术语，指规则椭圆形，常搭配 draw an ellipse, in the shape of an ellipse。

lemmas.def_zh: 椭圆率, 椭圆形, 椭圆性
lemmas.def_en: the property possessed by a round shape that is flattened at the poles

examples.en: the oblateness of the planet

lemmas.def_zh: 椭圆的
lemmas.def_en: rounded like an egg

lemmas.def_zh: 椭圆形的
lemmas.def_en: (of a leaf shape) in the form of an ellipse

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ellipse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 平息，减退，消退；（水等）回落，退去；（地面、建筑物等）下陷，沉降
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (of pain, anger, storm, or noise) To become calmer, quieter, or less intense. 2. [I] (of water) To sink to a lower or normal level. 3. [I] (of ground or a building) To sink lower into the ground.

examples.en: The doctor assured him that the swelling and pain would subside within a few days.
examples.zh: 医生向他保证，肿胀和疼痛会在几天之内消退。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，主语多为风暴、疼痛、愤怒等情绪或洪水、地面，表示逐渐平息、消退或沉降，后不接宾语。

lemmas.def_zh: 沉淀, 下沉, 陷没
lemmas.def_en: an abatement in intensity or degree (as in the manifestations of a disease)

examples.en: his cancer is in remission

family_guide.root_logic: 以 subside 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 内心的, 向内的, 本来的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or existing in the mind or thoughts

examples.en: Despite his calm exterior, he was dealing with intense inward turmoil.
examples.zh: 尽管表面平静，他的内心深处却经历着剧烈的动荡。

lemmas.usage_note: 仅作前置定语，修饰 feelings, smile, journey 等，表示内心的、精神深处的或朝向内部的，反义词为 outward。

lemmas.def_zh: 在内部, 向中心, 向内, 内里, 在心灵深处, 精神上, 思想上, 暗自地
lemmas.def_en: with respect to private feelings

examples.en: inwardly, she was raging

lemmas.def_zh: 本质, 深意, 灵性, 精神性, 思想的深度, 诚挚, 感情的深度
lemmas.def_en: the choicest or most essential or most vital part of some idea or experience

examples.en: the gist of the prosecutor's argument
the heart and soul of the Republican Party

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inward 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 受雇暴徒, 愚笨者, 呆子
lemmas.def_en: an awkward stupid person

examples.en: The corrupt businessman hired a couple of goons to intimidate the local shopkeepers.
examples.zh: 那个黑心商人雇了几个打手去恐吓当地的店主。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式口语名词，指受雇施暴的打手、暴徒（多用于犯罪/工会罢工语境），也可指傻瓜、呆子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 goon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （使）烧焦，（使）焦黑；炙烤；（使植物）枯焦
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To burn and discolor the surface of something with intense heat, or to become burned on the surface. 2. [T] (of the sun or drought) To dry up or wither vegetation.

examples.en: Be careful not to scorch the delicate silk fabric while ironing it.
examples.zh: 熨烫时要小心，别把娇贵的丝绸面料给烫焦了。

lemmas.usage_note: 可用作及物或不及物动词，指物体表面被火或高温烤焦、烫黄，常见搭配 scorch the earth, scorched by the sun。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scorch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使纠缠，缠住；使卷入，使陷入
lemmas.def_en: [T] To twist things together in an untidy mass, or to involve someone or something in a complicated or difficult situation.

examples.en: The young sea turtle became entangled in an abandoned plastic fishing net.
examples.zh: 那只幼年海龟被一张遗弃的塑料渔网死死缠住了。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常用于被动语态 be entangled in/with，物理上表示被绳网缠住，引申指卷入复杂纷争或难题。

lemmas.def_zh: 纠缠, 卷入, 缠绕物
lemmas.def_en: an intricate trap that entangles or ensnares its victim

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 纠缠的；卷入（复杂局面）的
lemmas.def_en: caught or involved in a tangled, complicated, or compromising situation
lemmas.usage_note: 既可指绳网物理上的纠结，也可引申指陷入复杂的纷争或感情中，常与 in 搭配。

examples.en: The diplomat found himself entangled in a dangerous political scandal.
examples.zh: 那位外交官发现自己卷入了一场危险的政治丑闻。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 entangle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 长颈鹿, 鹿豹座
lemmas.def_en: tallest living quadruped; having a spotted coat and small horns and very long neck and legs; of savannahs of tropical Africa

examples.en: The tall giraffe stretched its long neck to reach the tender leaves at the top of the acacia tree.
examples.zh: 高大的长颈鹿伸长脖子去吃金合欢树顶端的嫩叶。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指原产于非洲的长颈鹿，天文学中首字母大写指鹿豹座；作比喻时形容身材极高瘦的人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 giraffe 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 目击者, 见证人
lemmas.def_en: a spectator who can describe what happened

examples.en: An eyewitness gave police a detailed description of the suspect fleeing the crime scene.
examples.zh: 一名目击者向警方详细描述了嫌疑人逃离犯罪现场的情形。

lemmas.usage_note: 指亲眼目睹事件或犯罪过程的人，常搭配 eyewitness account（目击者叙述）或 eyewitness testimony。

lemmas.def_zh: 亲眼目击，目睹
lemmas.def_en: [T] To see an event, crime, or accident personally with one's own eyes.

examples.en: The elderly war correspondent claimed to have eyewitnessed some of the century's most pivotal battles.
examples.zh: 这位年迈的战地记者声称亲眼目睹了本世纪几场最关键的战役。

lemmas.usage_note: 较罕见作及物动词，表示“亲眼目击或见证某事件”，语体正式，侧重以第一视角亲身经历。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 eyewitness 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 瓜, 甜瓜, 红利, 赃物
lemmas.def_en: any of numerous fruits of the gourd family having a hard rind and sweet juicy flesh

examples.en: They enjoyed slices of chilled, sweet melon on the porch during the hot summer afternoon.
examples.zh: 在炎热的夏日午后，他们坐在门廊上品尝着冰镇清甜的瓜片。

lemmas.usage_note: 指甜瓜类水果；在商业或俚语中常指“大笔利润、分红”或“巨额赃物”，常搭配 cut the melon（分红）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 melon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 重击，重打；砰然撞击；（心脏）怦怦直跳
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To hit someone or something heavily with a fist or blunt object, making a dull sound. 2. [I] To beat strongly and quickly.

examples.en: His heart began to thump wildly against his ribs as footsteps approached in the dark.
examples.zh: 随着黑暗中脚步声逼近，他的心开始在胸膛里剧烈狂跳。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可作不及物动词表心脏“剧烈跳动”，也可作及物动词表用重拳或重物“砰然捶打、猛击”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 thump 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 有利害关系的人, 当事人, 厕所
lemmas.def_en: a room or building equipped with one or more toilets

examples.en: Before modern indoor plumbing was installed, families relied on a small wooden privy behind the house.
examples.zh: 在安装现代室内管道系统之前，一家人全靠屋后的一座小型木质简易厕所。

lemmas.usage_note: 旧时指户外简易厕所或茅坑；在法律语境中指与某诉讼、契约有利害关系的“当事人”或“利益关联人”。

lemmas.def_zh: 暗中, 秘密地
lemmas.def_en: confidentially or in secret

examples.en: told her friend privily that she was planning to be married

family_guide.root_logic: 以 privy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 顺利地, 亲切地, 好意地
lemmas.def_en: showing approval

examples.en: The board responded favorably to our new marketing proposal and approved the necessary budget.
examples.zh: 董事会对我们的新营销方案反响良好，并批准了所需的预算。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰 respond, review, impress 等，意为“赞许地、有利地”，常见搭配 favorably disposed to（倾向于支持）。

lemmas.def_zh: 不利地; 不适宜地; 反对地; 令人不快地
lemmas.def_en: showing disapproval; in a disparaging way

examples.en: he reviewed the play unfavorably

family_guide.root_logic: 以 favorably 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 摩天楼, 三角形天帆
lemmas.def_en: a very tall building with many stories

examples.en: The shimmering glass skyscraper dominates the city's rapidly expanding financial district.
examples.zh: 这座闪闪发光的玻璃幕墙摩天大楼矗立在城市迅速扩张的金融区中心。

lemmas.usage_note: 现代多指超高层摩天大楼，常与 modern, towering 连用；航海旧语中偶指帆船最顶层的三角天帆。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 skyscraper 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 瑞典人
lemmas.def_en: a native or inhabitant of Sweden

examples.en: He met a friendly Swede during his backpacking trip across Northern Europe.
examples.zh: 在穿越北欧的背包旅行中，他结识了一位友善的瑞典人。

lemmas.usage_note: 首字母大写（Swede）指瑞典人；全小写时英式英语中指一种根茎类蔬菜“芜菁甘蓝”（美式为 rutabaga）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 swede 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （使）变暗，（使）变黑；（使情绪等）转为阴沉
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To become dark or darker, or to make something dark or darker; to become or make gloomy.

examples.en: The sky began to darken ominously as thick thunderclouds rolled in from the west.
examples.zh: 随着厚重的雷雨云从西方涌来，天空开始显得阴沉可怖。

lemmas.usage_note: 可及物或不及物，指天色“变暗”或“使变黑”；引申指脸色“沉下来”或情绪变得忧郁沮丧。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 darken 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （使）图像平滑变换；逐步演变成，变化
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] to change smoothly and gradually from one image, shape, or state into another.

examples.en: What started as a peaceful demonstration quickly morphed into a chaotic riot.
examples.zh: 一场原本和平的示威活动迅速演变成了一场混乱的暴乱。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与介词 into 连用，原指图像电脑特技变形，现广泛引申表示事物逐渐且彻底地“演变、转化”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 morph 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 蜂蜜酒, 草地
lemmas.def_en: United States anthropologist noted for her claims about adolescence and sexual behavior in Polynesian cultures (1901-1978)

examples.en: The warriors gathered in the banquet hall to drink mead and celebrate their hard-won victory.
examples.zh: 勇士们聚集在宴会厅里畅饮蜂蜜酒，庆祝他们来之不易的胜利。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指古老的“蜂蜜酒”；文学或诗歌语体中亦可指“草地”（meadow 的古体简称）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mead 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 教父
lemmas.def_en: any man who serves as a sponsor for a child at baptism

examples.en: He was invited to act as godfather to his best friend's newborn daughter.
examples.zh: 他受邀担任挚友刚出生的女儿的教父。

lemmas.usage_note: 指宗教意义上的“教父”，亦常引申为某领域或组织的“教父、元老”，常与 of 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 godfather 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 困境, 窘境
lemmas.def_en: a situation from which extrication is difficult especially an unpleasant or trying one

examples.en: The charity organization called on the public to pay attention to the plight of refugees.
examples.zh: 该慈善组织呼吁公众关注难民的艰难困境。

lemmas.usage_note: 作名词表示“困境、苦难”，书面语色彩浓厚，常见搭配为 the plight of 或 desperate plight。

lemmas.def_zh: 发誓保证，立誓许婚（尤用于 plight one's troth）
lemmas.def_en: [T] (archaic or literary) To solemnly pledge or promise (one's faith or loyalty), especially in marriage.

examples.en: They knelt before the altar to plight their troth in the presence of family and friends.
examples.zh: 他们在亲友面前跪在祭坛前，许下了执子之手的婚誓。

lemmas.usage_note: 作动词表示“发誓、保证”，属古旧或文学用语，常见固定搭配为 plight one's troth（订婚、誓约）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 plight 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 有关处罚的, 刑的, 刑罚的, 刑法上的, (课税)繁重的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to punishment

examples.en: The government proposed urgent reforms to improve living conditions within the penal system.
examples.zh: 政府提出了紧急改革方案，以改善刑罚体系内部的居住条件。

lemmas.usage_note: 作形容词修饰与刑罚相关的制度或法律，常搭配 penal system、penal code、penal colony。

lemmas.def_zh: 与刑罚有关地; 用刑罚, 刑事上
lemmas.def_en: in a punishing manner

family_guide.root_logic: 以 penal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 榆树
lemmas.def_en: any of various trees of the genus Ulmus: important timber or shade trees

examples.en: The old stone cottage stood quietly beneath the shade of a towering elm.
examples.zh: 那座古老的石砌小屋静静伫立在一棵参天榆树的树荫之下。

lemmas.usage_note: 指植物学中的“榆树”或其木材，常用于植物描绘或自然景观中，搭配 Dutch elm disease。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 elm 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 礼拜仪式, 祷告文, 圣餐仪式
lemmas.def_en: a Christian sacrament commemorating the Last Supper by consecrating bread and wine

examples.en: The congregation followed the traditional liturgy printed in the service book.
examples.zh: 会众遵照礼拜用书上印制的传统仪式文本进行祈祷。

lemmas.usage_note: 宗教专用名词，指基督教的礼拜仪式或规范祷告文，常见搭配如 divine liturgy。

lemmas.def_zh: 礼拜仪式的权威
lemmas.def_en: an authority on liturgies

lemmas.def_zh: 礼拜仪式的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or in accord with liturgy

family_guide.root_logic: 以 liturgy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使全神贯注，占据（某人的心头）
lemmas.def_en: [T] (often passive) To fill someone's thoughts completely so that other matters are ignored.

examples.en: Financial worries continued to preoccupy his mind during the entire vacation.
examples.zh: 在整个假期中，财务方面的担忧一直占据着他的思绪。

lemmas.usage_note: 作及物动词表示“使全神贯注、占据心神”，常以被动形式 be preoccupied with 出现。

lemmas.def_zh: 抢先占据, 先人之见, 入神
lemmas.def_en: an idea that preoccupies the mind and holds the attention

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 心事重重的；全神贯注的
lemmas.def_en: deeply absorbed in one's thoughts to the extent of ignoring other things
lemmas.usage_note: 常与介词 with 搭配，形容因某事而无暇他顾，如 preoccupied with work / worries。

examples.en: She seemed preoccupied and barely listened to what I was saying.
examples.zh: 她看起来心事重重，几乎没听我在说什么。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 preoccupy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 漠不关心的, 无重要性的, 中立的
lemmas.def_en: marked by a lack of interest

examples.en: He remained completely indifferent to the emotional pleas of the protesters.
examples.zh: 面对抗议者动之以情的诉求，他依然显得完全无动于衷。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词表示“冷漠的、不在乎的”，常与介词 to 搭配构成 be indifferent to sth。也可以指平庸的。

lemmas.def_zh: 不关心地, 冷淡地, 淡然地
lemmas.def_en: with indifference; in an indifferent manner

examples.en: she shrugged indifferently

lemmas.def_zh: 不重视, 无兴趣, 漠不关心
lemmas.def_en: unbiased impartial unconcern

examples.en: His complete indifference to public opinion astonished his political advisors.
examples.zh: 他对公众舆论表现出的彻底冷漠，令他的政治顾问们大为震惊。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词表示“漠不关心、冷淡”，常与介词 to 或 towards 搭配，如 treat sth with indifference。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 indifferent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可玩的, 可演奏的, 宜玩的, 宜演奏的
lemmas.def_en: capable of or suitable for being played or played on; ; ; ; - P.H.Lang

examples.en: After hours of heavy rain, the referee declared that the football pitch was no longer playable.
examples.zh: 经过数小时的暴雨后，裁判宣布该足球场已不再适合进行比赛。

lemmas.usage_note: 指场地、游戏“适于比赛的、可游玩的”，常修饰 pitch、character（游戏可用角色）等。

lemmas.def_zh: 无法用乐器演奏的
lemmas.def_en: not capable of or suitable for being played or played on

examples.en: the golf ball was in an unplayable lie
the field was unplayable

family_guide.root_logic: 以 playable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 惊骇, 吃惊
lemmas.def_en: an emotion experienced in anticipation of some specific pain or danger (usually accompanied by a desire to flee or fight)

examples.en: The sudden loud bang behind the door gave everyone in the room a terrible fright.
examples.zh: 门后突然传来的一声巨响把房间里的所有人都狠狠吓了一跳。

lemmas.usage_note: 作不可数或可数名词，指“惊骇、突然的恐惧”，常见搭配有 get a fright 或 in fright。

lemmas.def_zh: 可怕的, 惊人的, 丑的, 非常的
lemmas.def_en: provoking horror; ; ; ; - Winston Churchill

examples.en: an atrocious automobile accident
a frightful crime of decapitation

lemmas.def_zh: 可怕地, (非正式)非常地
lemmas.def_en: used as intensifiers

examples.en: terribly interesting
I'm awful sorry

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fright 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 狂人, 疯子
lemmas.def_en: an insane person

examples.en: He drives like a maniac on the highway, ignoring all traffic signals.
examples.zh: 他在公路上开车像个疯子，对所有的交通信号灯视而不见。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指言行疯狂的人，或对某事痴迷狂热者；常见搭配如 homicidal maniac（杀人狂）、fitness maniac。

lemmas.def_zh: 躁狂的, 狂乱的, 狂热的, 疯狂的
lemmas.def_en: wildly disordered

examples.en: a maniacal frenzy

lemmas.def_zh: 疯狂地
lemmas.def_en: in a maniacal manner or to a maniacal degree

examples.en: he was maniacally obsessed with jealousy

family_guide.root_logic: 以 maniac 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 珐琅, 瓷釉
lemmas.def_en: hard white substance covering the crown of a tooth

examples.en: Acidic drinks can gradually wear away the enamel on your teeth.
examples.zh: 酸性饮料会逐渐腐蚀牙齿表面的牙釉质。

lemmas.usage_note: 多指涂覆在金属等表面的瓷釉、搪瓷，或指牙齿的牙釉质；常见搭配有 tooth enamel、vitreous enamel。

lemmas.def_zh: 涂以瓷釉，上搪瓷；给……施彩饰
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To coat metal, pottery, or a surface with smooth, glossy protective enamel.

examples.en: The artisan carefully enameled the copper vase with intricate floral patterns.
examples.zh: 手工艺人细心地在铜瓶表面涂上瓷釉，绘出繁复的花卉图案。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指在金属或陶瓷器物表面涂饰瓷釉；常以被动形式出现，搭配介词 with 或 in。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 enamel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 引出，探出（信息）；诱发，引起（反应）
lemmas.def_en: [T] (+ from) To manage to get information, facts, or a reaction from someone.

examples.en: The detective asked specific questions to elicit the truth from the suspect.
examples.zh: 侦探提出具体的问题，试图从嫌疑人口中套出真相。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面动词，指巧妙地引出或诱导出事实、答复或情绪反应；常见搭配如 elicit a response/sympathy/information。

lemmas.def_zh: 引出, 诱出, 抽出
lemmas.def_en: stimulation that calls up (draws forth) a particular class of behaviors

examples.en: the elicitation of his testimony was not easy

family_guide.root_logic: 以 elicit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 萧瑟的, 荒凉的, 阴冷的
lemmas.def_en: offering little or no hope; ; ; - J.M.Synge

examples.en: The economic forecast for the upcoming quarter looks increasingly bleak.
examples.zh: 下一季度的经济预测看起来愈发暗淡无望。

lemmas.usage_note: 可形容天气阴冷、景色荒凉，或比喻前途暗淡无望；常见搭配有 a bleak winter、bleak future、bleak landscape。

lemmas.def_zh: 缺少颜色、缺少植被、缺少友爱的性质和状态
lemmas.def_en: a bleak and desolate atmosphere

examples.en: the nakedness of the landscape

lemmas.def_zh: 风吹雨打地；荒凉地；阴郁地
lemmas.def_en: without hope

examples.en: he wondered bleakly

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bleak 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 修剪（树枝等）；删减，削减（开支、人员等）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] to cut off dead or overgrown branches from a tree or shrub. 2. [T] to reduce the size or extent of something by removing unnecessary parts.

examples.en: The company decided to prune its budget by cutting non-essential travel costs.
examples.zh: 公司决定通过削减非必要的差旅费用来压缩预算。

lemmas.usage_note: 可指园艺修剪枝叶，亦广泛用于比喻精简预算、删节冗余文字；常搭配 prune back、prune down、prune expenses。

lemmas.def_zh: 修枝剪刀, 修剪树枝者
lemmas.def_en: a worker who thins out and trims trees and shrubs

examples.en: untouched by the pruner's axe

family_guide.root_logic: 以 prune 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 鹬鸵, 地勤人员, 新西兰人
lemmas.def_en: climbing vine native to China; cultivated in New Zealand for its fuzzy edible fruit with green meat

examples.en: The sanctuary is dedicated to protecting the endangered brown kiwi.
examples.zh: 该保护区致力于保护濒临灭绝的褐几维鸟。

lemmas.usage_note: 多指新西兰国鸟几维鸟，或口语代指新西兰人（首字母常大写），亦常简称奇异果（kiwifruit）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kiwi 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （用煤烟等）熏黑，弄黑
lemmas.def_en: [T] (archaic or dialect) To blacken or begrime with soot or coal dust.

examples.en: The soot from the malfunctioning chimney will colly the white ceiling.
examples.zh: 故障烟囱冒出的煤烟会把白色的天花板熏黑。

lemmas.usage_note: 古英语或方言词汇，指用煤烟或煤尘把某物熏黑、弄脏；在现代英语中罕见，多见于文学作品。

lemmas.def_zh: 煤矿工人, 运煤船, 运煤船员
lemmas.def_en: someone who works in a coal mine

examples.en: Life was perilous for an underground collier during the industrial revolution.
examples.zh: 工业革命时期，井下煤矿工人的生活充满了危险。

lemmas.usage_note: 旧式或行业名词，多指从事开采的煤矿工人，亦可指专门运煤的船只或船员。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 colly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 勃艮第(法国一地区), 勃艮第葡萄酒
lemmas.def_en: a former province of eastern France that is famous for its wines

examples.en: She ordered a fine bottle of Burgundy to accompany the roasted duck.
examples.zh: 她点了一瓶优质的勃艮第红葡萄酒来佐烤鸭。

lemmas.usage_note: 首字母大写时指法国勃艮第葡萄酒或产区，小写时常代指紫红色、深红褐色；搭配如 a glass of Burgundy。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 burgundy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可鄙的, 卑劣的
lemmas.def_en: morally reprehensible

examples.en: Betraying his closest friends for personal gain was a despicable act.
examples.zh: 为了个人利益出卖最亲近的朋友是一种可鄙的行为。

lemmas.usage_note: 强烈的贬义形容词，指道德上极其卑劣、下流且令人作呕的行为或人；常见搭配 a despicable act/crime。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 despicable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 奴役, 束缚
lemmas.def_en: the state of being under the control of a force or influence or abstract power; he sought release from his bondage to Satana self freed from the bondage of time"

examples.en: The captured soldiers were held in bondage until the treaty was signed.
examples.zh: 被俘虏的士兵一直处于被奴役的状态，直到条约签署。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，书面语指被奴役、失去自由的束缚状态，或比喻思想枷锁；常见搭配 escape from bondage、be held in bondage。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bondage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 石板瓦工, 铺石板者
lemmas.def_en: any of various small terrestrial isopods having a flat elliptical segmented body; found in damp habitats

examples.en: The contractor hired a skilled slater to restore the historic chapel's leaking roof.
examples.zh: 承包商雇了一名熟练的石板瓦工来修复历史小教堂漏雨的屋顶。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，指铺石板瓦的工匠或（英式方言中的）潮虫，建筑领域常用于描述屋面施工作业人员。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 slater 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 芝麻
lemmas.def_en: East Indian annual erect herb; source of sesame seed or benniseed and sesame oil

examples.en: Sprinkle some toasted sesame seeds over the stir-fried noodles before serving.
examples.zh: 上菜前在炒面上撒上一些烤熟的芝麻粒。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，常作不可数，指芝麻或芝麻植物；高频搭配包括 sesame oil（芝麻油）与 sesame seed（芝麻粒）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sesame 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 鸦片
lemmas.def_en: an addictive narcotic extracted from seed capsules of the opium poppy

examples.en: The cultivation of the poppy plant for illicit opium production has strictly declined.
examples.zh: 用于非法生产鸦片的罂粟种植量已大幅下降。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，指鸦片毒品；常与 war、addiction、poppy 等词搭配，多见于历史、禁毒或医药语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 opium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 向前, 前进, 在先
lemmas.def_en: forward in time or order or degree

examples.en: Despite the severe snowstorm, the determined hikers pressed onward toward the summit.
examples.zh: 尽管遭遇了严重的暴风雪，意志坚定的登山者们仍继续向峰顶进发。

lemmas.usage_note: 副词，意为“向前、继续”，常与 march、press、move 连用，或构成 from...onward（从……起一直）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 onward 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 人力
lemmas.def_en: the force of workers available

examples.en: The factory suffered from a severe manpower shortage during the peak harvest season.
examples.zh: 在收获高峰期，这家工厂遭遇了严重的人力短缺。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，指劳动力或人力资源，属于书面正式用语；高频搭配为 manpower shortage（人手短缺）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 manpower 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 蕃茄酱
lemmas.def_en: thick spicy sauce made from tomatoes

examples.en: He squeezed a generous dollop of tomato ketchup next to his plate of fries.
examples.zh: 他在自己那盘薯条旁挤了一大团番茄酱。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，指番茄酱；常与 dip into、squeeze 等动词搭配，广泛用于日常餐饮和快餐场景。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ketchup 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 希腊文第十个字母(K)
lemmas.def_en: the 10th letter of the Greek alphabet

examples.en: In statistics, Cohen's kappa is widely used to measure inter-rater reliability.
examples.zh: 在统计学中，科恩卡帕系数被广泛用于测量评估者间的一致性。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，指希腊字母表的第十个字母（Κ, κ）；常用于学术统计、科学命名及大学兄弟会名称中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kappa 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 猪, 卑鄙的家伙
lemmas.def_en: stout-bodied short-legged omnivorous animals

examples.en: I cannot believe that treacherous swine stole money from his own elderly parents.
examples.zh: 我真不敢相信那个卑鄙的家伙竟然偷了自己年迈父母的钱。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，单复同形；农牧语境指“猪”（较正式），日常口语中多作贬义词，斥责“卑鄙无耻的家伙”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 swine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不宽容, 偏狭, 不容许相反的言论
lemmas.def_en: impatience with annoyances

examples.en: Religious intolerance has fueled conflicts and division across the region for centuries.
examples.zh: 几个世纪以来，宗教上的不宽容加剧了该地区的冲突与分裂。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，既可指思想上的“不容忍、偏狭”，也可指医学上的“耐受不良”（如 lactose intolerance）。

lemmas.def_zh: 不容忍的, 不容异说的, 偏执的, 偏狭的, 不宽容的, 不耐的, 不耐性的
lemmas.def_en: unwilling to tolerate difference of opinion

examples.en: The authoritarian regime proved utterly intolerant of any peaceful political opposition.
examples.zh: 该威权政权表现得对任何和平的政治反对派都极不容忍。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，表示“偏执的、不宽容的”或“耐受不良的”；常与介词 of 连用（如 intolerant of dissent）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 intolerance 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 弓射手, 持弓的兵, 船首的划手
lemmas.def_en: a person who is expert in the use of a bow and arrow

examples.en: The medieval army relied heavily on the lethal accuracy of each skilled bowman.
examples.zh: 这支中世纪军队严重依赖每位熟练弓箭手的致命精准度。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指“弓箭手”（复数形式为 bowmen），或在赛艇运动中特指“船首划手”；多见于历史与军事叙事。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bowman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 开创性的, 突破性的
lemmas.def_en: being or producing something like nothing done or experienced or created before

examples.en: Her groundbreaking research on gene editing paved the way for novel therapeutic approaches.
examples.zh: 她在基因编辑方面的开创性研究为新的治疗方法铺平了道路。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰research, discovery或technology，表具有划时代意义或重大突破，多用于褒义书面语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 groundbreaking 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 本能的, 天生的, 直觉的
lemmas.def_en: unthinking; prompted by (or as if by) instinct

examples.en: His instinctive reaction to the loud noise was to duck under the nearest table.
examples.zh: 听到那声巨响，他的本能反应是迅速躲到最近的桌子底下。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰reaction, fear或knowledge，强调出于本能而非后天学习或深思熟虑，多用于中性语境。

lemmas.def_zh: 本能地, 直觉地
lemmas.def_en: as a matter of instinct

examples.en: he instinctively grabbed the knife

family_guide.root_logic: 以 instinctive 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 强制地, 用力地
lemmas.def_en: in a forcible manner

examples.en: The squatters were forcibly evicted from the abandoned building by law enforcement officers.
examples.zh: 非法占居者被执法人员强行逐出了那栋废弃建筑。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与removed, evicted或remind连用，既可指物理上的“强制地、暴力地”，也可指观点“有力地”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 forcibly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 乙醇, 酒精
lemmas.def_en: the intoxicating agent in fermented and distilled liquors; used pure or denatured as a solvent or in medicines and colognes and cleaning solutions and rocket fuel; proposed as a renewable clean-burning additive to gasoline

examples.en: Many modern vehicles are designed to run efficiently on gasoline blended with ethanol.
examples.zh: 许多现代汽车被设计为可以使用混合了乙醇的汽油高效行驶。

lemmas.usage_note: 专业及科技词汇，指乙醇或作为生物燃料的酒精，常与fuel, production或blend搭配使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ethanol 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （苏格兰）自己的
lemmas.def_en: belonging to or on behalf of a specified person (especially yourself); preceded by a possessive

examples.en: He longed to return to his ain country after spending years wandering abroad.
examples.zh: 在异国他乡漂泊多年后，他渴望回到自己的故乡。

lemmas.usage_note: 苏格兰方言词，等同于own，必须置于物主代词之后（如my ain, his ain），用于文学或方言语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ain 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 下层社会, 地狱, 下流社会
lemmas.def_en: the criminal class

examples.en: The police launched an extensive undercover operation to dismantle the city's criminal underworld.
examples.zh: 警方发起了一项代号严密的卧底行动，以瓦解该市的黑社会犯罪集团。

lemmas.usage_note: 常带定冠词the，既可指黑社会、犯罪团伙（如criminal underworld），也可指神话中的冥界。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 underworld 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 象征主义, 符号论
lemmas.def_en: a system of symbols and symbolic representations

examples.en: The author used the recurring image of a caged bird as heavy symbolism for loss of freedom.
examples.zh: 作者反复使用笼中鸟的意象，作为失去自由的强烈象征。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，指象征手法、意义或象征主义流派，常与religious, rich或political搭配。

lemmas.def_zh: 符号使用者, 象征主义者, 符号学者
lemmas.def_en: a member of an artistic movement that expressed ideas indirectly via symbols

examples.en: The famous French symbolist poet often used subtle metaphors to express hidden emotional depths.
examples.zh: 这位著名的法国象征主义诗人常用精妙的隐喻来表达深层情感。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 symbolism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 下木, 林下灌丛
lemmas.def_en: the brush (small trees and bushes and ferns etc.) growing beneath taller trees in a wood or forest

examples.en: The frightened deer quickly darted into the dense underwood and disappeared from view.
examples.zh: 受惊的鹿迅速窜入茂密的林下灌木丛中，从视线中消失了。

lemmas.usage_note: 集合名词，常作不可数，指生长在大树下的小树和灌木丛（林下植被），多见于自然描写与林业语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 underwood 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 淀粉, 浆糊, 刻板
lemmas.def_en: a complex carbohydrate found chiefly in seeds, fruits, tubers, roots and stem pith of plants, notably in corn, potatoes, wheat, and rice; an important foodstuff and used otherwise especially in adhesives and as fillers and stiffeners for paper and textiles

examples.en: Potatoes and rice are staple crops that provide high amounts of dietary starch.
examples.zh: 土豆和大米是能够提供大量膳食淀粉的主要农作物。

lemmas.usage_note: 物质名词，指作为营养成分的淀粉或用于浆衣服的浆粉，也可用引申义指人举止刻板、拘谨。

lemmas.def_zh: 淀粉的, 浆糊的, 浆糊状的, 古板的
lemmas.def_en: consisting of or containing starch

examples.en: starchy foods

lemmas.def_zh: （用淀粉浆）使变硬，上浆
lemmas.def_en: [T] to make clothes, linen, or fabric stiff and crisp by applying starch

examples.en: The laundry service starches the tuxedo collars heavily to keep them stiff and crisp.
examples.zh: 洗衣店把燕尾服的领子重重地上浆，以使其保持挺括平整。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指用浆粉把衣物、织物等“上浆浆硬”，常与shirt, collar或linen等名词连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 starch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person active in party politics

examples.en: The veteran pol knew exactly how to evade tough questions from the media during the press conference.
examples.zh: 这位经验丰富的政客在新闻发布会上非常清楚如何回避媒体的刁钻提问。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，为politician的非正式口语缩写，常带有轻微戏谑或贬损意味，指职业政客。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pol 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 制服，击败，压倒；（情绪、气味等）使难以忍受，使不知所措
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To defeat or subdue someone by using superior physical strength, numbers, or force. 2. [T] (of an emotion, smell, or heat) To have such a strong effect on someone that they cannot resist or think clearly.

examples.en: The security guards managed to overpower the intruder before he could reach the vault.
examples.zh: 安保人员在那名入侵者接近金库之前成功将其制服。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指以压倒性力量制服对手或情感彻底压倒理智，常用于被动语态或军事、情绪语境。

lemmas.def_zh: overpowering的变形
lemmas.def_en: incapable of being resisted

examples.en: the candy looked overwhelmingly desirable to the dieting man

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 压倒性的；不可抗拒的；刺鼻强烈的
lemmas.def_en: extremely strong or intense, so as to be irresistible or difficult to endure
lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰气味、欲望、情感或恐惧，如 an overpowering smell / desire / fear。

examples.en: An overpowering smell of burning plastic filled the kitchen.
examples.zh: 一股刺鼻强烈的塑料燃烧味弥漫在厨房里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 overpower 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 拳斗，切磋；争论，争辩
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To practice boxing with light punches without trying to hurt each other. 2. [I] (+ with) To argue or disagree in a lively but usually harmless way.

examples.en: The two politicians continued to spar with each other throughout the televised debate.
examples.zh: 两位政治家在整场电视辩论中不断唇枪舌剑。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，既指拳击实战练习，也常引申为口头争辩，常与介词 with 搭配使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 spar 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 胃, 肚子
lemmas.def_en: slang for a paunch

examples.en: The little girl complained of a tummy ache after eating too many green apples.
examples.zh: 小女孩吃了太多未熟的青苹果后抱怨肚子疼。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，胃或肚子的儿语化非正式表达，多用于儿童用语、口语及医学沟通中化解紧张。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tummy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 垃圾堆；垃圾填埋地
lemmas.def_en: a low area that has been filled in

examples.en: The council aims to divert 80 percent of household waste away from the local landfill.
examples.zh: 市议会旨在将80%的生活垃圾转移出当地垃圾填埋场。

lemmas.usage_note: 指垃圾填埋场或填埋方式，常作为不可数名词表处置方式，也可作可数名词表具体场地。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 landfill 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （军队）大举攻占，席卷；（害虫、杂草等）肆虐，泛滥；超过（限度、时间）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] to invade, spread over, or occupy a place rapidly and in large numbers. 2. [I, T] to exceed an allotted limit, budget, or scheduled time.

examples.en: Abandoned for decades, the ancient garden was soon overrun by wild weeds and briars.
examples.zh: 荒废数十年后，这座古老的花园很快被杂草和荆棘侵占。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物或不及物动词，指害虫或杂草泛滥、敌军侵占席卷，或指时间、预算超出预定限制。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 overrun 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 妓院
lemmas.def_en: a building where prostitutes are available

examples.en: Police officers shut down an illegal brothel operating behind a massage parlor front.
examples.zh: 警方查封了一家伪装成按摩店营业的非法妓院。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指妓院，属于直接客观的法律与社会学词汇，常用于新闻报道和执法语境中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 brothel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 迫切的, 严厉的, 银根紧的
lemmas.def_en: demanding strict attention to rules and procedures

examples.en: The aviation industry must comply with stringent safety regulations to prevent accidents.
examples.zh: 航空业必须遵守极其严格的安全规章以防止事故发生。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式形容词，修饰规则、标准时意为“严格紧缩的”，修饰金融环境时意为“银根吃紧的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 严格地, 严厉地
lemmas.def_en: in a stringent manner

examples.en: the laws are stringently enforced
stringently controlled

lemmas.def_zh: 严格, 严厉, 说服力, 迫切, 银根紧
lemmas.def_en: a state occasioned by scarcity of money and a shortage of credit

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stringent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （在垃圾中）搜寻（有用物或食物）；以（腐肉等）为食；打扫
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To search through discarded waste, garbage, or carcasses for food or usable items. 2. [T] (of an animal) To feed on carrion or decaying organic matter. 3. [T] To clean or clear away.

examples.en: Stray dogs scavenged for scraps of food among the discarded garbage bins behind the restaurant.
examples.zh: 流浪狗在餐馆后面废弃的垃圾桶里翻找残羹剩饭。

lemmas.usage_note: 可用作及物或不及物动词，指食腐动物觅食或人在废弃物中搜寻可用之物，常接介词 for。

lemmas.def_zh: (英)清道夫, 清扫工, 拾垃圾的人, 清除剂, 净化剂, 食腐动物, 黄色作家
lemmas.def_en: a chemical agent that is added to a chemical mixture to counteract the effects of impurities

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scavenge 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 宽松的上衣
lemmas.def_en: a top worn by women

examples.en: She paired a crisp white silk blouse with dark tailored trousers for the interview.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件清爽的白色真丝女衬衫搭配深色西装裤去参加面试。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，专指女式衬衫或宽松短上衣，多用于日常服装、职场着装等搭配语境中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 blouse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 围攻，包围；围扰，蜂拥而至
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (military) To surround a town or fortress with armed forces to cut off supplies and force surrender. 2. [T] To overwhelm or harass someone with persistent requests or questions.

examples.en: Fans besieged the pop star outside the hotel entrance, desperately asking for autographs.
examples.zh: 粉丝们在酒店门口团团围住这位流行歌星，急切地索要签名。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，本义为军事围攻，引申为群众围堵或大量请求、问题接踵而至，常用于被动语态。

lemmas.def_zh: 围攻者, 围攻军
lemmas.def_en: an enemy who lays siege to your position

family_guide.root_logic: 以 besiege 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 化装外衣, 面具, 骨牌, 多米诺骨牌
lemmas.def_en: United States rhythm and blues pianist and singer and composer (born in 1928)

examples.en: The collapse of the major investment bank triggered a domino effect across global financial markets.
examples.zh: 这家大型投资银行的倒闭在全球金融市场引发了多米诺骨牌效应。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指骨牌或面具，常用于比喻短语 domino effect（多米诺骨牌效应）中，多见于书面政经评论。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 domino 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 深褐色的
lemmas.def_en: marked by dark or relatively dark pigmentation of hair or skin or eyes

examples.en: She decided to dye her naturally blonde hair to a warm brunette shade for the winter.
examples.zh: 她决定在这个冬天把自己天生的金发染成温暖的深褐色。

lemmas.usage_note: 用于形容女性头发或肤色为深褐色的，通常修饰 hair 或用于描述女性外貌，属于日常书面语。

lemmas.def_zh: 浅黑肤色的女人
lemmas.def_en: a person with dark (brown) hair

examples.en: The tall brunette standing near the entrance was introduced as the firm's new chief architect.
examples.zh: 站在入口附近的那位高个子深发女子被介绍为公司新任首席建筑师。

lemmas.usage_note: 特指深褐色头发或浅黑肤色的白人女性，常作为描述人物外貌的名词单独使用，口语和文学中均常见。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 brunette 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 承保，为……投保；包销（证券）；资助，为……提供资金担保
lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. (finance) to accept financial responsibility for an insurance policy, bond issue, or loan. 2. to support a project financially by agreeing to cover losses.

examples.en: A consortium of international banks agreed to underwrite the multimillion-dollar infrastructure bond.
examples.zh: 一家国际银行财团同意承销这笔数百万美元的基础设施债券。

lemmas.usage_note: 金融与保险专业及商务公文词汇，常搭配 an offering 或 an insurance policy，指包销证券或承保风险。

lemmas.def_zh: 保险业者, 证券包销者
lemmas.def_en: a banker who deals chiefly in underwriting new securities

family_guide.root_logic: 以 underwrite 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不满
lemmas.def_en: a longing for something better than the present situation

examples.en: Rising inflation and stagnant wages fueled widespread public discontent with the current economic policies.
examples.zh: 不断上升的通胀和停滞不前的工资加剧了公众对当前经济政策的广泛不满。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示不满情绪，多用作不可数名词，常与 fuel、voice、widespread 连用，多见于政经与社会议题报道。

lemmas.def_zh: 不满, 不平
lemmas.def_en: a longing for something better than the present situation

lemmas.def_zh: 使不满，使不快
lemmas.def_en: [T] (formal or archaic) to make someone dissatisfied or discontented.

examples.en: The harsh working conditions and lack of promotional opportunities discontented the younger employees.
examples.zh: 恶劣的工作条件和晋升机会的匮乏使年轻员工们感到心怀不满。

lemmas.usage_note: 极少使用的及物动词（现代英语多用其过去分词作形容词 discontented），意为使不满足或使不高兴，语体正式且生僻。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 discontent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 错误的, 不正确的
lemmas.def_en: containing or characterized by error

examples.en: The researchers had to retract the paper after discovering that their initial findings were based on erroneous data.
examples.zh: 研究人员在发现他们最初的研究结果是基于错误数据后，不得不撤回了这篇论文。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面语，常修饰 assumption、conclusion、belief 等词，表示基于错误信息或逻辑而得出的错误认知。

lemmas.def_zh: 错误, 不正确
lemmas.def_en: in a mistaken manner

examples.en: he mistakenly believed it

family_guide.root_logic: 以 erroneous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 逐步灌输，传授（思想、原则等）；滴注
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (+ in/into) To gradually put a feeling, idea, or principle into someone's mind so that it becomes firmly established. 2. [T] (medical) To put a liquid into something drop by drop.

examples.en: Her parents worked hard to instill a strong sense of integrity and compassion in her from an early age.
examples.zh: 她的父母自幼便努力向她灌输强烈的正直感与同情心。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用搭配为 instill sth in/into sb，意为潜移默化地灌输价值观或习惯，多用于家庭教育或企业文化语境。

lemmas.def_zh: 慢慢灌输, 滴注法, 滴剂
lemmas.def_en: the introduction of a liquid (by pouring or injection) drop by drop

family_guide.root_logic: 以 instill 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 听得见的
lemmas.def_en: heard or perceptible by the ear

examples.en: Her quiet voice was barely audible over the roaring traffic outside the conference room.
examples.zh: 在会议室外隆隆的交通噪音衬托下，她轻柔的声音几乎听不见。

lemmas.usage_note: 指声音足够大能被听见，常修饰 sigh、whisper、sound，或用作表语与 barely、clearly 连用，属通用书面语。

lemmas.def_zh: 清晰度, 可闻度
lemmas.def_en: quality or fact or degree of being audible or perceptible by the ear

family_guide.root_logic: 以 audible 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 狭小空间, 鸡笼, 捕鱼篓
lemmas.def_en: a farm building for housing poultry

examples.en: Every evening before sunset, the farmer locks the chickens safely inside the wooden coop to protect them from foxes.
examples.zh: 每天傍晚日落前，农夫都会把鸡安全地锁在木制鸡舍里，以防狐狸侵袭。

lemmas.usage_note: 日常农业及通用词汇，最常指鸡舍（chicken coop），也可泛指关家禽的小笼子或狭窄逼仄的空间。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 coop 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 睡眠状态的, 静止的
lemmas.def_en: in a condition of biological rest or suspended animation

examples.en: The bank notified the customer that her account had been classified as dormant due to three years of inactivity.
examples.zh: 银行通知该客户，由于三年未活动，她的账户已被归类为休眠账户。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于科学（休眠的火山/种子）或经济法律（休眠账户），常与 volcano、account、lie 搭配，较正式。

lemmas.def_zh: 静止的, 不活动的, 寂静的
lemmas.def_en: not active or activated

examples.en: The volcano remained quiescent for centuries before suddenly showing renewed signs of life.
examples.zh: 这座火山沉寂了几个世纪，随后突然重新显现出活动的迹象。

lemmas.def_zh: 不活动性, 休眠, 蛰伏
lemmas.def_en: a state of quiet (but possibly temporary) inaction

examples.en: the volcano erupted after centuries of dormancy

lemmas.def_zh: 静止, 不活动, 寂静
lemmas.def_en: a state of quiet (but possibly temporary) inaction

examples.en: The dormant volcano remained in a state of peaceful quiescence for several centuries.
examples.zh: 这座休眠火山在几个世纪里一直保持着平静的静止状态。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dormant 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 脊椎, 椎骨
lemmas.def_en: one of the bony segments of the spinal column

examples.en: The magnetic resonance scan revealed a hairline fracture in his third lumbar vertebra after the cycling accident.
examples.zh: 核磁共振扫描显示，在那场自行车事故后，他的第三腰椎出现了一处细微骨折。

lemmas.usage_note: 解剖学与医学专业名词，复数形式通常为 vertebrae，指单块脊椎骨，常与 cervical、lumbar 连用。

lemmas.def_zh: 椎骨的, 脊椎的, 由椎骨构成的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or constituting vertebrae

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vertebra 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 农舍
lemmas.def_en: house for a farmer and family

examples.en: They spent the summer renovating an old stone farmhouse in the countryside.
examples.zh: 他们在乡下度过了整个夏天，翻修了一座古老的石头农舍。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指农场中的住宅建筑，常与 rustic、old、stone 等形容词连用，搭配介词 in 或 at。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 farmhouse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 宇宙飞船
lemmas.def_en: a spacecraft designed to carry a crew into interstellar space (especially in science fiction)

examples.en: The astronauts boarded the spaceship just hours before the scheduled launch.
examples.zh: 宇航员在预定发射前数小时登上了宇宙飞船。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指载人或无人宇宙飞船，科幻与航天语境常用，常与 launch、board 等动词搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 spaceship 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 举起（试重量）；用力举起，抬起
lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. To lift or hold something heavy, especially to test or estimate its weight. 2. To heave or lift up with effort.

examples.en: He hefted the heavy suitcase to judge whether it exceeded the airline's weight limit.
examples.zh: 他掂了掂那个沉重的行李箱，看看是否超过了航空公司的限重。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指用手掂量某物的重量或用力举起，常接箱子、武器或重物作宾语，动作感极强。

lemmas.def_zh: 重的, 肌肉发达的
lemmas.def_en: (of a person) possessing physical strength and weight; rugged and powerful

examples.en: a hefty athlete
a muscular boxer

family_guide.root_logic: 以 heft 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使恢复元气，使复苏，使重获新生
lemmas.def_en: [T] To give new life, energy, vitality, or success to something that has become weak or inactive.

examples.en: The government launched a comprehensive plan to revitalize the declining local economy.
examples.zh: 政府启动了一项全面计划，旨在重振日渐衰退的当地经济。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，多用于政经、文化语境，常与 economy、community、neighborhood 等抽象名词搭配。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 复苏, 回生, 复新
lemmas.def_en: bringing again into activity and prominence

examples.en: the revival of trade
a revival of a neglected play by Moliere

family_guide.root_logic: 以 revitalize 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 灯芯, 油绳
lemmas.def_en: any piece of cord that conveys liquid by capillary action

examples.en: She trimmed the candle wick before lighting it to prevent excess smoke.
examples.zh: 她在点燃蜡烛前修剪了烛芯，以防止产生过多烟雾。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指蜡烛或油灯的引线、灯芯，常搭配动词 trim（修剪）、light（点燃）或 burn。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wick 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 水壶, 监牢, 模仿夜莺的叫声
lemmas.def_en: a large bottle with a narrow mouth

examples.en: She poured fresh orange juice into a glass from a large glass jug.
examples.zh: 她从一个大玻璃壶里把新鲜橙汁倒进杯子里。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，常指带柄和倾倒口的带嘴大壶；口语中亦可指“监狱”（常作 the jug），搭配 a jug of。

lemmas.def_zh: 把……关押入狱；（在罐中）焖炖
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (informal) To put someone in prison. 2. [T] To stew meat (especially hare) slowly in a closed container or pot.

examples.en: The chef jugged the hare with red wine, herbs, and root vegetables for hours.
examples.zh: 厨师用红酒、香草和根茎类蔬菜将野兔肉在陶罐中慢炖了数小时。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，烹饪专业语境指将肉类（如兔肉）放入陶罐中慢炖；非正式俚语中指“关进监狱”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jug 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 伪造的, 假的, 不可信的, 华而不实的
lemmas.def_en: fraudulent; having a misleading appearance

examples.en: She greeted everyone with a phony smile that barely masked her irritation.
examples.zh: 她带着虚伪的微笑向每个人打招呼，这几乎掩饰不住她的恼怒。

lemmas.usage_note: 口语与非正式用语，修饰人时指“虚伪的”，修饰物时指“伪造的”，常搭配 smile、accent、passport。

lemmas.def_zh: 假货, 假冒者, 赝品
lemmas.def_en: a person who professes beliefs and opinions that he or she does not hold in order to conceal his or her real feelings or motives

examples.en: It didn't take long for the team to realize that their new manager was a complete phony.
examples.zh: 没过多久，团队就意识到他们的新经理是个彻头彻尾的骗子。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，非正式口语表达，指虚伪透顶的人或假冒者，也指赝品，常用于贬义批评语境中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 phony 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 锄头
lemmas.def_en: a tool with a flat blade attached at right angles to a long handle

examples.en: He grabbed a rusty hoe from the shed and began clearing weeds from the vegetable patch.
examples.zh: 他从棚子里拿出一把生锈的锄头，开始清理菜地里的杂草。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指农业或园艺中用来松土、除草的短柄或长柄锄头，常与 garden、handle 等搭配。

lemmas.def_zh: 用锄头锄（地），锄除（杂草）
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To dig, loosen soil, or weed ground using a hoe.

examples.en: The gardener spent the entire morning hoeing between the rows of young lettuce.
examples.zh: 园丁花了一整个上午在成排的幼嫩生菜之间锄草松土。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可用作及物也可作不及物动词，指用锄头耕地或锄除杂草，常接 weeds、soil 或 field 作宾语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hoe 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 短吻鳄
lemmas.def_en: leather made from alligator's hide

examples.en: A large alligator was spotted basking in the sun along the edge of the swamp.
examples.zh: 有人看到一只巨大的短吻鳄在沼泽边晒太阳。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，特指短吻鳄（与 crocodile 相对），常用于野生动物保护、沼泽栖息地等自然语境。

lemmas.def_zh: （油漆、涂层等）龟裂，开裂成鳄皮状
lemmas.def_en: [I] (of paint, varnish, or asphalt) To crack into a rough pattern resembling alligator skin.

examples.en: Years of sun exposure caused the thick paint on the exterior wall to alligator and peel.
examples.zh: 多年的日晒导致外墙上厚厚的油漆出现龟裂并剥落。

lemmas.usage_note: 罕见专业动词，指油漆、沥青等表面因老化干裂而形成如同鳄鱼皮般龟裂纹路，多用于材料工程。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 alligator 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 摆动，振荡；（在两种观点、情感之间）摇摆不定
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] to move repeatedly from one position to another and back again at a regular speed. 2. [I] to keep changing between two extreme opinions, moods, or states

examples.en: His mood seemed to oscillate between extreme optimism and deep despair.
examples.zh: 他的情绪似乎总在极度乐观与深深绝望之间反复摇摆。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可作及物也可作不及物动词，物理上指摆动、振动；引申指在两种观点、情绪或状态之间摇摆不定（常接 between... and...）。

lemmas.def_zh: 振动, 动摇, 变动, 彷徨, 电波
lemmas.def_en: the process of oscillating between states

lemmas.def_zh: 振动的, 动摇的, 变动的
lemmas.def_en: having periodic vibrations

examples.en: The pendulum continued its steady oscillatory motion until the clock finally stopped.
examples.zh: 钟摆继续保持着稳定的往复摆动，直到时钟最终停下来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 oscillate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 宣誓书, 书面陈述
lemmas.def_en: written declaration made under oath; a written statement sworn to be true before someone legally authorized to administer an oath

examples.en: The witness signed a sworn affidavit detailing the events of that night.
examples.zh: 目击者签署了一份详述当晚经过的宣誓书。

lemmas.usage_note: 法律正式用词，常与 sign, file, sworn 搭配，指经宣誓后签署的书面证词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 affidavit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 狂欢作乐，纵情庆祝；陶醉于，沉醉于（revel in）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To celebrate, dance, or drink in a noisy, lively way. 2. [I] ('revel in') To get great pleasure, satisfaction, or delight from something.

examples.en: She seemed to revel in the unexpected attention from the national media.
examples.zh: 她似乎非常享受来自全国媒体的这番意料之外的关注。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与介词 in 连用表示“沉溺于、极度享受”，单独使用多指通宵达旦地欢宴狂欢。

lemmas.def_zh: 闹饮, 狂欢
lemmas.def_en: unrestrained merrymaking

lemmas.def_zh: 狂欢者, 欢宴者
lemmas.def_en: a celebrant who shares in a noisy party

examples.en: Tired revelers slowly dispersed as dawn broke over the quiet city square.
examples.zh: 随着黎明笼罩安静的城市广场，疲惫的狂欢者渐渐散去。

lemmas.def_zh: 狂欢者, 欢宴者
lemmas.def_en: a celebrant who shares in a noisy party

examples.en: the clubs attract revelers as young as thirteen

family_guide.root_logic: 以 revel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 晶体管
lemmas.def_en: a semiconductor device capable of amplification

examples.en: Modern microprocessors contain billions of tiny transistors packed onto a single silicon chip.
examples.zh: 现代微处理器在单个硅芯片上集成了数以百亿计的微型晶体管。

lemmas.usage_note: 电子工程与物理学核心名词，常指半导体晶体管，亦可借指旧式的晶体管收音机。

lemmas.def_zh: 装晶体管于, 使晶体管化
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (electronics) To equip an electronic circuit or device with transistors instead of vacuum tubes.

family_guide.root_logic: 以 transistor 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 证实，确证，佐证
lemmas.def_en: [T] (formal) To provide evidence or information that supports and confirms a statement, theory, or finding.

examples.en: Recent experimental data strongly corroborated the hypothesis proposed by the team.
examples.zh: 最近的实验数据有力地证实了该团队提出的假设。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，属正式司法或学术用语，常接 evidence, claim, story 等宾语，意为提供佐证。

lemmas.def_zh: 确实, 确证, 确证的事实
lemmas.def_en: confirmation that some fact or statement is true through the use of documentary evidence

lemmas.def_zh: 确证的
lemmas.def_en: serving to support or corroborate

examples.en: collateral evidence

family_guide.root_logic: 以 corroborate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 打鼾，打呼噜
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To breathe noisily through your nose and mouth while asleep.

examples.en: He fell asleep on the couch and began to snore loudly.
examples.zh: 他在沙发上睡着了，并开始大声打呼噜。

lemmas.usage_note: 主要用作不及物动词表示打呼噜；作及物动词时常与 away 连用表示“打鼾度过（时间）”。

lemmas.def_zh: 打鼾者
lemmas.def_en: someone who snores while sleeping

family_guide.root_logic: 以 snore 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 恶兆的, 不吉利的, 预兆的
lemmas.def_en: threatening or foreshadowing evil or tragic developments

examples.en: The sudden drop in temperature was accompanied by an ominous rumble of thunder.
examples.zh: 气温骤降，伴随着一阵令人不安的不祥雷声。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰 silence, dark clouds, signs 等，形容令人感到不祥或凶兆的氛围与迹象。

lemmas.def_zh: 恶兆地, 不吉利地; 预示地
lemmas.def_en: in an ominous manner

examples.en: the sun darkened ominously

lemmas.def_zh: 预兆, 前兆, 征兆
lemmas.def_en: a sign of something about to happen

examples.en: In ancient times, a sudden solar eclipse was regarded as an evil omen.
examples.zh: 在古代，突然发生的日食被视为不祥之兆。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，常与 good, bad, ill 搭配，指预示未来好坏的客观征兆或预兆。

lemmas.def_zh: 预示，作为……的征兆
lemmas.def_en: [T] (literary/archaic) to be an omen of; to foretell or portend something

examples.en: Such disturbing rumors omened a major political upheaval in the capital.
examples.zh: 这些令人不安的传闻预示着首都将有一场重大的政治动荡。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，属于罕见的文学书面语，常接宾语表示预示灾祸或变故，通常可用 bode 替代。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ominous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 卫生的
lemmas.def_en: free from filth and pathogens

examples.en: The refugee camp lacked proper sanitary facilities and clean drinking water.
examples.zh: 难民营缺乏适当的卫生设施和清洁的饮用水。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于公共卫生与设施领域，修饰 conditions, inspector, pad 等，强调清洁无菌或防病环境。

lemmas.def_zh: 不卫生的, 有碍健康的, 不清洁的
lemmas.def_en: not sanitary or healthful

examples.en: unsanitary open sewers
grim and unsanitary conditions

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sanitary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 脂类, 类脂物, 脂质
lemmas.def_en: an oily organic compound insoluble in water but soluble in organic solvents; essential structural component of living cells (along with proteins and carbohydrates)

examples.en: The doctor ordered a blood test to measure the patient's lipid levels.
examples.zh: 医生要求进行血液检测以测量该患者的血脂水平。

lemmas.usage_note: 生化与医学专业名词，常以复数形式出现，多与 metabolism, profile, bilayer 搭配使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lipid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不育的, 贫瘠的
lemmas.def_en: providing no shelter or sustenance

examples.en: The drought transformed the fertile valley into a barren landscape.
examples.zh: 干旱使原本肥沃的山谷变成了不毛之地。

lemmas.usage_note: 可修饰土地（贫瘠）、生物（不育）或事物（枯燥无成效），语体正式且具文学色彩。

lemmas.def_zh: 荒地
lemmas.def_en: an uninhabited wilderness that is worthless for cultivation

examples.en: The explorers struggled across the frozen barrens of the northern plateau.
examples.zh: 探险家们艰难地穿行在北部高原冰冻的荒原上。

lemmas.usage_note: 地理名词，常用复数 barrens，专指土壤贫瘠、植被稀疏的旷野或荒原地带。

lemmas.def_zh: 贫瘠, 不妊, 不孕, 不生育, 不毛, 荒芜, 思想贫乏, 空洞, 无用, 无聊
lemmas.def_en: the state (usually of a woman) of having no children or being unable to have children

family_guide.root_logic: 以 barren 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 短剑, 匕首
lemmas.def_en: a relatively long dagger with a straight blade

examples.en: The Scottish warrior drew his silver-hilted dirk from beneath his plaid.
examples.zh: 苏格兰勇士从他的格子披风下拔出了银柄短剑。

lemmas.usage_note: 历史文化名词，特指苏格兰高地人佩戴的短剑或长匕首，常出现在历史军事文学中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dirk 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 查明，弄清，核实
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (formal) To find out and verify the exact facts or truth about something through investigation.

examples.en: The committee conducted a thorough investigation to ascertain the exact cause of the mechanical failure.
examples.zh: 委员会进行了深入调查，以查明这起机械故障的确切原因。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面正式及法律用语，常接 that 从句或 whether/what 引导的宾语，强调通过调查查明事实。

lemmas.def_zh: 可查明的, 可弄清的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being ascertained or found out

examples.en: ascertainable facts

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ascertain 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 平房
lemmas.def_en: a small house with a single story

examples.en: They decided to retire to a cozy seaside bungalow away from the noisy city.
examples.zh: 他们决定退居到海边一座舒适的小平房里，远离喧嚣的城市。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指带阳台的单层独立平房小屋，多用于住宅地产、度假村或郊区住房场景，为可数名词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bungalow 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 唤醒，弄醒；激起，使振奋
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To wake someone up from sleep. 2. [T] To make someone feel active, excited, or interested.

examples.en: The speaker's impassioned words roused the crowd to demand immediate political reform.
examples.zh: 演讲者激情洋溢的话语激起了群众要求立即进行政治改革的呼声。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物或不及物动词，常用于引申义，表示激发情感、警惕或行动，常见搭配 rouse sb to anger/action。

lemmas.def_zh: 唤醒者, 搅拌器, 弥天大谎
lemmas.def_en: someone who rouses others from sleep

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rouse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 遮蔽，隐藏，笼罩；裹以裹尸布
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To cover, hide, or surround something so that it is not clearly seen or understood. 2. [T] To wrap a dead body in cloth for burial.

examples.en: The ancient mountain ruins were shrouded in dense morning mist, completely hidden from view.
examples.zh: 清晨浓重的雾气笼罩着古老的山中废墟，使其完全隐匿于视野之外。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于被动语态或比喻义，后接介词 in，如 be shrouded in mystery/fog，强调严密笼罩或隐藏。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shroud 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 平息，抚慰；姑息，绥靖
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To calm someone or prevent conflict by giving them what they demand.

examples.en: The company offered full refunds in an effort to appease angry customers after the service outage.
examples.zh: 在服务中断后，该公司提供了全额退款，以安抚愤怒的客户。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，在政治语境中常含贬义（姑息放任），日常多接 anger, hunger, critics 等作宾语，意为平息或满足。

lemmas.def_zh: 抚慰, 缓解, 平息, 姑息
lemmas.def_en: the act of appeasing (as by acceding to the demands of)

lemmas.def_zh: 劝解人
lemmas.def_en: someone who tries to bring peace by acceding to demands; --Winston Churchill

examples.en: An appeaser is one who feeds a crocodile--hoping it will eat him last

family_guide.root_logic: 以 appease 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不法的, 不正当的, 禁止的
lemmas.def_en: contrary to accepted morality (especially sexual morality) or convention

examples.en: Authorities seized a large shipment of illicit drugs hidden inside commercial cargo containers.
examples.zh: 当局截获了一大批藏在商用货运集装箱内的非法毒品。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式用语，修饰活动、交易或关系，常与 trade, drugs, relationship 等名词连用，表示违背法规或社会道德。

lemmas.def_zh: 违法地, 不正地
lemmas.def_en: in a manner disapproved or not allowed by custom

examples.en: He acted illegitimately when he increased the rent fourfold

family_guide.root_logic: 以 illicit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 中后卫球员
lemmas.def_en: a defensive football player who takes a position close behind the linemen

examples.en: The star linebacker anticipated the pass and made a game-winning tackle in the final seconds.
examples.zh: 这位明星中后卫预判了传球，并在最后几秒完成了一记锁定胜局的擒抱。

lemmas.usage_note: 美式橄榄球防守专属术语，指防守锋线后方的关键防守球员，兼具撞击与传球防守职责。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 linebacker 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 凉亭, 树阴处
lemmas.def_en: a framework that supports climbing plants

examples.en: They sat quietly reading under a leafy bower draped with fragrant wisteria vines.
examples.zh: 他们静静地坐在一座挂满芬芳紫藤的树荫凉亭下看书。

lemmas.usage_note: 文学与诗歌词汇，指藤蔓、绿树环绕遮荫的幽静休憩处或凉亭，具有典雅浪漫色彩。

lemmas.def_en: a street in Manhattan noted for cheap hotels frequented by homeless derelicts

lemmas.def_zh: （以树荫、枝叶等）庇护，掩蔽
lemmas.def_en: [T] (literary) To enclose, shade, or shelter someone or something with leafy branches or trees.

examples.en: The old stone cottage was completely bowered by towering oaks and weeping willows.
examples.zh: 那座古老的石砌小屋完全被高耸的橡树与垂柳所荫蔽。

lemmas.usage_note: 罕见文学书面动词，意为“用树木荫蔽”或“隐蔽于树荫中”，常以过去分词作定语或用于被动语态。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bower 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 围裙
lemmas.def_en: a garment of cloth or leather or plastic that is tied about the waist and worn to protect your clothing

examples.en: She tied a cotton apron around her waist before preparing the Sunday dinner.
examples.zh: 在准备周日晚餐之前，她在腰间系了一条棉布围裙。

lemmas.usage_note: 生活高频词，常用搭配 tie/wear an apron；航空领域亦指停机坪，舞台领域指台唇（外舞台）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 apron 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 牙刷
lemmas.def_en: small brush; has long handle; used to clean teeth

examples.en: Dentists recommend replacing your toothbrush every three months to prevent bacterial buildup.
examples.zh: 牙医建议每三个月更换一次牙刷，以防止细菌滋生。

lemmas.usage_note: 日常基础名词，常与 electric toothbrush, soft-bristled toothbrush 等搭配，用于口腔卫生表达。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 toothbrush 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 羊毛, 羊毛制的覆盖物
lemmas.def_en: the wool of a sheep or similar animal

examples.en: She put on a warm fleece jacket before heading out into the brisk morning air.
examples.zh: 在走进清晨凛冽的寒风之前，她穿上了一件保暖的抓绒夹克。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指整张剪下的羊毛或仿羊毛抓绒面料，在服装领域多见搭配 fleece jacket。

lemmas.def_zh: 敲竹杠，敲诈；剪（羊毛）
lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. (informal) To obtain a lot of money from someone by overcharging or tricking them. 2. To shear the wool from a sheep.

examples.en: Unscrupulous vendors managed to fleece the unsuspecting tourists of their travel funds.
examples.zh: 不法商贩设法敲诈了毫无防备的游客，骗走了他们的旅行资金。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于非正式语境，指通过欺诈手段敲诈或敲竹杠，常与介词 of 连用（fleece sb of sth）。

lemmas.def_zh: 覆盖羊毛的, 羊毛似的, 松软的
lemmas.def_en: (of fabrics) having soft nap produced by brushing

examples.en: Light sunlight filtered through the fleecy white clouds on Sunday morning.
examples.zh: 周日清晨，淡淡的阳光透过松软的白云洒向大地。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fleece 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 大胆, 厚颜无耻
lemmas.def_en: fearless daring

examples.en: He had the sheer audacity to blame his colleagues for his own careless mistakes.
examples.zh: 他竟然厚颜无耻地把自己粗心犯下的错误归咎于同事。

lemmas.usage_note: 指惊人的大胆或厚颜无耻，常带贬义或惊讶语气，常见搭配 have the audacity to do sth。

lemmas.def_zh: 大胆的, 鲁莽的, 胆大妄为的
lemmas.def_en: invulnerable to fear or intimidation

examples.en: audacious explorers
fearless reporters and photographers

lemmas.def_zh: 无畏地；放肆地；大胆创新地；无拘无束地
lemmas.def_en: in an audacious manner

examples.en: an idea so daring and yet so audaciously tempting that a shiver of excitement quivered through him

family_guide.root_logic: 以 audacity 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （用手肘等）轻推，轻触；推进，劝诱
lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. To push someone gently, usually with an elbow, to attract attention. 2. To gently encourage or persuade someone to take action.

examples.en: She nudged her husband under the table to signal that it was time to leave the party.
examples.zh: 她在桌子底下轻轻碰了碰丈夫，示意该离开聚会了。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于用肘轻推以引起注意，也可引申为温和劝说或缓慢推进，常接 sb into/towards doing。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nudge 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 小的, 次要的, 小个子的, 娇小玲珑的, 娇小的
lemmas.def_en: very small

examples.en: Despite her petite frame, the young gymnast displayed extraordinary strength on the beam.
examples.zh: 尽管身材娇小，这位年轻的体操运动员在平衡木上展现了非凡的力量。

lemmas.usage_note: 用于形容女性身材娇小苗条，多为褒义或时尚描述语，常作定语修饰 woman 或 figure。

lemmas.def_en: a garment size for short or slender women

examples.en: The department store has expanded its clothing section specifically designed for petites.
examples.zh: 这家百货公司扩大了专门为娇小身材女性设计的服装专区。

lemmas.usage_note: 服装零售专业术语，指小号女装尺码或特指身材娇小的女性群体，常用作单复数名词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 petite 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 戳，捅，刺；督促，激励
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To push someone or something with a finger or a pointed object. 2. [T] To encourage or remind someone to do something.

examples.en: Managers often have to prod the creative team into meeting their project deadlines.
examples.zh: 管理者经常不得不敦促创意团队按时完成项目截止日期的任务。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指用手指或尖物戳刺，也常引申为敦促、激励某人行动，常搭配 prod sb into doing sth。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 prod 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 皇后, 女皇
lemmas.def_en: a woman emperor or the wife of an emperor

examples.en: Empress Catherine II played a pivotal role in modernizing the Russian state.
examples.zh: 叶卡捷琳娜二世女皇在俄罗斯国家的现代化进程中发挥了关键作用。

lemmas.usage_note: 指女性皇帝（如女皇）或皇帝的配偶（皇后），专有名词中首字母通常大写。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 empress 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 侯爵
lemmas.def_en: humorist who wrote about the imaginary life of cockroaches (1878-1937)

examples.en: The elderly marquis bequeathed his vast country estate to his eldest nephew.
examples.zh: 这位年迈的侯爵将他广袤的乡村庄园遗赠给了他的大侄子。

lemmas.usage_note: 欧洲贵族头衔，位列公爵（Duke）之下、伯爵（Earl）之上，多见于历史与文学语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 marquis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 侦察, 勘察队
lemmas.def_en: the act of reconnoitring (especially to gain information about an enemy or potential enemy)

examples.en: The fighter jets conducted a rapid reconnaissance mission over the disputed border area.
examples.zh: 战斗机在争议边境地区上空执行了一次快速空中侦察任务。

lemmas.usage_note: 军事与战术术语，指实地侦察或前期勘察，常搭配 conduct/carry out reconnaissance。

lemmas.def_zh: 侦察，勘测
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] (military) To explore an area, usually in secret, to gather information about enemy forces or terrain.

examples.en: The scout moved ahead silently to reconnoiter the enemy's defensive positions along the river.
examples.zh: 侦察兵悄悄走在前面，勘查沿河敌军的防御阵地。

lemmas.def_zh: 侦察, 勘探
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (British English spelling of reconnoiter) To survey or inspect an area to gather strategic information.

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reconnaissance 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 生殖的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the external sex organs

examples.en: The physician carefully examined the patient for any signs of genital infections.
examples.zh: 医生仔细检查了患者是否有任何生殖器官感染的迹象。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学与生物学正式用语，表示生殖器官的，常修饰 organ, area, herpes 等词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 genital 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 支流的, 纳贡的, 从属的, 辅助的
lemmas.def_en: (of a stream) flowing into a larger stream

examples.en: Several tributary streams flow down the rugged mountain to feed the main river.
examples.zh: 几条支流溪水从崎岖的山间流下，汇入主要干流。

lemmas.usage_note: 用于修饰河流支流或历史上纳贡的从属国，多见于地理学与历史学学术文献。

lemmas.def_zh: 支流, 纳贡者, 属国
lemmas.def_en: a branch that flows into the main stream

examples.en: The Missouri River is the longest tributary of the Mississippi River system.
examples.zh: 密苏里河是密西西比河水系中最长的一条支流。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指大河或大湖的支流，也指古代纳贡藩属，通常与介词 to 搭配（a tributary to/of）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tributary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 赞助, 恩赐态度, 光顾, 任免权, 保护人的身分
lemmas.def_en: the act of providing approval and support

examples.en: The arts center relies heavily on corporate patronage to fund its educational programs.
examples.zh: 该艺术中心在很大程度上依赖企业的赞助来资助其教育项目。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，常与 royal, political, arts 搭配，指“赞助、惠顾”或政治上的“任免庇护”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 patronage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 蓄意的破坏, 故意的伤害罪
lemmas.def_en: the willful and unlawful crippling or mutilation of another person

examples.en: The sudden power outage caused complete mayhem in the crowded subway station.
examples.zh: 突如其来的停电在拥挤的地铁站内引起了一片彻底的混乱。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，常用动词 cause, create 搭配，指混乱、骚乱状态，亦可作法律术语指重伤罪。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mayhem 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 孢子
lemmas.def_en: a small usually single-celled asexual reproductive body produced by many nonflowering plants and fungi and some bacteria and protozoans and that are capable of developing into a new individual without sexual fusion

examples.en: Mold spores can trigger severe allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.
examples.zh: 霉菌孢子会引发过敏体质人群的严重过敏反应。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，生物学术语，常用复数形式，常与 release, produce, airborne 搭配使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 spore 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 身材, 身高, 高度
lemmas.def_en: high level of respect gained by impressive development or achievement

examples.en: She quickly grew into a diplomat of immense international stature.
examples.zh: 她迅速成长为一名极具国际声望的外交家。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，既可指物理“身高”，更常喻指“声望、地位”，常与 of great stature, global 搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stature 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 玛拉（女子名）
lemmas.def_en: Hindu god of death; opposite of Kama

examples.en: Mara decided to pursue a master's degree in environmental science after graduation.
examples.zh: 玛拉决定毕业后继续攻读环境科学硕士学位。

lemmas.usage_note: 专有名词作人名，亦可指动物“巴塔哥尼亚豚鼠”或神话恶魔，通常作为主语或宾语使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mara 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 恶臭
lemmas.def_en: an unpleasant smell

examples.en: There was an awful pong coming from the unwashed gym kit left in the locker.
examples.zh: 留在储物柜里未洗的运动服散发出一股难闻的恶臭。

lemmas.usage_note: 英式非正式用语，单数名词，常与 horrible, awful, terrible 等形容词搭配，指刺鼻恶臭。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pong 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: denoting a quantity consisting of 12 items or units

examples.en: The events described in Chapter XII took place during the late eighteenth century.
examples.zh: 第十二章所描述的事件发生在十八世纪末。

lemmas.usage_note: 罗马数字作定语，表示“第十二”或“十二个”，常置于名词后用于世纪、章节或君主称号后。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 xii 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 称赞, 光荣, 荣誉
lemmas.def_en: an expression of approval and commendation

examples.en: Kudos to the rescue team for saving all the hikers trapped in the blizzard.
examples.zh: 向成功营救所有被困暴风雪中的徒步旅行者的救援队致敬。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词（易被误当复数），口语及书面通俗语体，常与 receive, earn 或介词 to 搭配表示赞扬。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kudos 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 主页
lemmas.def_en: the opening page of a web site

examples.en: You can download the latest software update directly from the company's homepage.
examples.zh: 你可以直接从该公司的网站主页下载最新的软件更新。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，网络语境常用词，常与 set as, link to, visit 搭配，指网站的起始主页。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 homepage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 酗酒, 酒精中毒
lemmas.def_en: habitual intoxication; prolonged and excessive intake of alcoholic drinks leading to a breakdown in health and an addiction to alcohol such that abrupt deprivation leads to severe withdrawal symptoms

examples.en: He sought professional medical treatment to help him overcome his long battle with alcoholism.
examples.zh: 他寻求了专业的医疗帮助，以克服他与酗酒症的长期抗争。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，医学与社会学严肃语体，常与 suffer from, treat, battle 搭配使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 alcoholism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 书记处, 秘书之职, 秘书处
lemmas.def_en: an administrative unit responsible for maintaining records and other secretarial duties; especially for international organizations

examples.en: The United Nations Secretariat is responsible for servicing the other principal organs of the UN.
examples.zh: 联合国秘书处负责为联合国的其他主要机构提供日常服务。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指大型国际组织或政府部门的常设行政机构（秘书处），多与 the 连用，属正式公文语体。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 secretariat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 场所
lemmas.def_en: the post or function properly or customarily occupied or served by another

examples.en: Employees who work overtime may receive extra time off in lieu of payment.
examples.zh: 加班员工可获得调休，以代替加班费。

lemmas.usage_note: 几乎仅见于固定短语 in lieu of（替代/代替），常用于法律、公文或书面英语中取代 instead of。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lieu 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a silly and inept person; someone who is regarded as stupid

examples.en: I felt like a complete wally when I realized I was wearing mismatched shoes.
examples.zh: 当意识到自己两只鞋穿得不一样时，我觉得自己像个十足的傻瓜。

lemmas.usage_note: 英式非正式口语词，指行为愚蠢、笨拙或可笑的人，语气较温和，相当于 silly person。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wally 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 否, 不, 不仅如此
lemmas.def_en: not this merely but also; not only so but

examples.en: It was difficult, nay, impossible to complete the project without external funding.
examples.zh: 没有外部资金支持，要完成这个项目即使不是毫无可能，也是极为困难的。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于书面语或演说中表示递进（甚至、不仅如此），或在古英语及传统表决中表示“不/否”。

lemmas.def_zh: 拒绝, 反对, 投反对票
lemmas.def_en: a negative

examples.en: The final vote count showed that the nays carried the day, defeating the proposal.
examples.zh: 最终计票结果显示反对票占了上风，否决了该项提案。

lemmas.usage_note: 指表决中的反对票或投反对票的人，高频搭配为 the ayes and the nays（赞成票与反对票）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nay 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 桩, 尖桩, 警戒哨, 巡逻艇, 纠察队
lemmas.def_en: a person employed to keep watch for some anticipated event

examples.en: Dozens of union members formed a picket outside the factory gates this morning.
examples.zh: 数十名工会成员今天上午在工厂大门外组织了纠察防线。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指罢工期间在工作场所外的纠察队员或哨卡，常见搭配 picket line（纠察线）。

lemmas.def_zh: 在……设置纠察；在……外抗议（示威）；担任纠察
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To stand or march outside a factory, office, or building as a picket during a strike or protest to persuade others not to enter.

examples.en: Disgruntled workers gathered early to picket the company headquarters over unfair wages.
examples.zh: 不满的工人们一早就聚集在公司总部门口进行纠察抗议，抗议不公薪酬。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物或不及物动词，指在建筑物或企业前“设立纠察线抗议”，后常直接接抗议地点或对象。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 picket 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 临床医师, 临证医师
lemmas.def_en: a practitioner (of medicine or psychology) who does clinical work instead of laboratory experiments

examples.en: The new treatment guidelines are designed to help clinicians make informed diagnostic decisions.
examples.zh: 新版治疗指南旨在帮助临床医师做出有根据的诊断决策。

lemmas.usage_note: 专业医疗词汇，指直接接触并诊治患者的临床医生或医务人员，区别于从事实验室研究的医学学者。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 clinician 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 焊接，焊合；结合
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To join pieces of metal or electrical wires together with melted solder.

examples.en: He carefully used an iron to solder the loose copper wire back onto the circuit board.
examples.zh: 他小心地用烙铁把松动的铜线重新焊回到电路板上。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指使用低熔点焊料将金属部件“焊合/焊接”，常与 to 或 together 搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 solder 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 全部剧目, 全部技能, 全部节目, 全部作品
lemmas.def_en: the entire range of skills or aptitudes or devices used in a particular field or occupation

examples.en: The young pianist expanded her classical repertoire to include several modern jazz compositions.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的钢琴家扩展了她的古典曲目库，融入了数首现代爵士作品。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指演职人员或团体的全部常备剧目，也可引申指个人掌握的全部技能或手段，常与 expand 搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 repertoire 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 沮丧
lemmas.def_en: the feeling of despair in the face of obstacles

examples.en: To her utter dismay, the airline announced that all departing flights had been cancelled.
examples.zh: 让她深感沮丧的是，航空公司宣布所有起飞航班均已被取消。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，表示面对意外困境时的惊愕、沮丧或绝望感，常见搭配 to one's dismay 或 in dismay。

lemmas.def_zh: 使气馁，使沮丧；使惊愕
lemmas.def_en: [T] To make someone feel deeply worried, disappointed, or disheartened by something unexpected.

examples.en: The sudden collapse of negotiations dismayed all the international delegates involved.
examples.zh: 谈判的骤然破裂使所有参与其中的国际代表深感错愕与沮丧。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指突发的不良情况“使某人惊愕/气馁”，常用被动语态 be dismayed by/at。

lemmas.def_zh: 无恐惧的, 未灰心的, 不泄气的
lemmas.def_en: unshaken in purpose

examples.en: wholly undismayed by the commercial failure of the three movies he had made

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dismay 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 欺骗, 谎言
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being fraudulent

examples.en: He was dismissed from the firm after his long history of corporate deceit was finally exposed.
examples.zh: 在他长期的企业欺诈行径最终败露后，他被公司解雇了。

lemmas.usage_note: 主要指故意隐瞒真相的欺骗行为或欺诈品质，作不可数名词居多，带有强烈道德贬义色彩。

lemmas.def_zh: 不诚实；欺诈
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being crafty

lemmas.def_zh: 欺诈的
lemmas.def_en: intended to deceive; ; ;  - S.T.Coleridge

examples.en: deceitful advertising
fallacious testimony

lemmas.def_zh: 惯于欺骗地, 不诚实地; 骗人地
lemmas.def_en: in a corrupt and deceitful manner

examples.en: he acted dishonestly when he gave the contract to his best friend

family_guide.root_logic: 以 deceit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 奢侈的, 挥霍无度的, 浪费的
lemmas.def_en: unrestrained, especially with regard to feelings

examples.en: Her extravagant spending habits eventually pushed the whole family into serious debt.
examples.zh: 她挥霍无度的消费习惯最终让全家陷入了严重的债务危机。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰lifestyle、claim或price，表示过度浪费或夸张不切实际，含贬义色彩。

lemmas.def_zh: 挥霍无度地
lemmas.def_en: in an abundant manner

examples.en: they were abundantly supplied with food
he thanked her profusely

lemmas.def_zh: 奢侈, 浪费, 放肆的言行
lemmas.def_en: the quality of exceeding the appropriate limits of decorum or probability or truth

examples.en: Buying another luxury sports car was seen as an unnecessary extravagance.
examples.zh: 再买一辆豪华跑车被视为一种毫无必要的奢侈行为。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 extravagant 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 精神病的
lemmas.def_en: characteristic of or suffering from psychosis

examples.en: The patient experienced a psychotic break brought on by severe sleep deprivation.
examples.zh: 由于严重缺乏睡眠，该患者经历了一次精神病性发作。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学上修饰disorder、episode等，指精神病性的；口语中常夸张指极疯狂的。

lemmas.def_zh: 精神病患者
lemmas.def_en: a person afflicted with psychosis

examples.en: The specialized clinic provides round-the-clock intensive care for acute psychotics.
examples.zh: 这家专科诊所为急性重症精神病患者提供全天候的特护服务。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，指精神病患者，具较强临床色彩，非正式语境中使用可能带有冒犯性。

lemmas.def_zh: 精神病, 精神不正常
lemmas.def_en: any severe mental disorder in which contact with reality is lost or highly distorted

examples.en: Early intervention can significantly improve the long-term prognosis of drug-induced psychosis.
examples.zh: 早期干预能够显著改善药物所致精神病的远期预后。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数或可数名词，指精神病状态，常与develop、suffer from等动词搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 psychotic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 强夺, 拦劫, 抢劫
lemmas.def_en: the act of stealing

examples.en: The armed gang pulled off an audacious museum heist in broad daylight.
examples.zh: 那个持枪团伙光天化日之下制造了一起大胆的博物馆劫案。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式用语，多指精心策划的珠宝、现金重大抢劫案，常搭配pull off或stage。

lemmas.def_zh: 抢劫，盗窃
lemmas.def_en: [T] (slang) To steal valuable goods or large amounts of money in a daring robbery.

examples.en: A ring of professional thieves managed to heist millions of dollars in uncut diamonds.
examples.zh: 一个职业盗窃团伙设法劫走了价值数百万美元的未加工钻石。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，俚语用法，表示通过周密策划实施抢劫或盗窃，后接被盗目标或财物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 heist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 边缘, 折边, 哼声
lemmas.def_en: the edge of a piece of cloth; especially the finished edge that has been doubled under and stitched down

examples.en: She carefully unstitched the hem of the trousers to make them an inch longer.
examples.zh: 她小心地拆开裤脚的折边，想把裤子放长一英寸。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指衣物的褶边或卷边，搭配动词let down（放长）或take up（改短）。

lemmas.def_zh: 给……缝边，折边；包围，围住
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To fold over and sew down the edge of a piece of cloth or a garment. 2. [T] (hem in) To surround or restrict someone or something closely.

examples.en: The mountain troops were completely hemmed in by dense forests and hostile forces.
examples.zh: 高山部队被茂密的森林和敌对势力彻底重重包围。

lemmas.usage_note: 作本义指缝制折边；常见短语hem in表示包围、限制自由，常用于被动语态。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hem 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 永恒的, 持久的
lemmas.def_en: continuing forever or indefinitely

examples.en: They made an everlasting promise to stand by each other through all hardships.
examples.zh: 他们许下永恒的誓言，无论面对何种艰难险阻都同舟共济。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰love、peace等表示永恒不变；修饰烦心事时表无休止的，带抱怨口吻。

lemmas.def_zh: 永远地, 持续不尽地, 无穷地
lemmas.def_en: for a limitless time; ; - P.P.Bliss

examples.en: no one can live forever
brightly beams our Father's mercy from his lighthouse evermore

family_guide.root_logic: 以 everlasting 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 结巴地说，口吃；（机器）断断续续地运转
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To speak with involuntary pauses and repeated initial sounds because of a speech difficulty, nervousness, or shock. 2. [I] To move or operate with unsteady, irregular sounds.

examples.en: Nervous under the harsh spotlight, he began to stutter uncontrollably during the defense.
examples.zh: 在刺眼的聚光灯下感到紧张，他在答辩中开始不由自主地结巴起来。

lemmas.usage_note: 作不及物或及物动词，指说话结巴、口吃，也可隐喻机器运转断续卡顿。

lemmas.def_zh: 口吃者, 说话结巴者
lemmas.def_en: someone who speaks with involuntary pauses and repetitions

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stutter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 斗士, 斗剑者, 争论者
lemmas.def_en: (ancient Rome) a professional combatant or a captive who entertained the public by engaging in mortal combat

examples.en: In ancient Rome, a trained gladiator fought to the death for public entertainment.
examples.zh: 在古罗马，受过训练的角斗士为了供大众娱乐而拼死战斗。

lemmas.usage_note: 本义指古罗马角斗士，现代常借喻政治、法律等领域中斗志顽强的辩论者与竞争者。

lemmas.def_zh: 斗剑者的, 争论的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or resembling gladiators or their combat

examples.en: gladiatorial combats

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gladiator 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 记录者, 登记者, 登记官员
lemmas.def_en: a person employed to keep a record of the owners of stocks and bonds issued by the company

examples.en: You need to submit your official course withdrawal form directly to the university registrar.
examples.zh: 你需要直接向大学教务主任提交正式的退课申请表。

lemmas.usage_note: 主要指大学教务主管（注册主任），也可指医院的高级住院医生或户籍登记官。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 registrar 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无, 全无, 零
lemmas.def_en: a quantity of no importance

examples.en: With no new leads after three months, the police admitted their chances of finding the suspect were almost nil.
examples.zh: 三个月没有任何新线索后，警方承认找到嫌疑人的希望几乎为零。

lemmas.usage_note: 特指比分中的“零”（尤其在英式英语体育中），或表示几率、希望等全无。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nil 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 语义的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to meaning or the study of meaning

examples.en: The modern search engine relies heavily on semantic analysis to comprehend user queries.
examples.zh: 现代搜索引擎高度依赖语义分析来理解用户的查询意图。

lemmas.usage_note: 语言学和计算机术语，常与analysis、meaning、shift等搭配，表示语义层面的。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 语义地
lemmas.def_en: with regard to meaning

examples.en: semantically empty messages

lemmas.def_zh: [语]语义学；语义论
lemmas.def_en: the study of language meaning

examples.en: Arguing over whether to call it a reduction or a pause is just an issue of mere semantics.
examples.zh: 争论是该称其为削减还是暂停，纯粹只是一场字面语义上的文字游戏。

lemmas.usage_note: 作学科名词时谓语动词常用单数；口语中常作复数指“文字游戏”或无意义争论。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 semantic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 常绿的
lemmas.def_en: (of plants and shrubs) bearing foliage throughout the year

examples.en: Pine trees are evergreen plants that retain their foliage throughout the freezing winter.
examples.zh: 松树是常绿植物，在严寒的冬日里依然枝繁叶茂。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰trees、shrubs等植物，亦可引申作比喻义，指作品或话题“经久不衰的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 常绿树, 常绿植物
lemmas.def_en: a plant having foliage that persists and remains green throughout the year

examples.en: They planted several evergreens along the fence to provide privacy all year round.
examples.zh: 他们在篱笆旁种了几棵常青树，以便全年都能遮挡视线、保护隐私。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指常绿树木或灌木，也可引申指长盛不衰的经典歌曲或艺术作品。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 evergreen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 审慎的, 三思而后行的, 精明的, 节俭的
lemmas.def_en: careful and sensible; marked by sound judgment

examples.en: In times of economic uncertainty, it is prudent to save a portion of your income.
examples.zh: 在经济前景不明朗的时期，存一部分收入是明智审慎的做法。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式用语，常修饰decision、investment等，表示在处理事务时审慎且精明。

lemmas.def_zh: 审慎的, 精明的, 起咨询作用的
lemmas.def_en: arising from or characterized by prudence especially in business matters

examples.en: he abstained partly for prudential reasons

lemmas.def_zh: 谨慎地；慎重地
lemmas.def_en: in a prudent manner

examples.en: I had allotted my own bedroom for necking, prudently removing both the bed and the key, and taken both myself and my typewriter into my son's bedroom.

lemmas.def_zh: 审慎, 慎重, 精明, 节俭
lemmas.def_en: discretion in practical affairs

examples.en: The central bank exercised financial prudence to curb soaring inflation.
examples.zh: 央行推行审慎的金融举措以抑制飞涨的通货膨胀。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数抽象名词，常与with、exercise搭配，用于金融、政策等庄重语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 prudent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 攻占，夺回（失地等）；重新拿回；重拍；重考
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To take control of a place or position again by force. 2. [T] To take an exam or photograph again.

examples.en: The director decided to retake the final scene to capture the actor's emotions better.
examples.zh: 导演决定重拍最后一场戏，以便更好地捕捉演员的情感。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常与town、exam、scene搭配，指夺回阵地、重考或电影重拍镜头。

lemmas.def_zh: 夺回，收复；重考；重新拍摄（retake的过去式）
lemmas.def_en: [T] Past tense of retake; recaptured an area or position, or took an exam again.

examples.en: The military forces managed to recapture the fort

family_guide.root_logic: 以 retake 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 偶尔发生的, 零星发生的, 分散的
lemmas.def_en: recurring in scattered and irregular or unpredictable instances

examples.en: Sporadic clashes were reported between the rival factions despite the ceasefire agreement.
examples.zh: 尽管达成了停火协议，但对立派系之间仍有零星冲突的报道。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰violence、fighting、outbreaks等，指无规律、断断续续发生的事件。

lemmas.def_zh: 偶发地；零星地
lemmas.def_en: in a sporadic manner

examples.en: he only works sporadically

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sporadic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 仓鼠
lemmas.def_en: short-tailed Old World burrowing rodent with large cheek pouches

examples.en: The little hamster spent hours running on its plastic exercise wheel inside the cage.
examples.zh: 那只小仓鼠在笼子里的塑料跑轮上跑了好几个小时。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指宠物仓鼠；常与wheel连用比喻周而复始、疲于奔命的生活。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hamster 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 圣礼, 圣事, 誓言
lemmas.def_en: a formal religious ceremony conferring a specific grace on those who receive it; the two Protestant ceremonies are baptism and the Lord's Supper; in the Roman Catholic Church and the Eastern Orthodox Church there are seven traditional rites accepted as instituted by Jesus: baptism and confirmation and Holy Eucharist and penance and holy orders and matrimony and extreme unction

examples.en: The priest arrived at the hospital to administer the last sacrament to the dying patient.
