examples.en: He joined the university lacrosse team and practiced on the field three afternoons a week.
examples.zh: 他加入了大学的长曲棍球队，每周有三个下午在球场上训练。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，表示长曲棍球运动，常与 play 搭配，或作定语修饰 stick、team 等。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lacrosse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 未婚夫
lemmas.def_en: a man who is engaged to be married

examples.en: She introduced her fiancé to her colleagues at the annual company dinner.
examples.zh: 在公司年会上，她将自己的未婚夫介绍给了同事们。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常拼作 fiancé，特指男性未婚夫（女性为 fiancée），常与 my, her 连用，多见于社交与日常生活语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fiance 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 绿林, 湿材
lemmas.def_en: woodlands in full leaf

examples.en: The outlaw and his merry band sought refuge deep within the sheltering greenwood.
examples.zh: 那名亡命之徒和他的伙伴们躲进了茂盛绿林的深处寻求庇护。

lemmas.usage_note: 常带文学或诗歌色彩，特指繁茂的绿林（常让人联想到罗宾汉传说），也可指未经干燥处理的湿木材。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 greenwood 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 中产阶级的, 平庸的
lemmas.def_en: (according to Marxist thought) being of the property-owning class and exploitive of the working class

examples.en: He rejected what he saw as comfortable, bourgeois values in favor of an artistic life.
examples.zh: 他摒弃了自己眼中安逸平庸的中产阶级价值观，转而选择追求艺术生活。

lemmas.usage_note: 作形容词时常含贬义或讽刺意味，修饰 values, lifestyle 等，指中产阶级市侩、平庸、追求物质享受的特质。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bourgeois 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 埃米尔(穆斯林国家的酋长等称号)
lemmas.def_en: an independent ruler or chieftain (especially in Africa or Arabia)

examples.en: The foreign delegation was formally received by the amir at the royal palace.
examples.zh: 外国代表团在王宫受到了埃米尔的正式接见。

lemmas.usage_note: 专有名词性头衔（亦作 emir），指伊斯兰国家的统治者、酋长或贵族，常大写置于人名或国名前作尊称。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 amir 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 击球手
lemmas.def_en: (baseball) a ballplayer who is batting

examples.en: The opening batsman scored a century before being caught out by the fielder.
examples.zh: 首棒击球手在被接杀出局之前成功拿下了整整一百分。

lemmas.usage_note: 板球等球类运动中的专业术语，指击球手，常与 opening, skilled 等词搭配，现亦常用中性词 batter 替代。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 batsman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 火葬，焚化（遗体）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To burn the body of a dead person to ashes, usually as part of a funeral service.

examples.en: In accordance with his final wishes, his body was cremated and the ashes were scattered at sea.
examples.zh: 根据他的遗愿，他的遗体被火化，骨灰被撒入了大海。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式动词，指将尸体火化或焚化，常用于被动语态（be cremated），常与 wish to, choose to 连用。

lemmas.def_zh: 烧, 火葬
lemmas.def_en: the incineration of a dead body

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cremate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 对……行割礼，切除……的包皮
lemmas.def_en: [T] To cut off the foreskin of a male, typically for medical reasons or as a religious rite.

examples.en: In many cultures, male infants are traditionally circumcised shortly after birth.
examples.zh: 在许多文化中，男婴在出生后不久传统上都会接受割礼。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学与宗教人类学专业动词，指行包皮环切术或割礼，极常用于被动语态（be circumcised at birth 等）。

lemmas.def_zh: 包皮环割术, 环切术, 犹太教的割礼, 净心, 犹太人
lemmas.def_en: (Roman Catholic Church and Anglican Church) feast day celebrating the circumcision of Jesus; celebrated on January 1st

family_guide.root_logic: 以 circumcise 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 紫胶, 十万, 许多
lemmas.def_en: resinlike substance secreted by certain lac insects; used in e.g. varnishes and sealing wax

examples.en: The artisan extracted natural red dye and resin from the raw lac found on tree branches.
examples.zh: 工匠从树枝上采集的天然紫胶中提取出了红色染料和树脂。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可指用于制漆的紫胶（天然树脂），在南亚英语中亦常写作 lakh，作数词性名词表示“十万”，用于金融统计。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lac 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 三倍的, 最高声部的
lemmas.def_en: having or denoting a high range

examples.en: The boy was chosen for the solo part because of his remarkably clear treble voice.
examples.zh: 这个男孩因其极为清脆纯净的高音声线而被选为独唱者。

lemmas.usage_note: 作形容词可表示“三倍的”（英式常用，等同于 triple），在音乐领域则指“最高声部的”或“清脆高音的”。

lemmas.def_zh: （使）成三倍，（使）增加到三倍
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] (chiefly British) To increase threefold, or to multiply an amount or number by three.

examples.en: The company's profits trebled within two years thanks to the new marketing strategy.
examples.zh: 得益于新的营销策略，该公司的利润在两年内增长到了三倍。

lemmas.usage_note: 可作及物或不及物动词，表示数量、价值或规模“增至三倍”或“使增为三倍”，常见于经济、统计等正式语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 treble 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a native or inhabitant of Byzantium or of the Byzantine Empire

examples.en: The Byzantines successfully defended Constantinople for centuries against numerous sieges.
examples.zh: 拜占庭人曾数百年成功抵御了针对君士坦丁堡的无数次围攻。

lemmas.usage_note: 作名词时首字母常大写（Byzantine），指拜占庭帝国的臣民、东罗马人，在历史与文化研究文献中偶见使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 byzantine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 克尔维特式轻巡航舰, 小型护舰
lemmas.def_en: a highly maneuverable escort warship; smaller than a destroyer

examples.en: The navy deployed a missile corvette to patrol the disputed coastal waters.
examples.zh: 海军部署了一艘导弹护卫舰在有争议的沿海水域巡逻。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，指轻型护卫舰或巡逻舰，多用于军事与海事语境，常与 naval, fleet 等连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 corvette 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 依偎，偎靠；半隐半现地坐落，依傍；抱，抱在怀里
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (+ into/against/in) To settle comfortably and warmly against someone or in a sheltered place. 2. [I] (of a place or building) To be situated half-hidden or pleasantly sheltered.

examples.en: The child nestled into her mother's arms and quickly fell asleep.
examples.zh: 孩子依偎在母亲怀里，很快就睡着了。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可作及物动词（抱、安放），也可作不及物动词（偎依、坐落），常与 against, into 或 in 搭配。

lemmas.def_zh: 刚孵出的雏, 未离巢的雏, 幼儿
lemmas.def_en: young bird not yet fledged

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nestle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可怜的, 不幸的, 卑鄙的
lemmas.def_en: of very poor quality or condition

examples.en: Refugees endured wretched conditions in the makeshift camps through the winter.
examples.zh: 难民们在临时营地里熬过了极度恶劣的冬季。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，表示极度不幸的、恶劣的或令人鄙视的，常修饰 conditions, life, smell 等，书面语常用。

lemmas.def_zh: 可怜, 悲惨
lemmas.def_en: a state of ill-being due to affliction or misfortune

examples.en: the misery and wretchedness of those slums is intolerable

lemmas.def_zh: 可怜地, 鄙劣地, 差劲地
lemmas.def_en: in a wretched manner

examples.en: `I can't remember who I am,' I said, wretchedly

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wretched 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使贫穷，使赤贫；耗尽……的资源（或养分），削弱
lemmas.def_en: [T] To make someone or something extremely poor, or to make land, soil, or a system worse in quality.

examples.en: Decades of relentless civil war have impoverished the once-thriving nation.
examples.zh: 数十年的残酷内战使这个曾经繁荣的国家陷入贫困。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指使人或国家陷入贫困，亦指使土地贫瘠或资源枯竭，常接 people, soil 等名词。

lemmas.def_zh: 贫穷, 穷困
lemmas.def_en: the state of having little or no money and few or no material possessions

family_guide.root_logic: 以 impoverish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 俯身，弯腰；降格，堕落
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To bend the head and body forward and downward. 2. [I] (stoop to) To lower one's moral standards to do something bad or dishonest.

examples.en: He stooped down to pick up the coins scattered on the floor.
examples.zh: 他弯下身子去捡散落在地板上的硬币。

lemmas.usage_note: 动词，物理上指弯腰或俯身；引申指堕落、降格做坏事，常与 down 或 to 搭配（如 stoop to cheating）。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 驼背的；弓着身子的
lemmas.def_en: having the head and shoulders habitually bent forward; not erect
lemmas.usage_note: 多用于形容老年人或体弱者的身姿体态，如 a stooped figure / posture / old man。

examples.en: A stooped elderly man walked slowly down the street with a cane.
examples.zh: 一位驼背的老人拄着拐杖在街上缓缓行走。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stoop 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 咕哝，嘟囔；低声抱怨
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] (+ about/to) To speak quietly in a low, unclear voice, especially when complaining or annoyed.

examples.en: He walked away, muttering darkly about the unfair decision under his breath.
examples.zh: 他走开了，低声嘟囔着对这一不公平决定的不满。

lemmas.usage_note: 动词，指低声嘟囔或暗自抱怨，常与 to oneself 或 about 连用，多含不满情绪。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mutter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 挤作一团，拥挤；蜷缩；把……聚集在一起；碰头密谈
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (+ together) To crowd or cause to crowd closely together in a small group. 2. [I] (+ up) To curl one's body closely up for warmth or comfort. 3. [I] To gather privately to discuss something.

examples.en: The stray puppies huddled together by the radiator to keep warm.
examples.zh: 流浪小狗挤在暖气片旁取暖。

lemmas.usage_note: 动词，指因寒冷、恐惧等挤作一团，或蜷缩身体，常与 together, around 搭配使用。

lemmas.def_zh: 杂乱一团, 混乱, 拥挤
lemmas.def_en: (informal) a quick private conference

examples.en: The coach called the players into a quick huddle before the final play.
examples.zh: 教练在最后一攻前召集球员们紧急碰头商讨战术。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，指挤成一团的人群或杂乱堆积，美式英语中常指（比赛或密谈时的）碰头协商。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 huddle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 小孩, 少量, 合计
lemmas.def_en: a small amount (especially of a drink)

examples.en: She offered the freezing sailor a small tot of rum to warm him up.
examples.zh: 她给浑身发冷的落水水手倒了一小口朗姆酒暖身。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，口语指刚学会走路的小孩，也可指一小口烈酒，常见于英式日常表达中。

lemmas.def_zh: （tot up）把……加起来，合计；总计为
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] ('tot up') (chiefly British informal) To add numbers or amounts together to find the total sum. 2. [I] ('tot up to') To amount to a total.

examples.en: Let's tot up the total expenses before we finalize the budget.
examples.zh: 在最终确定预算之前，我们先把总开销核算出来。

lemmas.usage_note: 动词，主要用于短语 tot up，意为“合计、总计为”，属于非正式英语口语用法。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 义务的, 必须的, 强制性的
lemmas.def_en: morally or legally constraining or binding

examples.en: Wearing protective helmets on the construction site is obligatory for all visitors.
examples.zh: 所有访客在施工现场佩戴安全帽是强制要求的。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，指依法律、规章等强制必须履行的，正式语境多与 for/to 连用，常修饰 course, attendance。

lemmas.def_zh: obligatory（有义务的）的变形
lemmas.def_en: in an obligatory manner

examples.en: this rule applies obligatorily

family_guide.root_logic: 以 obligatory 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 踏车, 令人厌倦的工作
lemmas.def_en: an exercise device consisting of an endless belt on which a person can walk or jog without changing place

examples.en: She spends thirty minutes every morning jogging on the treadmill.
examples.zh: 她每天早晨在跑步机上慢跑三十分钟。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，指健身用跑步机，常与 run on, buy 搭配；比喻单调乏味且停不下来的枯燥工作。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 treadmill 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 香, 香气, 奉承
lemmas.def_en: a substance that produces a fragrant odor when burned

examples.en: The fragrance of burning incense filled every corner of the ancient temple.
examples.zh: 燃烧的熏香散发出的香气弥漫在古庙的每一个角落。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指宗教仪式中燃烧的熏香或散发的香气，常见搭配 burn incense、incense stick。

lemmas.def_zh: 激怒，使大怒；焚香，用香熏
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (often passive) to make someone extremely angry and indignant. 2. [T] to perfume or burn with incense.

examples.en: The unfair decision incensed local residents, who immediately took to the streets in protest.
examples.zh: 这一不公正的决定激怒了当地居民，他们随即上街抗议。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作及物动词表示“激怒”，多用于被动语态 be incensed at/by/with，语气极重。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 incense 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 精神疗法, 心理疗法
lemmas.def_en: the branch of psychiatry concerned with psychological methods

examples.en: She decided to undergo psychotherapy to cope with her severe anxiety and past trauma.
examples.zh: 她决定接受心理治疗，以应对严重的焦虑情绪和过去的心理创伤。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，专指通过心理学手段治疗心理疾病的疗法，常与 undergo、offer 搭配。

lemmas.def_zh: 精神治疗医生
lemmas.def_en: a therapist who deals with mental and emotional disorders

lemmas.def_zh: 精神疗法药
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or practicing psychotherapy

examples.en: The doctor explored both psychotherapeutic approaches and medication to treat the patient's severe anxiety.
examples.zh: 医生尝试了精神疗法和药物治疗来应对患者的严重焦虑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 psychotherapy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 将……钉在十字架上处死；严厉批评，严惩
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (historical) To execute someone by nailing or tying them to a wooden cross. 2. [T] (informal) To criticize or punish someone severely.

examples.en: The critics will completely crucify his new film for its chaotic plot and poor acting.
examples.zh: 评论家们会因为这部新电影混乱的剧情和糟糕的演技而把它批得体无完肤。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，原义为“钉死在十字架上”，现代英语常引申指“严厉谴责”或“残酷折磨”。

lemmas.def_zh: 在十字架上钉死的刑罚, 酷刑, 苦难, 折磨
lemmas.def_en: the act of executing by a method widespread in the ancient world; the victim's hands and feet are bound or nailed to a cross

examples.en: Historical records describe the brutal process of crucifixion practiced during that era.
examples.zh: 历史记录描述了那个时代所实施的残酷的十字架酷刑过程。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，既可指古代的“十字架刑”，也常用于比喻极其痛苦折磨的经历，前常加 the。

lemmas.def_zh: 十字架
lemmas.def_en: representation of the cross on which Jesus died

examples.en: The monk held a wooden crucifix in his hands while softly reciting prayers.
examples.zh: 修道士手里握着一个木制耶稣受难像十字架，低声诵念着祷文。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，特指带有耶稣受难像的十字架圣物或饰品，常与 wear、hold 搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crucify 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 尸体
lemmas.def_en: the dead body of an animal especially one slaughtered and dressed for food

examples.en: Vultures circled in the sky, waiting to feed on the carcass of the fallen deer.
examples.zh: 秃鹫在空中盘旋，等待着啄食倒下的鹿的尸体。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指动物尸体（尤指被宰杀或腐食的），亦可戏称残破的躯壳或废墟框架。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 carcass 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 意见不同的, 持不同政见的
lemmas.def_en: characterized by departure from accepted beliefs or standards

examples.en: Several dissident journalists were banned from publishing articles critical of the regime.
examples.zh: 几位持不同政见的记者被禁止发表批评该政权的文章。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，指“持异见或反对官方政策的”，常修饰 voice、group、writer 等名词。

lemmas.def_zh: 意见不同的人, 持不同政见者
lemmas.def_en: a person who dissents from some established policy

examples.en: The government released an imprisoned political dissident following international pressure.
examples.zh: 在国际压力下，政府释放了一名被监禁的政治异见人士。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指“持不同政见者”，多用于政治、社会议题语境中，常与 political 搭配。

lemmas.def_zh: 意见不同, 不同意, 异议
lemmas.def_en: disagreement; especially disagreement with the government

examples.en: The authoritarian regime took extreme measures to suppress any growing political dissidence.
examples.zh: 该专制政权采取极端手段镇压任何日益抬头的政治异见。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dissident 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 女傧相
lemmas.def_en: an unmarried woman who attends the bride at a wedding

examples.en: She asked her younger sister to serve as the chief bridesmaid at her wedding.
examples.zh: 她邀请自己的妹妹在她的婚礼上担任首席女傧相。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指婚礼上的女傧相，习语 always a bridesmaid 喻指总是屈居次席的人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bridesmaid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 航空学, 飞行术
lemmas.def_en: the theory and practice of navigation through air or space

examples.en: He earned an advanced degree in aeronautics and now designs commercial aircraft.
examples.zh: 他获得了航空学的高级学位，目前从事商用飞机的设计工作。

lemmas.usage_note: 学科名词，形式为复数但常作单数用，指航空学或飞行技术，学术及工程语体常用。

lemmas.def_zh: 航空的, 航空学的
lemmas.def_en: of or pertaining to aeronautics

lemmas.def_zh: 航空的
lemmas.def_en: of or pertaining to aeronautics

examples.en: She pursued an aeronautic engineering degree to design next-generation passenger aircraft.
examples.zh: 她攻读航空工程学位，以设计下一代客机。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 aeronautics 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使窒息致死，闷死；闷熄（火）；扼杀，抑制；厚厚覆盖
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To kill someone by covering their face so they cannot breathe. 2. [T] To extinguish a fire by cutting off air. 3. [T] To suppress or stifle an emotion or action. 4. [T] (+ with/in) To cover something thickly.

examples.en: Firefighters used heavy wool blankets to smother the flames before they could spread.
examples.zh: 消防员用厚羊毛毯扑灭了火焰，防止其进一步蔓延。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指用厚物使窒息、捂灭火焰，或引申为抑制情绪、密集覆盖（with/in）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 smother 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 自以为是的, 自鸣得意的, 整洁的
lemmas.def_en: marked by excessive complacency or self-satisfaction

examples.en: He wore a smug grin after correctly predicting the outcome of the competition.
examples.zh: 在准确预测了比赛结果后，他脸上露出了自鸣得意的笑容。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，含贬义，指沾沾自喜、自鸣得意的神态或态度，常搭配 smile、look、expression。

lemmas.def_zh: 沾沾自喜地；自鸣得意地
lemmas.def_en: in a smug manner

examples.en: the bureaucrats explained smugly that the facts provided by their own experts show no cause for concern

lemmas.def_zh: 矫矜；装模做样
lemmas.def_en: an excessive feeling of self-satisfaction

family_guide.root_logic: 以 smug 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 觉醒, 幻灭
lemmas.def_en: freeing from false belief or illusions

examples.en: The scandal caused widespread disillusion among voters who had trusted the candidate.
examples.zh: 这起丑闻在曾信任该候选人的选民中引起了普遍的幻灭感。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数或可数名词，指理想破灭后的清醒与失望感，常见搭配 a sense of disillusion。

lemmas.def_zh: 幻灭,觉醒
lemmas.def_en: freeing from false belief or illusions

lemmas.def_zh: 使幻灭，使幻想破灭，使醒悟
lemmas.def_en: [T] (often passive) To destroy someone's illusions, making them realize that something they admired is not as good as they thought.

examples.en: Working closely with his idol quickly disillusioned him about the glamorous film industry.
examples.zh: 与偶像共事的经历很快打破了他对光鲜亮丽的电影行业的幻想。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指“使清醒、使幻想破灭”，极常以过去分词作形容词 disillusioned 呈现。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 disillusion 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 棱堡, 阵地工事
lemmas.def_en: a group that defends a principle

examples.en: The university has long been regarded as a bastion of free speech and academic inquiry.
examples.zh: 这所大学长期以来一直被视为言论自由和学术探究的坚固堡垒。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作比喻，指坚固的堡垒或传统守护者；高频搭配为 bastion of (freedom/hope)。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bastion 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 三人一组, 三人的竞赛
lemmas.def_en: the cardinal number that is the sum of one and one and one

examples.en: The energetic threesome spent the entire afternoon playing golf together.
examples.zh: 这个活力充沛的三人组一起打了一整个下午的高尔夫球。

lemmas.usage_note: 用于日常或运动语境，指三人组或三人进行的比赛；作主语时谓语多用单数。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 threesome 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 附加，增补（于末尾）
lemmas.def_en: [T] (+ to) (formal) To add a piece of writing, signature, or document to the end of an official text.

examples.en: Please read the terms thoroughly before you append your signature to the contract.
examples.zh: 在合同上签字之前，请仔细阅读相关条款。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面语动词，指在文件末尾添加文字或签名；常用搭配为 append sth to sth。

lemmas.def_zh: 附加物, 附器
lemmas.def_en: an external body part that projects from the body

examples.en: it is important to keep the extremities warm

lemmas.def_zh: 附加的, 附属的
lemmas.def_en: affixed as an appendage

family_guide.root_logic: 以 append 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可笑的, 滑稽的, 荒唐的
lemmas.def_en: broadly or extravagantly humorous; resembling farce

examples.en: Paying fifty dollars for a single cup of coffee is absolutely ludicrous.
examples.zh: 一杯咖啡要付五十美元简直太荒谬可笑了。

lemmas.usage_note: 强评价性形容词，修饰主张、价格或建议，强调荒谬可笑；语气重于 absurd。

lemmas.def_zh: 滑稽地, 荒唐地
lemmas.def_en: so as to arouse or deserve laughter

examples.en: her income was laughably small, but she managed to live well

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ludicrous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 乡绅, 大地主, 治安官
lemmas.def_en: young nobleman attendant on a knight

examples.en: The local squire owned vast acres of fertile farmland across the county.
examples.zh: 当地的乡绅在整个郡内拥有大片肥沃的农田。

lemmas.usage_note: 主要用于英国历史或乡村背景，指乡绅或大地主；常作专有名词的前缀或称谓。

lemmas.def_zh: 护送，陪同（尤指男子侍从女子）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (dated or humorous) When a man squires a woman, he accompanies and attends her to a social event.

examples.en: He had the honor of squiring the guest of honor around the estate.
examples.zh: 他有幸护送主宾参观了整个庄园。

lemmas.usage_note: 较古典或幽默用法，及物动词，指（男士）护送或随侍（女士）；直接接宾语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 squire 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 灵敏的, 精巧的, 聪明的
lemmas.def_en: showing inventiveness and skill

examples.en: She devised an ingenious solution that resolved the system bottleneck in minutes.
examples.zh: 她构想出了一个巧妙的解决方案，几分钟内就解决了系统瓶颈。

lemmas.usage_note: 褒义形容词，修饰人时指才思敏捷，修饰物时指设计巧妙；常与 method/solution 连用。

lemmas.def_zh: 有才能地, 贤明地
lemmas.def_en: in an ingenious manner

examples.en: a Hampshire farmer had fowls of different breeds, including Dorkings, and he discriminated ingeniously between the `dark ones' and the `white ones'

lemmas.def_zh: 心灵手巧, 精巧, 精巧设计
lemmas.def_en: the power of creative imagination

examples.en: The success of the mission demonstrated the remarkable ingenuity of the engineers.
examples.zh: 任务的成功展现了工程师们非凡的聪明才智与创造力。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，强调独创性与创造力；常见搭配包括 human ingenuity、with ingenuity。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ingenious 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 魅力, 诱惑力
lemmas.def_en: the power to entice or attract through personal charm

examples.en: The allure of quick riches blinded many investors to the obvious risks.
examples.zh: 快速致富的诱惑让许多投资者对显而易见的风险视而不见。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面语不可数名词，指强烈的吸引力或神秘魅力；常搭配 the allure of (fame/power)。

lemmas.def_zh: 引诱, 诱惑
lemmas.def_en: attractiveness

examples.en: its allurement was its remoteness

lemmas.def_zh: 诱惑，吸引，迷住
lemmas.def_en: [T] (literary) to powerfully attract, tempt, or charm someone

examples.en: Bright city lights and endless opportunities continue to allure young graduates.
examples.zh: 璀璨的都市霓虹与无尽的机遇持续吸引着年轻的毕业生们。

lemmas.usage_note: 文学或正式动词，指诱惑或深深吸引；常用于被动语态或作及物动词接人称宾语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 allure 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 幼虫, 乏味之人
lemmas.def_en: informal terms for a meal

examples.en: The bird probed the damp soil looking for a fat grub to eat.
examples.zh: 那只鸟试探着啄着潮湿的泥土，寻找肥美的幼虫充饥。

lemmas.usage_note: 指昆虫幼虫时为可数名词；非正式俚语中也可作不可数名词指日常食物。

lemmas.def_en: small sculpin of the coast of New England

lemmas.def_zh: 翻掘，搜寻，刨挖
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To dig or search untidily in the earth or among objects to find something

examples.en: Wild boars were grubbing for truffles beneath the ancient oak trees.
examples.zh: 野猪正在古老的橡树下翻掘寻找松露。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与介词 about/around/up 搭配，表示在泥土或堆积物中摸索、翻寻或挖掘。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 grub 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 截肢，切除（手臂、腿等）
lemmas.def_en: [T] To cut off an arm, leg, finger, or toe by surgical operation.

examples.en: Doctors had no choice but to amputate his lower leg to prevent infection.
examples.zh: 为防止感染扩散，医生别无选择，只能为他实施小腿截肢手术。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学专业动词，指通过手术切除肢体；及物用法，常搭配 amputate a limb/leg。

lemmas.def_zh: 切断, 截肢术
lemmas.def_en: a condition of disability resulting from the loss of one or more limbs

family_guide.root_logic: 以 amputate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 放弃，舍弃（尤指令人满意之物）；居先，在……之前发生
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (variant of forgo) To decide to do without or give up something enjoyable or advantageous. 2. [T] (archaic) To precede in time or place.

examples.en: She decided to forego a lavish holiday in order to pay off her student loans.
examples.zh: 为了还清助学贷款，她决定放弃一次奢华的度假。

lemmas.usage_note: 与 forgo 常通用，及物动词，指克制或放弃（乐趣、机会等）；直接接名词宾语。

lemmas.def_zh: （forego的过去分词）放弃，舍弃；居先
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] Past participle of forego: to have given up or preceded.

examples.en: Stone tools precede bronze tools

lemmas.def_zh: forego的过去式
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] Past tense of forego; gave up or preceded.

examples.en: Stone tools precede bronze tools

family_guide.root_logic: 以 forego 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 药用蜀葵, 蜀葵糖剂
lemmas.def_en: spongy confection made of gelatin and sugar and corn syrup and dusted with powdered sugar

examples.en: The children gathered around the campfire to roast sweet marshmallows.
examples.zh: 孩子们围在篝火旁烤甜甜的棉花糖。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指棉花糖，在植物学中亦指药用蜀葵，常见搭配有 roast marshmallows（烤棉花糖）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 marshmallow 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 电容器
lemmas.def_en: an electrical device characterized by its capacity to store an electric charge

examples.en: A faulty capacitor caused the entire circuit board to overheat and fail.
examples.zh: 一个有缺陷的电容器导致整个电路板过热并损坏。

lemmas.usage_note: 电子工程核心专业词汇，指储存电荷的电容器，常与 charge（充电）、discharge（放电）搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 capacitor 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 轻蔑, 藐视, 嘲笑, 被嘲弄的人
lemmas.def_en: lack of respect accompanied by a feeling of intense dislike

examples.en: Her innovative proposals were met with open scorn by the traditional board members.
examples.zh: 她富有创新性的提议遭到了传统董事会成员的公然嘲弄。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面语色彩浓厚，常与 pour/heap scorn on 或 treat with scorn 搭配，表示强烈的鄙视态度。

lemmas.def_zh: 轻蔑者；藐视者；嘲笑者
lemmas.def_en: a person who expresses contempt by remarks or facial expression

lemmas.def_zh: 鄙视，轻蔑；不屑接受，摒弃
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To feel or show contempt and disdain for someone or something. 2. [T] To reject or refuse something with contempt.

examples.en: He scorned their offer of assistance, determined to solve the crisis alone.
examples.zh: 他轻蔑地拒绝了他们提供的帮助，决心独自解决这场危机。

lemmas.usage_note: 可及物，后接名词或不定式（scorn to do sth），表示不屑于接受或轻蔑地拒绝某事。

lemmas.def_zh: 轻蔑的
lemmas.def_en: expressing extreme contempt

lemmas.def_zh: 鄙视地, 轻蔑地
lemmas.def_en: without respect; in a disdainful manner

examples.en: she spoke of him contemptuously

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scorn 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 小狗儿
lemmas.def_en: informal terms for dogs

examples.en: The little girl gently patted the stray doggy on its head.
examples.zh: 小女孩轻轻地拍了拍那只流浪小狗的头。

lemmas.usage_note: 口语与儿语常用词，指小狗，亦常出现于 doggy bag（餐后打包袋）这一常用合成词中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 doggy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 铺鹅卵石于；草率拼凑，粗制（常与 together 连用）；修补（鞋等）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To pave a road or surface with cobblestones. 2. [T] (cobble together/up) To assemble or produce something quickly and roughly. 3. [T] To mend or repair shoes.

examples.en: They managed to cobble together a temporary agreement before the midnight deadline.
examples.zh: 他们在午夜截止时间前勉强拼凑出了一份临时协议。

lemmas.usage_note: 作动词时常与 together 搭配构成短语 cobble together，表示匆忙或粗糙地拼凑、拼凑解决。

lemmas.def_zh: 皮匠, 补鞋匠, 笨工匠
lemmas.def_en: a person who makes or repairs shoes

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cobble 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 球, 天体, 球状物
lemmas.def_en: the ball-shaped capsule containing the vertebrate eye

examples.en: The golden orb of the sun slowly dipped below the distant horizon.
examples.zh: 金色的太阳圆球缓缓沉入远处的地平线之下。

lemmas.usage_note: 文学语体词汇，多用于诗歌或描绘性文本中，代指太阳、月亮或行星等发光的球状天体。

lemmas.def_zh: 绕轨道运行；使成球形，成圆形
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] (poetic) To move in a circular orbit, or to encircle or form into a sphere.

examples.en: Soft mists began to orb around the glowing lamps as the cold evening fell.
examples.zh: 随着寒夜降临，柔和的薄雾开始环绕在发光的街灯周围成圈。

lemmas.usage_note: 极罕见的文学/诗歌动词用法，意为围成圆形、盘旋环绕或使成球形，具浓厚修辞色彩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 orb 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 快乐, 幸福, 幸运
lemmas.def_en: pleasing and appropriate manner or style (especially manner or style of expression)

examples.en: The couple enjoyed years of domestic felicity away from the noisy city.
examples.zh: 这对夫妇远离嘈杂的城市，享受了多年的家庭幸福。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面语，既可表极大幸福感，也可指言语文学作品中用词的得体与巧妙（felicity of expression）。

lemmas.def_zh: 祝贺, 祝词
lemmas.def_en: (usually plural) an expression of pleasure at the success or good fortune of another

examples.en: I sent them my sincere congratulations on their marriage

lemmas.def_zh: 巧妙的, 极为适当的, 善于措辞的, 可喜的
lemmas.def_en: exhibiting an agreeably appropriate manner or style

examples.en: a felicitous speaker

lemmas.def_zh: 庆祝, 庆贺
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (+ on) (formal / archaic) To congratulate someone warmly on a happy occasion or achievement.

lemmas.def_zh: 恰当地, 适切地
lemmas.def_en: in a felicitous manner

examples.en: a not felicitously chosen word

family_guide.root_logic: 以 felicity 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 喧闹, 裙撑
lemmas.def_en: a rapid active commotion

examples.en: I wanted to escape the hustle and bustle of modern downtown life.
examples.zh: 我想要逃离现代市中心生活的喧嚣与忙碌。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于固定习语 bustle and hustle 或 the bustle of the city，表人群熙熙攘攘的喧闹状态。

lemmas.def_zh: 奔忙，匆忙走动；熙熙攘攘，充满活力
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (+ about/around) To move around in a hurried, busy, and energetic manner. 2. [I] (+ with) To be full of bustling activity or people.

examples.en: Waiters bustled around the dining room, attending to the evening guests.
examples.zh: 服务员们在餐厅里忙前忙后，照应着晚间的客人们。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作不及物动词，与介词 in/out/around 搭配，形容人慌忙走动或充满活跃生机（bustle with）。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 繁华忙碌的；熙熙攘攘的
lemmas.def_en: full of lively, energetic, and noisy activity
lemmas.usage_note: 常用于修饰城市、市场或街道，如 a bustling city / market / street。

examples.en: We wandered through the bustling streets of downtown Tokyo.
examples.zh: 我们漫步在东京市中心熙熙攘攘的街道上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bustle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 新成员
lemmas.def_en: any new participant in some activity

examples.en: As a newbie to programming, she found the complex syntax rather confusing.
examples.zh: 作为一名编程新手，她觉得那些复杂的语法相当令人困惑。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式网络与职场口语，指某领域的新手或网络社区的新注册用户，略带调侃。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 newbie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 眼皮, 眼睑
lemmas.def_en: either of two folds of skin that can be moved to cover or open the eye

examples.en: He heard the shocking announcement without even batting an eyelid.
examples.zh: 他听到那个令人震惊的消息时，甚至连眼皮都没眨一下。

lemmas.usage_note: 解剖学与日常均常用，高频搭配有 bat an eyelid（眨眼，常用于否定句表无动于衷）与 heavy eyelids。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 eyelid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 运动员, 冒险家
lemmas.def_en: someone who engages in sports

examples.en: He proved himself a true sportsman by congratulating his opponent on the hard-fought victory.
examples.zh: 他向对手在艰难比赛中的胜利表示祝贺，展现了真正的体育精神。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指擅长或热爱户外运动（如狩猎、钓鱼）的男性运动员，也可引申指具有良好体育道德精神的人。

lemmas.def_zh: 运动员精神
lemmas.def_en: fairness in following the rules of the game

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sportsman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 语音信箱
lemmas.def_en: a computerized system for answering and routing telephone calls; telephone messages can be recorded and stored and relayed

examples.en: I was unable to answer your call, but I listened to your voicemail and will get back to you shortly.
examples.zh: 我刚才没接电话，但我听了你的语音留言，很快就会回复你。

lemmas.usage_note: 现代通讯高频词，既可指语音留言系统，也可指留下的具体语音信息，常与 leave 或 check 搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 voicemail 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 小片, 片断, 摘录
lemmas.def_en: a small piece of anything (especially a piece that has been snipped off)

examples.en: The journalist published a brief snippet of the interview to tease the upcoming exclusive report.
examples.zh: 该记者公布了采访的一小段片段，为即将推出的独家报道预热。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指从信息、对话、音乐或代码中摘出的一小段、小碎片，多与 of 连用（如 snippet of news/code）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 snippet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使无效，使作废；证明……不成立
lemmas.def_en: [T] to officially make something legally invalid or no longer acceptable; to prove that an argument, idea, or result is incorrect

examples.en: Any unauthorized signature on the contract will immediately invalidate the entire agreement.
examples.zh: 合同上任何未经授权的签名都将立即使整份协议失效。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式法律或学术用语，表示通过证据或程序使合同、论点、选举结果失效或被推翻。

lemmas.def_zh: 无效, 失效
lemmas.def_en: (law) a formal termination (of a relationship or a judicial proceeding etc)

family_guide.root_logic: 以 invalidate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 英勇的
lemmas.def_en: having or showing valor

examples.en: Despite their valiant efforts to defend the title, the team was defeated in the final minutes.
examples.zh: 尽管为了卫冕付出了英勇的努力，该队仍在最后几分钟惜败。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面庄重词汇，形容人或行为（尤其是即使面临失败仍展现出的）勇敢果决，常修饰 effort 或 soldier。

lemmas.def_zh: 勇敢地, 英勇地; 雄赳赳
lemmas.def_en: with valor; in a valiant manner

examples.en: he fought valiantly until the end

family_guide.root_logic: 以 valiant 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 目不识丁的, 没受教育的
lemmas.def_en: not able to read or write

examples.en: Many rural villagers remained illiterate until the government launched an adult education program.
examples.zh: 在政府开展成人教育项目之前，许多乡村村民依然目不识丁。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可指不识字的，也常用于隐喻引申义，表示在某一专业领域（如计算机、金融）毫无常识的。

lemmas.def_zh: 文盲
lemmas.def_en: a person unable to read

examples.en: The evening classes were established primarily to teach adult illiterates how to read and write.
examples.zh: 开设夜校主要是为了教授成年文盲读书写字。

lemmas.usage_note: 指缺乏读写能力的人或某领域的一窍不通者，为可数名词，语体中需注意避免贬损色彩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 illiterate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 纵线, 纵座标
lemmas.def_en: the value of a coordinate on the vertical axis

examples.en: In the graph, the abscissa represents time while the ordinate indicates temperature change.
examples.zh: 在图表中，横坐标代表时间，而纵坐标表示温度变化。

lemmas.usage_note: 数学及测量专业术语，指笛卡尔坐标系中的纵坐标（y值），与横坐标 abscissa 相对。

lemmas.def_zh: 授予圣职，任命；整顿，安排
lemmas.def_en: [T] (rare or archaic) To ordain someone to a religious office; to order or arrange.

examples.en: The algorithm was designed to ordinate each point on the grid according to its vertical displacement.
examples.zh: 该算法旨在根据垂直位移确定网格上每个点的纵坐标位置。

lemmas.usage_note: 罕见的数学或生理组织学术语，表示使有序排列或在坐标系中确定纵坐标位置。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ordinate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 猛烈攻击，袭击；质问，抨击；困扰
lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. To attack someone violently or physically. 2. To criticize strongly or be troubled persistently by something.

examples.en: Reporters assailed the spokesperson with aggressive questions regarding the financial scandal.
examples.zh: 记者们就这起财务丑闻向发言人发起了连珠炮般的质问。

lemmas.usage_note: 文学或正式语体，既可指物理上的猛烈攻击，也可引申指用质疑、批评围攻，或指疑虑/气味困扰某人。

lemmas.def_zh: 攻击者
lemmas.def_en: someone who attacks

family_guide.root_logic: 以 assail 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 军需品
lemmas.def_en: weapons considered collectively

examples.en: The army suffered severe supply shortages and urgently needed more munition to sustain the defense.
examples.zh: 该军队遭遇严重的补给短缺，急需更多军火物资来维持防御。

lemmas.usage_note: 军事与国防术语，多用复数 munitions 表示弹药与军火武器，单数常作定语修饰 factory 等。

lemmas.def_zh: 供给军需品；为……装备武器弹药
lemmas.def_en: [T] To supply an army, fort, or ship with weapons and ammunition.

examples.en: The allied forces worked continuously to munition the frontline troops before the offensive began.
examples.zh: 盟军在攻势开始前持续不断地向前线部队供给军需物资。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，较正式罕见，意为“向……供应军火物资”或“为军队配备武器弹药”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 munition 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 含糊其辞，回避；篡改，捏造（以蒙混过关）
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To avoid giving a clear statement, answer, or commitment; to adjust or manipulate figures or facts deceptively.

examples.en: The politician tried to fudge the issue rather than giving a direct answer about the budget deficit.
examples.zh: 这位政客试图对预算赤字问题含糊其辞，而不是给出直接回答。

lemmas.usage_note: 口语与政经新闻高频词，指含糊其辞、篡改数据或敷衍应付问题以逃避责任，常与 the issue/figures 搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fudge 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 将…收归国有，实行国有化
lemmas.def_en: [T] to bring an industry, company, or land under the control and ownership of the government

examples.en: The newly elected government plans to nationalize the country's railway system next year.
examples.zh: 新当选的政府计划在明年将全国的铁路系统收归国有。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于政治经济语境，指政府将私有财产或行业收归国有，常接 industry、railways 等作宾语。

lemmas.def_zh: 将…收归国有，实行国有化
lemmas.def_en: [T] (chiefly British English) to bring an industry, company, or land under the control and ownership of the government

examples.en: His heroic deeds were nationalized by the press

lemmas.def_zh: 同化, 归化, 国有化
lemmas.def_en: the action of forming or becoming a nation

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nationalize 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 低语，低声说；轻声私语；发连续柔和的声音
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. To speak or say something very softly and quietly. 2. To make a continuous low, gentle sound.

examples.en: She leaned close to murmur a quiet apology before slipping out of the room.
examples.zh: 她凑近低声说了句道歉，随后悄悄退出了房间。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示小声嘀咕、轻声述说或私下抱怨，常接 direct speech 或介词 against/at，语感柔和或压抑。

lemmas.def_zh: 低语, 低声的怨言
lemmas.def_en: a low continuous indistinct sound; often accompanied by movement of the lips without the production of articulate speech

examples.en: A soft murmur of approval rippled through the audience after the speech.
examples.zh: 演讲结束后，听众席中传出一阵轻声的赞许。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指听不真切的低语声、流水微风的沙沙声或轻微怨言，常与 a murmur of 搭配使用。

lemmas.def_zh: 低声咕哝
lemmas.def_en: a low continuous indistinct sound; often accompanied by movement of the lips without the production of articulate speech

family_guide.root_logic: 以 murmur 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 色情（书刊、电影等, 等于pornography）
lemmas.def_en: creative activity (writing or pictures or films etc.) of no literary or artistic value other than to stimulate sexual desire

examples.en: He was caught trying to download illegal porno onto his work laptop.
examples.zh: 他试图在工作笔记本上下载非法色情片时被当场抓获。

lemmas.usage_note: 属于口语及非正式语体，为 pornography 的缩写，常用于指代色情出版物、影片或相关产业。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 porno 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 镇痛软膏, 香膏
lemmas.def_en: any of various aromatic resinous substances used for healing and soothing

examples.en: Her gentle, reassuring words were a soothing balm to his wounded pride.
examples.zh: 她温柔而安慰的话语，抚慰了他受挫的自尊心。

lemmas.usage_note: 本义指药膏或香膏，常引申为使人心情平静、抚平心灵创伤的事物，多与介词 to/for 连用。

lemmas.def_zh: 芳香的, 温和的, 止痛的
lemmas.def_en: informal or slang terms for mentally irregular

examples.en: it used to drive my husband balmy

family_guide.root_logic: 以 balm 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 血统, 家谱, 名门世系
lemmas.def_en: the descendants of one individual

examples.en: This award-winning dog comes with an official pedigree tracing back five generations.
examples.zh: 这只获奖名犬附有可追溯至五代以上的官方血统证书。

lemmas.usage_note: 指动植物纯正的血统谱系，或人的高贵出身及某事物的优良沿革历史，常搭配 of pedigree。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pedigree 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （液体）滤去，浸出，沥滤；被滤除
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] to wash chemicals or minerals out of soil, stone, or waste by water percolating through, or to be washed away in this way

examples.en: Toxic chemicals began to leach from the landfill into the surrounding groundwater.
examples.zh: 有毒化学物质开始从垃圾填埋场滤出，渗入周边的地下水中。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于环境科学或化学语境，表示液体滤去矿物质或化学物质滤出，多接介词 into/from/out of。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 leach 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 雪撬
lemmas.def_en: a vehicle mounted on runners and pulled by horses or dogs; for transportation over snow

examples.en: The children dragged their wooden sled up the snow-covered hill.
examples.zh: 孩子们把木制雪橇一路拖上了积雪覆盖的小山坡。

lemmas.usage_note: 北美常用词，指在雪地或冰面上滑行的小型雪橇，常作可数名词，搭配 on a sled 等。

lemmas.def_zh: 乘雪橇滑行；用雪橇运送
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] (chiefly North American) To ride down snow on a sled, or transport loads using a sled.

examples.en: Every winter, hundreds of families gather in the park to sled down the slopes.
examples.zh: 每年冬天，成百上千个家庭都会聚在公园里乘雪橇滑下斜坡。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，指坐雪橇滑雪作为娱乐活动，常与 down the hill 等移动方向搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sled 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 飞机场
lemmas.def_en: a place where planes take off and land

examples.en: The cargo planes landed on a remote airfield deep inside the jungle.
examples.zh: 货运飞机降落在了丛林深处一座偏僻的简易机场上。

lemmas.usage_note: 指规模较小、设施相对简陋的简易机场，多见于军用、私人飞行或紧急起降等语境中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 airfield 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (=freakish)畸形的, 捉摸不定的
lemmas.def_en: strange and somewhat frightening

examples.en: It was really freaky how much the stranger looked like my deceased grandfather.
examples.zh: 那个陌生人和我已故的祖父长得极为相似，真让人毛骨悚然。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式口语形容词，形容事物极其怪异、不可思议或反常得令人不安，多用于口语交流。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 freaky 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 掠夺成性的, 捕食生物的, 掠夺的
lemmas.def_en: characterized by plundering or pillaging or marauding

examples.en: The agency was fined for engaging in predatory lending practices that targeted low-income borrowers.
examples.zh: 该机构因针对低收入借贷人实施掠夺性借贷行为而被处以罚款。

lemmas.usage_note: 生物学指掠食性的；商业或社会学中常作贬义，修饰掠夺性、剥削性的行为或资本，如 predatory lending。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 predatory 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 再生的, 更新的
lemmas.def_en: spiritually reborn or converted

examples.en: After taking a long walk in the crisp mountain air, she felt completely reborn and full of hope.
examples.zh: 在清新的山间空气中长途漫步后，她感到脱胎换骨，重新充满了希望。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作表语或定语，多用于比喻义，常见搭配有 feel reborn、a reborn spirit，表达获得新生或精神重振。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reborn 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 氧化
lemmas.def_en: the process of oxidizing; the addition of oxygen to a compound with a loss of electrons; always occurs accompanied by reduction

examples.en: Applying a protective layer of paint helps prevent the oxidation of iron structures exposed to moisture.
examples.zh: 涂上一层保护漆有助于防止暴露在潮湿环境中的铁结构发生氧化。

lemmas.usage_note: 学术与科技文体中常见，多作不可数名词，常与 prevent、undergo 或 process 连用，指化学氧化过程。

lemmas.def_zh: 氧化的
lemmas.def_en: taking place in the presence of oxygen

examples.en: Antioxidants found in fresh berries can protect human cells from oxidative damage.
examples.zh: 新鲜浆果中发现的抗氧化剂能够保护人体细胞免受氧化损伤。

lemmas.usage_note: 生物化学及医学专业术语，多作前置定语，高频搭配包括 oxidative stress（氧化应激）与 oxidative damage。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 oxidation 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 微红的, 略带红色的
lemmas.def_en: of a color at the end of the color spectrum (next to orange); resembling the color of blood or cherries or tomatoes or rubies

examples.en: As the sun dipped below the horizon, the evening sky took on a warm, reddish glow.
examples.zh: 夕阳跌落至地平线以下时，傍晚的天空泛起了一层温暖的微红光芒。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于客观外貌描写，常与 brown、purple、glow 或 tint 等词搭配，表示带有微红色调。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reddish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 轮盘赌, 点线机, 骑缝线
lemmas.def_en: a line generated by a point on one figure rolling around a second figure

examples.en: The tourist decided to try his luck by betting a few chips at the roulette table.
examples.zh: 这位游客决定在轮盘赌桌上下几枚筹码碰碰运气。

lemmas.usage_note: 作可数或不可数名词均可，常搭配 play roulette 或 Russian roulette（俄罗斯轮盘赌），引申指冒险行径。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 roulette 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] PASCAL语言
lemmas.def_en: a unit of pressure equal to one newton per square meter

examples.en: In the 1980s, many universities chose Pascal as the primary language to teach structured programming.
examples.zh: 20世纪80年代，许多大学选择Pascal作为讲授结构化编程的主流语言。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可指计算机高级编程语言（首字母通常大写），也可指国际压强单位（帕斯卡，符号为 Pa）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pascal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: being one more than thirteen

examples.en: Please turn to Chapter XIV of the textbook to review the principles of fluid mechanics.
examples.zh: 请翻到教科书第十四章，复习流体力学的相关原理。

lemmas.usage_note: 罗马数字14的表示法，书面语中常用作后置定语标示章节、世纪或统治者序号，如 Chapter XIV、Louis XIV。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 xiv 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 二, 两, 一对
lemmas.def_en: two items of the same kind

examples.en: The violent earthquake struck without warning and tore the ancient stone bridge in twain.
examples.zh: 强烈的地震毫无预警地袭来，将那座古老的石桥生生撕裂成两截。

lemmas.usage_note: 古英语或文学修辞用词，意为“二者”，多见于固定习语如 rent in twain（撕成两半）或 never the twain shall meet。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 twain 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 看得见地, 明显地, 明白地
lemmas.def_en: in a visible manner

examples.en: The speaker was visibly shaken after an audience member interrupted her presentation with harsh remarks.
examples.zh: 在一名听众用尖刻的言辞打断她的演讲后，这位发言人显然受到了极大的震动。

lemmas.usage_note: 主要修饰表示情绪外露或身体状态的动词与形容词，常见搭配有 visibly shaken、visibly upset、tremble visibly。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 visibly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 麻烦的, 令人讨厌的
lemmas.def_en: difficult to deal with

examples.en: The persistent engine noise turned out to be a troublesome problem for the maintenance crew.
examples.zh: 持续不断的发动机噪音被证实是让维修团队相当棘手的一个麻烦问题。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰抽象问题、疾病症状或不听话的人，高频搭配有 troublesome issue、troublesome cough、troublesome behavior。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 troublesome 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 牙科
lemmas.def_en: the branch of medicine dealing with the anatomy and development and diseases of the teeth

examples.en: Advancements in digital technology have completely revolutionized the practice of modern dentistry.
examples.zh: 数字化技术的进步已经彻底改变了现代牙科医学的临床实践。

lemmas.usage_note: 作为医学分支专有名词，不可数，常与 practice、study 或 cosmetic、preventive 等分类形容词搭配使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dentistry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 克里姆林宫
lemmas.def_en: citadel of Moscow, housing the offices of the Russian government

examples.en: The Kremlin announced new diplomatic policies during the international summit yesterday.
examples.zh: 克里姆林宫在昨天的国际峰会上宣布了新的外交政策。

lemmas.usage_note: 常首字母大写特指莫斯科克里姆林宫，政治语境中常借代指代俄罗斯中央政府，多与 the 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kremlin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 忧郁, 悲哀, 愁思
lemmas.def_en: a feeling of thoughtful sadness

examples.en: A profound melancholy seemed to settle over the quiet coastal town as winter approached.
examples.zh: 随着冬日临近，一种深沉的忧郁似乎笼罩了这座宁静的海滨小镇。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面语色彩浓厚，指深沉、持久且常无明确缘由的悲伤；常见搭配 a touch/sense of melancholy。

lemmas.def_zh: 忧郁的, 使人悲伤的, 愁思的
lemmas.def_en: characterized by or causing or expressing sadness

examples.en: The violinist played a melancholy tune that deeply moved everyone in the dimly lit hall.
examples.zh: 小提琴手演奏了一首忧伤的曲调，深深打动了昏暗大厅里的每一个人。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作前置定语或表语，修饰曲调、神情或氛围，表示“令人伤感的”或“神情忧郁的”，具文学色彩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 melancholy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [化] 兰勒(太阳辐射或织物、塑料耐晒牢度试验的能通量单位)
lemmas.def_en: unit of solar radiation

examples.en: The total solar radiation recorded at the station exceeded five hundred langleys per day.
examples.zh: 该站记录到的总太阳辐射量每天超过了五百兰勒。

lemmas.usage_note: 专业物理及气象计量单位，用于表示太阳辐射能通量密度，多见于学术文献与耐晒牢度测试报告。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 langley 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: being four more than fifty

examples.en: The reference to ancient trade routes can be found in chapter LIV of the historical volume.
examples.zh: 关于古代贸易路线的记载可见于该历史典籍的第五十四章。

lemmas.usage_note: 罗马数字写法，表示五十四（54），多用于书序、卷次、正式碑文或典籍章节编号等庄重语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 liv 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 赤脚的
lemmas.def_en: without shoes

examples.en: The barefoot children were happily chasing each other along the sandy beach.
examples.zh: 光着脚的孩子们在沙滩上欢快地互相追逐。

lemmas.usage_note: 作形容词时只用于名词前作前置定语，表示“未穿鞋袜的”；若修饰动作则需用副词词性。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 barefoot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 原汁清汤, 肉汤
lemmas.def_en: liquid in which meat and vegetables are simmered; used as a basis for e.g. soups or sauces

examples.en: She simmered the chicken bones for hours to make a rich, flavorful broth for the soup.
examples.zh: 她将鸡骨文火慢炖了数小时，为做汤熬制了一锅浓郁鲜美的清汤。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，指用肉、鱼或蔬菜慢火熬制的清汤；常与 chicken/beef/vegetable 搭配作烹饪基础。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 broth 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 麻醉, 麻木
lemmas.def_en: loss of bodily sensation with or without loss of consciousness

examples.en: The patient underwent complex abdominal surgery under general anesthesia without feeling any pain.
examples.zh: 该病人在全身麻醉下接受了复杂的腹部手术，全程未感到任何痛苦。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学名词，指通过药物诱导的知觉丧失状态；常见搭配 under anesthesia（在麻醉状态下）。

lemmas.def_zh: 麻醉剂, 麻药
lemmas.def_en: a drug that causes temporary loss of bodily sensations

examples.en: The dentist administered a local anesthetic to numb the area around the decayed tooth.
examples.zh: 牙医注射了局部麻醉剂以麻痹蛀牙周围的区域。

lemmas.usage_note: 指用于引起麻木或知觉丧失的药物制剂；可数名词，常用搭配 administer/give an anesthetic。

lemmas.def_zh: 麻醉剂, 麻药
lemmas.def_en: a drug that causes temporary loss of bodily sensations

lemmas.def_zh: 麻木, 麻醉
lemmas.def_en: loss of bodily sensation with or without loss of consciousness

examples.en: The surgery was performed under general anaesthesia to ensure the patient felt no pain.
examples.zh: 手术是在全身麻醉下进行的，以确保患者不会感到疼痛。

lemmas.def_zh: 麻醉师
lemmas.def_en: a specialist who administers an anesthetic to a patient before he is treated

examples.en: The anaesthetist carefully monitored the patient's vital signs throughout the complex surgery.
examples.zh: 在整个复杂的手术过程中，麻醉师仔细监测着患者的生命体征。

lemmas.def_zh: 麻醉师
lemmas.def_en: a specialist who administers an anesthetic to a patient before he is treated

examples.en: The skilled anesthetist monitored the patient's vital signs carefully throughout the entire surgical procedure.
examples.zh: 熟练的麻醉师在整个手术过程中仔细监测着患者的生命体征。

lemmas.def_zh: 麻醉的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or producing insensibility

examples.en: The herbal balm has a mild anesthetic effect that quickly soothes minor skin burns.
examples.zh: 这种草本软膏具有轻微的麻醉镇痛效果，能快速缓解轻度皮肤烫伤。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于医学专业语境，作定语修饰 effect、agent 或 property，表示“产生麻醉或止痛效果的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 给……施麻醉，使麻醉；使麻木，使失去知觉
lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. to give an anesthetic to a patient so they feel no pain during a medical procedure. 2. to make someone unable to feel normal emotions or sensations.

examples.en: The surgeon waited for the medication to completely anesthetize the patient before the incision.
examples.zh: 外科医生等待药物将病人彻底麻醉后，才开始进行切口。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 anesthesia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 巴特利特梨
lemmas.def_en: United States explorer who accompanied Peary's expedition to the North Pole and who led many other Arctic trips (1875-1946)

examples.en: The orchard is famous for its sweet Bartlett pears that are harvested in late summer.
examples.zh: 该果园以夏末收获的甜脆巴特利特梨而闻名。

lemmas.usage_note: 专指巴特利特梨（洋梨的一个常见品种），果实多汁甜美；通常首字母大写，常与 pear 连用或单独成词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bartlett 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 融合或具有多种文化的；多种文化的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or including several cultures

examples.en: Toronto is widely recognized as one of the most vibrant multicultural cities in the world.
examples.zh: 多伦多被公认为全球最具活力的多元文化城市之一。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词作定语或表语，修饰 society、education 或 community，描述多元族群与文化融合的包容性环境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 multicultural 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 马背
lemmas.def_en: the back of a horse

examples.en: The guards patrolled the vast boundaries of the private estate on horseback every morning.
examples.zh: 警卫每天清晨骑着马巡逻这座私人庄园的广阔边界。

lemmas.usage_note: 极高频固定用于介词短语 on horseback（骑着马），在现代英语中罕作独立主语或宾语使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 horseback 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （用汽加压煮出的）浓咖啡
lemmas.def_en: strong black coffee brewed by forcing hot water under pressure through finely ground coffee beans

examples.en: He ordered a double espresso to keep himself awake during the late-night meeting.
examples.zh: 他点了一杯双份浓缩咖啡，好让自己在深夜会议中保持清醒。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作不可数名词指意式浓缩咖啡，亦可用作可数名词表示“一杯浓缩”，常见搭配如 double espresso。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 espresso 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 学科间的
lemmas.def_en: drawing from or characterized by participation of two or more fields of study

examples.en: The university launched an interdisciplinary project combining computer science and linguistics.
examples.zh: 该大学启动了一个结合计算机科学与语言学的跨学科项目。

lemmas.usage_note: 学术与职场语境高频词，修饰 research、team 或 approach，强调跨越多个学科的协作与整合。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 interdisciplinary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可以忽略的, 不足取的, 无用的
lemmas.def_en: so small as to be meaningless; insignificant

examples.en: The cost difference between the two shipping methods was negligible.
examples.zh: 这两种运输方式之间的费用差异微乎其微。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面语，常与 impact、difference、amount 等搭配，表示数量或程度极小、微不足道。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 negligible 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 一百年的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or completing a period of 100 years

examples.en: The museum organized a centenary exhibition to honor the great artist's birth.
examples.zh: 博物馆举办了一场百年纪念展，以纪念这位伟大艺术家的诞辰。

lemmas.usage_note: 作形容词时多置于名词前作定语，主要在英式英语中修饰 celebrations、exhibition 等百年纪念活动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 centenary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 闪烁，微光闪现；（眼睛等因情绪而）发亮
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To shine with a soft or gentle light. 2. [I] (of eyes) To show a particular feeling or emotion brightly.

examples.en: His dark eyes gleamed with excitement as he unwrapped the mysterious gift.
examples.zh: 当他拆开那份神秘礼物时，深邃的双眼闪烁着兴奋的光芒。

lemmas.usage_note: 作动词常作不及物用，指物体在暗处发微光，亦可生动形容眼神闪烁着某种特定情绪。

lemmas.def_zh: 光束, 微光, 反光
lemmas.def_en: an appearance of reflected light

examples.en: A sudden gleam of hope appeared when the rescuers heard a faint tapping sound.
examples.zh: 当搜救人员听到微弱的敲击声时，心中升起了一线希望。

lemmas.usage_note: 作名词常与 of 搭配，既指短暂微弱的光束，也常喻指转瞬即逝的希望、灵感或幽默。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 闪闪发光的；洁净发亮的
lemmas.def_en: shining brightly with a smooth or soft reflected light; clean and polished
lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰金属表面、牙齿、眼睛或新车等，如 gleaming teeth / floors / eyes。

examples.en: The showroom displayed rows of gleaming new sports cars.
examples.zh: 陈列室里展示着一排排崭新发亮的跑车。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gleam 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 冲动的, 受感情驱使的, 任性的
lemmas.def_en: proceeding from natural feeling or impulse without external stimulus

examples.en: She later regretted making such an impulsive decision without consulting her team.
examples.zh: 她后来后悔自己在没有咨询团队的情况下做出了如此冲动的决定。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰人或 behavior、decision、buying，指未经深思熟虑、全凭一时冲动行事的特征。

lemmas.def_zh: 有推动力地
lemmas.def_en: in an impulsive or impetuous way; without taking cautions

examples.en: he often acts impulsively and later regrets it

lemmas.def_zh: 推进者, 叶轮
lemmas.def_en: the blade of a rotor (as in the compressor of a jet engine)

lemmas.def_zh: 易冲动
lemmas.def_en: the trait of acting suddenly on impulse without reflection

lemmas.def_zh: 冲动, 冲击, 原动力, 推动
lemmas.def_en: a force that moves something along

examples.en: He felt an irresistible impulsion to speak out against the unfair decision.
examples.zh: 他感到一种不可抗拒的冲动，想要抗议这一不公的决定。

lemmas.def_zh: 驱使，迫使；推动，推进
lemmas.def_en: [T] to force, urge, or drive someone to do something; to push or drive an object forward

examples.en: A strong sense of duty impelled him to speak out against the injustice.
examples.zh: 强烈的责任感驱使他挺身而出反对这种不公。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 impulsive 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 发出嘘声喝倒彩；发出嘶嘶声；低声斥责
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To make a sharp sound of disapproval or boo at someone. 2. [I] To make a long sharp sound like steam escaping or a snake. 3. [T] To say something in a fierce, angry whisper.

examples.en: The radiator began to hiss loudly as the hot steam rushed through the pipes.
examples.zh: 当热蒸汽涌入管道时，暖气片开始发出响亮的嘶嘶声。

lemmas.usage_note: 可作不及物或及物动词，指发出嘶嘶声（如蒸汽、蛇），或在剧场、赛场中表示倒彩、喝倒彩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hiss 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 导管, 水管, 沟渠
lemmas.def_en: a passage (a pipe or tunnel) through which water or electric wires can pass

examples.en: The small trading post served as an important conduit for illicit funds.
examples.zh: 这个小贸易站曾是非法资金流动的重要渠道。

lemmas.usage_note: 可指实际的输水管道或电线导管，也常引申为传递资金、信息或货物的渠道与中介。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 conduit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使迷惑，使不知所措，使昏头转向
lemmas.def_en: [T] (often passive) To confuse someone completely, especially by being complicated, unexpected, or chaotic.

examples.en: The rapid changes in modern tax regulations completely bewildered the small business owners.
examples.zh: 现代税收法规的快速变动让这些小企业主彻底手足无措。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，表示复杂的局势或信息使人彻底困惑、不知所措；极常用于被动语态 be bewildered。

lemmas.def_zh: 困惑, 昏乱
lemmas.def_en: confusion resulting from failure to understand

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 困惑的；不知所措的
lemmas.def_en: perplexed and confused; very puzzled by contradictory or complex circumstances
lemmas.usage_note: 形容被复杂或意料之外的情况搞糊涂的状态，如 a bewildered look / expression。

examples.en: He stood there with a bewildered expression, not knowing what had just happened.
examples.zh: 他神情困惑地站在那里，不知道刚刚发生了什么。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bewilder 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 干燥的, 不毛的
lemmas.def_en: lacking sufficient water or rainfall

examples.en: Cacti are uniquely adapted to survive in the arid environment of the desert.
examples.zh: 仙人掌具有独特的适应能力，能够在沙漠的干旱环境中生存。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰 climate、zone 或 landscape 表示干旱不毛；亦可引申指讨论或生活枯燥无味。

lemmas.def_zh: 干旱, 不毛, 乏味
lemmas.def_en: the quality of yielding nothing of value

family_guide.root_logic: 以 arid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 还押，还押候审
lemmas.def_en: [T] (law) To send an accused person back into custody or release them on bail while awaiting trial or further court proceedings.

examples.en: The magistrate decided to remand the suspect in custody until the trial begins next month.
examples.zh: 地方法官决定将嫌疑人还押候审，直至下个月案件开庭。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于司法语境，多以被动语态出现，常见搭配为 remand sb in custody（将某人还押候审）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 remand 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 彻底消灭，毁灭；抹去，擦去（痕迹、记忆等）
lemmas.def_en: [T] To destroy something completely so that nothing remains; wipe out or erase.

examples.en: The massive snowstorm threatened to obliterate all traces of the hikers' footprints.
examples.zh: 这场大暴雪可能会彻底抹去登山者留下的所有足迹。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面用语，表示彻底摧毁或抹除痕迹、记忆，常用搭配为 obliterate memories 或 be obliterated by。

lemmas.def_zh: 抹消, 灭迹, 忘却
lemmas.def_en: destruction by annihilating something

lemmas.def_zh: 删除因子；混沌毁灭者
lemmas.def_en: an eliminator that does away with all traces

family_guide.root_logic: 以 obliterate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 重新安排（日程、时间）；重新调整（还债计划等）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To change the date, time, or schedule of an event or appointment. 2. [T] To agree on a new plan for repaying a debt.

examples.en: Due to an unexpected conflict, we had to reschedule the board meeting for next Tuesday.
examples.zh: 由于突发日程冲突，我们不得不把董事会会议改期到下周二。

lemmas.usage_note: 商务与日常高频词，表示重新安排时间，常见结构为 reschedule sth for/to another date。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reschedule 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 陷阱, 诱惑, 圈套
lemmas.def_en: something (often something deceptively attractive) that catches you unawares

examples.en: The young fox managed to escape, but its hind leg was injured by the hidden snare.
examples.zh: 那只小狐狸成功逃脱了，但它的后腿被隐蔽的陷阱夹伤了。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指捕猎用的实物罗网，也常引申为抽象的圈套与诱惑，常见搭配为 set a snare 或 fall into a snare。

lemmas.def_zh: 用罗网（或陷阱）捕捉；诱捕，使落入圈套
lemmas.def_en: [T] to catch an animal in a snare or trap; to trick or trap someone into a difficult situation.

examples.en: The deceptive online scheme managed to snare dozens of unsuspecting investors.
examples.zh: 这个具有欺骗性的网络骗局诱骗了数十名毫无戒备的投资者。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指设圈套诱捕动物或用手段诱骗某人，常见搭配为 snare prey 或 snare customers。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 snare 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 邮筒, 邮箱
lemmas.def_en: a private box for delivery of mail

examples.en: Don't forget to check the mailbox outside for the parcel delivery slip.
examples.zh: 别忘了查看门外的信箱，看看有没有包裹投递单。

lemmas.usage_note: 指路边或门前的实体信箱，也广泛用于数字化语境指电子邮箱收件箱，为常见可数名词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mailbox 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 结交，待人如友；扶助
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To become friendly with someone and help or support them, especially when they are lonely or new.

examples.en: She went out of her way to befriend the new exchange student who felt lonely.
examples.zh: 她特意主动向那位感到孤单的新交换生示好并提供帮助。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指主动对人展现友好、提供关照或与人结交，后直接接宾语，不可加介词 with。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 befriend 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 光滑的, 油嘴滑舌的, 线条明快的, 圆滑的, 时髦的
lemmas.def_en: well-groomed and neatly tailored; especially too well-groomed

examples.en: The sports car features a sleek design that minimizes wind resistance at high speeds.
examples.zh: 这款跑车采用了线条明快流畅的设计，能够最大程度降低高速行驶时的风阻。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容毛发光滑发亮，或物体具有线条流畅优美、外形时髦的特质，常修饰 car、hair、design。

lemmas.def_zh: 光滑地, 光泽地
lemmas.def_en: in a sleek glossy manner

examples.en: the wet road was shining sleekly

lemmas.def_zh: 油滑; 油光发亮; 时髦阔气; 线条明快
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being well-groomed and neatly tailored

examples.en: the sleekness of his appearance reminded me of his financial successes

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sleek 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [俚]饭桶
lemmas.def_en: a person who is deemed to be despicable or contemptible

examples.en: Stop being such a miserable git and come enjoy the party with the rest of us.
examples.zh: 别再当这么讨人嫌的丧气鬼了，快来和大家一起享受派对吧。

lemmas.usage_note: 英式英语非正式侮辱性俚语，多用于贬称愚蠢、令人厌恶或惹人讨厌的人，语体极为口语化。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 git 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 原型
lemmas.def_en: something that serves as a model or a basis for making copies

examples.en: In literature, the tragic hero often serves as the archetype of human struggle against fate.
examples.zh: 在文学中，悲剧英雄往往被视为人类与命运抗争的原型代表。

lemmas.usage_note: 学术与文艺批评高频词，指具有代表性的典型原型，常用于 the archetype of 或 cultural archetype。

lemmas.def_zh: 原型的
lemmas.def_en: representing or constituting an original type after which other similar things are patterned

examples.en: archetypal patterns
she was the prototypal student activist

lemmas.def_zh: 典型的
lemmas.def_en: representing or constituting an original type after which other similar things are patterned

examples.en: archetypal patterns
she was the prototypal student activist

family_guide.root_logic: 以 archetype 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 电解物, 电解质, 电解液
lemmas.def_en: a solution that conducts electricity

examples.en: Marathon runners often drink specialized sports beverages to replenish lost electrolytes quickly.
examples.zh: 马拉松跑者通常会饮用专门的运动饮料，以快速补充流失的电解质。

lemmas.usage_note: 科学与健康领域词汇，既指化学电解质，也指运动补剂中的矿物质成分，常用搭配为 replenish electrolytes。

lemmas.def_zh: 电分解, 电解, 以电针除痣
lemmas.def_en: (chemistry) a chemical decomposition reaction produced by passing an electric current through a solution containing ions

examples.en: During high school chemistry class, we used electrolysis to separate water into hydrogen and oxygen.
examples.zh: 在高中化学课上，我们利用电解法将水分解为氢气和氧气。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 电解的
lemmas.def_en: a fixed capacitor consisting of two electrodes separated by an electrolyte

family_guide.root_logic: 以 electrolyte 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 龟, 行动迟缓的人
lemmas.def_en: usually herbivorous land turtles having clawed elephant-like limbs; worldwide in arid area except Australia and Antarctica

examples.en: Traffic crawled along the highway at a tortoise pace during the morning rush hour.
examples.zh: 早高峰期间，公路上的车辆像乌龟爬行一样缓慢移动。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指陆生龟类，常用于喻指行动极其缓慢的人或车辆，常见短语有 at a tortoise pace。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tortoise 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 虔诚的, 虔敬的, 诚恳的
lemmas.def_en: deeply religious;  H.L.Mencken

examples.en: It is our devout hope that the peace talks will bring an end to the conflict.
examples.zh: 我们由衷期盼和平谈判能够终结这场冲突。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可修饰宗教信仰的虔诚，也可表示非宗教性的真诚期盼，常搭配 Christian、hope 等词。

lemmas.def_zh: 虔诚地, 虔敬地, 衷心地
lemmas.def_en: in a devout and pious manner

examples.en: she was devoutly Catholic

lemmas.def_zh: 朝拜
lemmas.def_en: piety by virtue of being devout

family_guide.root_logic: 以 devout 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 制裁, 镇压, 痛击
lemmas.def_en: severely repressive actions

examples.en: The government launched a severe crackdown on financial fraud across the country.
examples.zh: 政府在全国范围内展开了严厉打击金融诈骗的专项行动。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指政府或官方机构实施的严厉打击与取缔，固定搭配为 crackdown on sth。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crackdown 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 踌躇, 犹豫, 微量
lemmas.def_en: a unit of apothecary weight equal to 20 grains

examples.en: The ruthless merchant had no scruples about selling counterfeit medicine to the poor.
examples.zh: 这个狠心的商人毫无顾忌地向穷人兜售假药。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用复数形式 scruples，指良心不安或道德顾忌，常搭配 have no scruples about doing。

lemmas.def_zh: 小心谨慎
lemmas.def_en: conformity to high standards of ethics or excellence

lemmas.def_zh: 狂妄；不择手段
lemmas.def_en: the quality of unscrupulous dishonesty

lemmas.def_zh: 无道德原则的, 不审慎的, 肆无忌惮的
lemmas.def_en: without scruples or principles

examples.en: unscrupulous politicos who would be happy to sell...their country in order to gain power

lemmas.def_zh: 小心谨慎的, 细心的
lemmas.def_en: having scruples; arising from a sense of right and wrong; principled

examples.en: less scrupulous producers sent bundles that were deceptive in appearance

lemmas.def_zh: 对…心存顾虑，顾忌，迟疑
lemmas.def_en: [I] (formal, chiefly negative) To hesitate or feel reluctant to do something because of moral doubts.

examples.en: He did not scruple to betray his closest friends to secure the promotion.
examples.zh: 他为了获得晋升，毫不犹豫地出卖了自己最要好的朋友。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于否定句或疑问句，后接不定式 not scruple to do，意为对做坏事毫无顾虑。

lemmas.def_zh: 严谨, 一丝不苟, 用心, 准确, 多顾虑, 小心翼翼, 审慎, 诚实, 真心实意
lemmas.def_en: with extreme conscientiousness

examples.en: he came religiously every morning at 8 o'clock

lemmas.def_zh: 不客气地, 无道德原则地
lemmas.def_en: without scruples

examples.en: she unscrupulously uses her charm to make men do what she wants

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scruple 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 仲裁者, 调解者, 媒介物, 中间人
lemmas.def_en: a negotiator who acts as a link between parties

examples.en: A seasoned diplomat acted as an intermediary between the two warring nations.
examples.zh: 一位经验丰富的外交官在交战两国之间充当了调解人。

lemmas.usage_note: 指在双方争端或交易中穿梭撮合的中间人，常与 act as an intermediary 搭配使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 intermediary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 呼出（气体），吐出；呼气
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] to breathe out air, smoke, or vapor from the lungs

examples.en: Close your eyes, breathe in deeply through your nose, and slowly exhale.
examples.zh: 闭上眼睛，用鼻子深吸一口气，然后慢慢呼出。

lemmas.usage_note: 可作及物或不及物动词，既指生理上的呼出气体，也可指容器或火山口散发烟气。

lemmas.def_zh: 呼气, 蒸发, 散发物
lemmas.def_en: exhaled breath

family_guide.root_logic: 以 exhale 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 前哨战, 小争论, 小冲突
lemmas.def_en: a minor short-term fight

examples.en: Several soldiers were wounded during a brief border skirmish last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚在一场短暂的边境冲突中，数名士兵受伤。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可指军队间的小规模交火，也可引申为政见不合的轻微争吵，常与 border、political 连用。

lemmas.def_zh: 进行小争斗者, 散兵
lemmas.def_en: someone who skirmishes (e.g., as a member of a scouting party)

lemmas.def_zh: 发生小冲突，进行小规模交火；发生小争吵
lemmas.def_en: [I] To engage in a minor, brief fight or dispute, especially between small military groups.

examples.en: Rebel forces skirmished with government troops near the outskirts of the capital.
examples.zh: 叛乱武装在首都郊区附近与政府军发生了小规模冲突。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示双方发生短兵相接的交火或进行小规模言语冲突，常搭配 skirmish with sb。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 skirmish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 柠檬
lemmas.def_en: large luxurious car; usually driven by a chauffeur

examples.en: The pharmaceutical formula contains tinctura limo as a natural flavoring agent.
examples.zh: 该药物配方中含有柠檬酊剂作为天然矫味剂。

lemmas.usage_note: 该词通常为 limousine 的口语简称，但在医学药典中可用作“柠檬”拉丁语变体缩写（如芳香剂成分）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 limo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可预知的, 能预测的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being anticipated

examples.en: Oil prices are expected to remain volatile for the foreseeable future.
examples.zh: 预计在可预见的未来，石油价格仍将保持波动。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示基于当前事实可推测的，高频固定搭配为 in the foreseeable future（在可预见的未来）。

lemmas.def_zh: [法] 不能预见的, 预料不到的
lemmas.def_en: incapable of being anticipated

examples.en: unforeseeable consequences

family_guide.root_logic: 以 foreseeable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 金黄鹂
lemmas.def_en: mostly tropical songbird; the male is usually bright orange and black

examples.en: The sweet song of the golden oriole echoed through the dense summer canopy.
examples.zh: 金黄鹂悦耳的鸣叫声在夏日茂密的树冠间回荡。

lemmas.usage_note: 生物学名词，指羽毛艳丽的黄鹂科鸟类，常见搭配包括 golden oriole（金黄鹂）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 oriole 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 重罪犯, 恶棍, 瘭疽
lemmas.def_en: someone who has committed a crime or has been legally convicted of a crime

examples.en: As a convicted felon, he was stripped of his right to vote in federal elections.
examples.zh: 作为一名被定罪的重罪犯，他被剥夺了在联邦选举中的投票权。

lemmas.usage_note: 法律与司法语体中的正式用词，指触犯重罪的犯人，常与 convicted、alleged 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 felon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 专题论文, 专著, 专刊
lemmas.def_en: a detailed and documented treatise on a particular subject

examples.en: The professor published a comprehensive monograph on 18th-century European trade routes.
examples.zh: 那位教授出版了一部关于18世纪欧洲贸易路线的详尽学术专著。

lemmas.usage_note: 学术语体专用词，指就某一特定学术课题深入探讨的学术专著，常与 publish、author 搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 monograph 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 爆发, 突发, 破裂, 暴乱
lemmas.def_en: an unrestrained expression of emotion

examples.en: She later apologized for her sudden emotional outburst during the tense meeting.
examples.zh: 她后来为自己在紧张的会议中突然的情绪失控道了歉。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指情绪或暴力的突然爆发，尤指愤怒或哭泣，常见搭配为 an outburst of anger/applause。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 outburst 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 鬃毛
lemmas.def_en: long coarse hair growing from the crest of the animal's neck

examples.en: The male lion shook its thick, dark mane as it surveyed the open savanna.
examples.zh: 那头雄狮审视着开阔的稀树草原，抖动着浓密深沉的鬃毛。

lemmas.usage_note: 指马或狮子的颈鬃，也可幽默、形象地借指人浓密蓬乱的长发，多用单数形式。

lemmas.def_zh: 配备人员，操纵，守卫
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To provide a place, machine, or vehicle with the people needed to operate or defend it.

examples.en: Volunteers were called in to man the emergency hotlines throughout the crisis.
examples.zh: 整个危机期间，志愿者们被召集前来接听并值守紧急求助热线。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指在岗位、船只或设备上派人驻守或操作，常用于 man the phones/desks/posts。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mane 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 灾难, 不幸事件
lemmas.def_en: an event resulting in great loss and misfortune

examples.en: The prolonged drought brought economic calamity to farming communities across the region.
examples.zh: 长期的干旱给该地区的所有农业社区带来了经济灾难。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面语，指造成巨大痛苦或损失的严重灾难，常与 national、economic 等形容词搭配。

lemmas.def_zh: 灾难性的, 不幸的
lemmas.def_en: (of events) having extremely unfortunate or dire consequences; bringing ruin; ; ; ; - Charles Darwin; - Douglas MacArthur

examples.en: the stock market crashed on Black Friday
a calamitous defeat

family_guide.root_logic: 以 calamity 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 乡村的, 纯朴的, 手工粗糙的
lemmas.def_en: characteristic of rural life

examples.en: The mountain cabin was furnished with rustic wooden tables and handcrafted chairs.
examples.zh: 那座山间木屋里陈设着质朴粗犷的原木桌子和纯手工打造的椅子。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容带有乡村质朴、粗犷风格的家具、建筑或生活方式，常与 charm、furniture 搭配。

lemmas.def_zh: 乡村式, 田园生活, 质朴
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being rustic or gauche

lemmas.def_zh: 乡村生活, 驱逐到乡下, 暂时停学
lemmas.def_en: the condition naturally attaching to life in the country

lemmas.def_zh: vt. 到农村去, 过乡村生活, 住在农村, 下乡
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (dated / British) To go to the countryside to live a simple life, or suspend a university student temporarily.

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rustic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 起飞
lemmas.def_en: a departure; especially of airplanes

examples.en: Passengers were requested to fasten their seatbelts in preparation for takeoff.
examples.zh: 乘客被要求系好安全带，为起飞做好准备。

lemmas.usage_note: 主要指飞行器起飞的动作或阶段，也可比喻经济等的腾飞，常与 smooth、delay 搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 takeoff 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 赞扬，高度赞美；提拔，提升（地位等）；使兴高采烈
lemmas.def_en: [T] (formal) 1. To praise someone or something highly. 2. To raise someone to a higher rank, position, or status.

examples.en: The poet wrote verses to exalt the virtues of courage and loyalty in times of war.
examples.zh: 诗人作诗赞颂战乱年代中展现的勇气与忠诚之美德。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面语，指极力赞美、颂扬某人某事，或提升地位和权力，常接抽象概念或人物作宾语。

lemmas.def_zh: 提升, 提高, 得意洋洋
lemmas.def_en: a state of being carried away by overwhelming emotion; - Charles Dickens

examples.en: listening to sweet music in a perfect rapture

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 崇高的；显赫的；狂喜的
lemmas.def_en: of high moral, intellectual, or social standing; noble; in a state of extreme happiness
lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰地位、理想、言辞或心境，如 an exalted position / status / state of mind。

examples.en: Despite his exalted position in the government, he remained humble.
examples.zh: 尽管在政府中身居显赫地位，他依然保持谦逊。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 exalt 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 协同作用
lemmas.def_en: the working together of two things (muscles or drugs for example) to produce an effect greater than the sum of their individual effects

examples.en: The merger was designed to create synergy between the two technology companies.
examples.zh: 这次合并旨在两家科技公司之间产生协同效应。

lemmas.usage_note: 商业与管理高频词，指多方协同合作产生的“1+1>2”增效作用，常用搭配 create/achieve synergy。

lemmas.def_zh: 协同的,协作的, 协同作用的
lemmas.def_en: working together; used especially of groups, as subsidiaries of a corporation, cooperating for an enhanced effect

examples.en: The two departments achieved a synergetic effect that greatly boosted overall productivity.
examples.zh: 两个部门产生了协同效应，大大提高了整体生产力。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 synergy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 郁金香
lemmas.def_en: any of numerous perennial bulbous herbs having linear or broadly lanceolate leaves and usually a single showy flower

examples.en: The spring festival attracts thousands of visitors eager to see the vibrant tulips in bloom.
examples.zh: 春季花节吸引了成千上万渴望观赏郁金香盛开美景的游客。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指百合科郁金香花或其植株，常搭配 tulip bulbs（鳞茎）或 tulip fields。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tulip 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 非常坚硬的, 坚强的, 固执的
lemmas.def_en: impervious to pleas, persuasion, requests, reason; ; - W.Churchill

examples.en: Despite facing intense public pressure, the mayor remained adamant that the policy would not change.
examples.zh: 尽管面临巨大的公众压力，市长依然坚决表示该政策不会改变。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作表语，多与介词 about 或 that 从句连用，强调态度坚定不移、绝不让步。

lemmas.def_zh: 坚硬无比地；坚强地；固执地；不动摇地
lemmas.def_en: inflexibly; unshakably

examples.en: adamantly opposed to the marriage

family_guide.root_logic: 以 adamant 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 全然, 彻底, 完全
lemmas.def_en: thoroughgoing

examples.en: His dismissive response to their genuine concerns was downright rude.
examples.zh: 他对大家切身关切的敷衍态度简直无礼透顶。

lemmas.usage_note: 用于修饰带有负面或极端含义的形容词，起强化语气的副词作用，意为“彻底地、简直”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 downright 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 杀人, 过失杀人罪
lemmas.def_en: homicide without malice aforethought

examples.en: The driver was convicted of manslaughter after the fatal crash caused by reckless speeding.
examples.zh: 该司机因超速鲁莽驾驶导致致命车祸，最终被判犯有过失杀人罪。

lemmas.usage_note: 法律专业术语，通常作为不可数名词使用，特指无预谋或过失造成的非法致人死亡罪。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 manslaughter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 乐器数字化接口
lemmas.def_en: used of women's clothing having a hemline at mid-calf

examples.en: He connected the synthesizer to his computer using a standard MIDI cable.
examples.zh: 他用一条标准 MIDI 线将合成器连接到了电脑上。

lemmas.usage_note: 在计算机与音乐领域作为定语形容词，修饰 cable、file 或 keyboard 等设备及文件。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 midi 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 高中；就读高中；特典
lemmas.def_en: a public secondary school usually including grades 9 through 12

examples.en: She decided to attend the local public highschool to be closer to her childhood friends.
examples.zh: 她决定就读当地的公立高中，以便离儿时的伙伴们更近一些。

lemmas.usage_note: 可作可数名词或复合名词前置定语，多用于日常交流中指代提供中等教育的高级中学。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 highschool 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 巨大的
lemmas.def_en: of great mass; huge and bulky

examples.en: The airline recently added another jumbo jet to its international long-haul fleet.
examples.zh: 该航空公司最近为其国际长途机队增添了一架巨型客机。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常作前置定语，口语及商业宣传中极常见，用来修饰体型、容量或规模超大的物品。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jumbo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 同上, 同上符号, 很相似的人(或物)
lemmas.def_en: a mark used to indicate the word above it should be repeated

examples.en: Use a ditto in the column below to indicate that the shipping address is unchanged.
examples.zh: 在下方一栏使用同上符号，以表明收货地址未发生改变。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指书写时表示“同上”的符号（"），也可引申指完全相同的人、物或言论。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ditto 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无头甘蓝类, 甘蓝菜, 蔬菜
lemmas.def_en: informal terms for money

examples.en: She added a handful of fresh kale to the blender to make a healthy green smoothie.
examples.zh: 她在搅拌机里加入了一把新鲜的羽衣甘蓝，制作健康的绿色果蔬汁。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用作不可数名词，常见于日常饮食、烹饪及健康营养语境，指羽衣甘蓝这种绿叶蔬菜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kale 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 刀匠, 刀剪商
lemmas.def_en: a dealer in cutlery

examples.en: The local cutler carefully sharpened the chef's knives on a specialized whetstone.
examples.zh: 当地的刀匠在特制的磨刀石上仔细打磨着主厨的刀具。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指制造、销售或修理刀具、餐具的工匠或商贩，属于传统手工业称谓。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cutler 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 牛皮纸
lemmas.def_en: strong wrapping paper made from pulp processed with a sulfur solution

examples.en: All the handmade soaps were wrapped in eco-friendly brown kraft for a rustic look.
examples.zh: 所有的手工皂都用环保的原色牛皮纸包裹，显得古朴自然。

lemmas.usage_note: 多作不可数名词，亦常以名词作定语修饰 paper、bag 或 box，指高强度的牛皮纸材料。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kraft 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 指挥操舵，掌舵（操纵船只或潜水艇的航向）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (nautical) To direct the steering and navigation of a ship or submarine.

examples.en: The captain allowed the junior officer to conn the ship through the narrow channel.
examples.zh: 船长允许初级军官指挥操舵，引导船只穿过狭窄的水道。

lemmas.usage_note: 航海专业及军事用语，指掌控舵轮或指挥船舶航向，常与 ship、vessel 等词搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 conn 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 生物量
lemmas.def_en: plant materials and animal waste used as fuel

examples.en: The power plant burns forest biomass to generate renewable electricity.
examples.zh: 该发电厂通过燃烧林业生物质来生产可再生电力。

lemmas.usage_note: 生态学与能源领域核心词，多用作不可数名词，常见搭配包括 biomass energy、total biomass。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 biomass 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 男爵夫人, 女性男爵
lemmas.def_en: a noblewoman who holds the rank of baron or who is the wife or widow of a baron

examples.en: The Baroness attended the royal banquet alongside other distinguished nobles.
examples.zh: 这位女男爵与其他尊贵的贵族一同出席了皇家宴会。

lemmas.usage_note: 贵族爵位名词，指男爵夫人或女男爵，首字母常大写与姓氏连用，用于正式或历史语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 baroness 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 马德拉斯薄棉布
lemmas.def_en: a state in southeastern India on the Bay of Bengal (south of Andhra Pradesh); formerly Madras

examples.en: He wore a light madras shirt that kept him cool during the humid summer afternoon.
examples.zh: 他穿着一件轻薄的马德拉斯薄棉布衬衫，在潮湿的夏日下午保持凉爽。

lemmas.usage_note: 纺织与服饰用语，指一种轻质格子棉布，常作为不可数名词或用作定语修饰 shirt、jacket 等。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 madras 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 元素的, 基本的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or being an element

examples.en: The storm unleashed an elemental fury that battered the coastal village.
examples.zh: 暴风雨释放出强大的自然狂暴之力，重创了沿海村庄。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面语形容词，常修饰 power、truth、forces 等抽象或自然事物，表示原始的、本质的或大自然的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 elemental 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 麦加
lemmas.def_en: joint capital (with Riyadh) of Saudi Arabia; located in western Saudi Arabia; as the birthplace of Muhammad it is the holiest city of Islam

examples.en: The coastal town has become a mecca for surfers from all over the world.
examples.zh: 这座沿海小镇已经成为全世界冲浪者心驰神往的胜地。

lemmas.usage_note: 小写时作比喻义，指众人向往的胜地或活动中心，常构成 a mecca for 结构，多见于文化与旅游语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mecca 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 福柏(月神), 月亮
lemmas.def_en: the cardinal number that is the sum of four and one

examples.en: A small phoebe was perched on the fence, occasionally darting into the air to catch insects.
examples.zh: 一只小霸鹟停在篱笆上，不时冲向空中捕食昆虫。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，专指北美产的一种灰褐色吃虫的小霸鹟；大写时亦可用作希腊神话中的月神或人名。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 phoebe 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 报应, 惩罚, 报酬
lemmas.def_en: a justly deserved penalty

examples.en: The tyrant lived in constant fear of retribution from the oppressed citizens.
examples.zh: 暴君终日生活在对受压迫民众进行报复惩罚的恐惧之中。

lemmas.usage_note: 庄重正式词汇，指因恶行招致的严厉惩罚或报应，常与 fear、divine、exact 搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 retribution 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 精液, 精子
lemmas.def_en: the thick white fluid containing spermatozoa that is ejaculated by the male genital tract

examples.en: The fertility clinic required a sample of semen for comprehensive laboratory analysis.
examples.zh: 生育诊所需要一份精液样本来进行全面的实验室分析。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学与生物学专业名词，不可数，用于描述雄性生殖液，常见搭配包括 semen analysis、sample。

lemmas.def_zh: 播种, 受胎, 授精
lemmas.def_en: the act of sowing (of seeds in the ground or, figuratively, of germs in the body or ideas in the mind, etc.)

lemmas.def_zh: 给……授精，使受胎；播种
lemmas.def_en: [T] (biology / medicine) To introduce semen into a female human or animal to cause pregnancy.

examples.en: The veterinarian arrived early in the morning to artificially inseminate the prize-winning dairy cow.
examples.zh: 兽医清晨赶来，为那头获奖的奶牛进行人工授精。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 semen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: coming next after the fifteenth in position

examples.en: The historic church was originally built in the sixteenth century.
examples.zh: 这座历史悠久的教堂最初建于十六世纪。

lemmas.usage_note: 序数词充当形容词，置于名词前作定语，表示“第十六个的”，常与 century、birthday 等搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sixteenth 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 往上坡, 向上地
lemmas.def_en: against difficulties

examples.en: We had to push our heavy bicycles uphill for nearly two miles.
examples.zh: 我们不得不吃力地推着沉重的自行车上了将近两英里的坡。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作状语修饰 walk, climb, run 等运动动词，表示向坡上移动，亦可引申指逆境奋斗。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 uphill 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 树木繁茂的
lemmas.def_en: covered with growing trees and bushes etc

examples.en: A narrow path wound gently through the densely wooded hills.
examples.zh: 一条狭窄的小径在树木葱茏的群山间缓缓蜿蜒。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰 slopes, hills, area 等地理名词，用于自然风光或地理描述，表被树木覆盖的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wooded 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 葡萄干
lemmas.def_en: dried grape

examples.en: She added a generous handful of raisins to the oatmeal cookies.
examples.zh: 她在燕麦饼干糊里加入了一大把葡萄干。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，常以复数形式出现，多用于烘焙、烹饪及麦片干果搭配语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 raisin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 横笛, 吹横笛
lemmas.def_en: a small high-pitched flute similar to a piccolo; has a shrill tone and is used chiefly to accompany drums in a marching band

examples.en: The piercing sound of the fife led the marching regiment into battle.
examples.zh: 军用横笛刺耳的乐声引领着行进的军团奔赴战场。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于历史、军事乐队语境，常与 drum 构成固定搭配 fife and drum。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fife 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 涌出，迸出；滔滔不绝地说，过分热情地赞扬
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To flow out suddenly and in large amounts in a rapid stream. 2. [I] To express great enthusiasm or praise in an exaggerated way.

examples.en: The critics couldn't stop gushing about the young actress's stunning debut.
examples.zh: 评论家们对这位年轻女演员惊艳的首秀赞不绝口。

lemmas.usage_note: 可用作及物或不及物动词，描述液体喷涌；引申为说话滔滔不绝、夸张赞叹（常接 about/over）。

lemmas.def_zh: [经] 喷油井, 自喷井
lemmas.def_en: an oil well with a strong natural flow so that pumping is not necessary

lemmas.def_zh: 过分多情的
lemmas.def_en: extravagantly demonstrative

examples.en: insincere and effusive demonstrations of sentimental friendship
a large gushing female

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gush 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 铸造, 铸造厂, 铸造类
lemmas.def_en: factory where metal castings are produced

examples.en: His grandfather spent forty years working as a mold maker in the iron foundry.
examples.zh: 他的祖父在铁铸造厂当了四十年的翻砂工。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，常与 iron, steel, brass 等金属名词复合，指熔铸金属的工场或车间。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 foundry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 在时间上早于，先于；倒填……的日期
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To exist or happen at an earlier time than something else. 2. [T] To put a date on a document that is earlier than the actual date.

examples.en: Archaeologists confirmed that these stone tools predate the arrival of modern humans.
examples.zh: 考古学家证实，这些石器的出现时间早于现代人类的到来。
