lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，学术语境常表示“早于”，行政或商业语境指“在文件上填写比实际更早的日期”。

lemmas.def_zh: 掠夺行为
lemmas.def_en: an act of plundering and pillaging and marauding

family_guide.root_logic: 以 predate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不透明的, 不传热的, 不传导的, 阴暗的
lemmas.def_en: not transmitting or reflecting light or radiant energy; impenetrable to sight

examples.en: The government's opaque decision-making process drew fierce criticism from the public.
examples.zh: 政府不透明的决策过程遭到了公众的强烈批评。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指物理上的不透光，也常用于正式语体引申指语言、政策、动机的晦涩难懂与不透明。

lemmas.def_zh: 不透明, 电波不透过, 不透明体
lemmas.def_en: the phenomenon of not permitting the passage of electromagnetic radiation

examples.en: Adjusting the layer's opacity can create subtle visual effects in digital painting.
examples.zh: 调整图层的不透明度可以在数码绘画中创造出微妙的视觉效果。

lemmas.def_zh: [化] 不透明性; 不透明度
lemmas.def_en: incomprehensibility resulting from obscurity of meaning

lemmas.def_zh: 不透明地, 无光泽地
lemmas.def_en: in an opaque manner

examples.en: he referred opaquely to her recent past

family_guide.root_logic: 以 opaque 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （高尔夫球中）以低于标准杆一杆击球入洞，打出小鸟球
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] (golf) to score a birdie on a hole by taking one stroke fewer than par

examples.en: He managed to birdie the final hole to secure a dramatic one-stroke victory.
examples.zh: 他在最后一洞抓下小鸟球，以一杆优势锁定了一场戏剧性的胜利。

lemmas.usage_note: 高尔夫专业术语，作及物动词时接洞数（如 the 18th hole），表示以低于标准杆一杆的成绩击球入洞。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 birdie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 世俗的, 不敬神的, 亵渎的
lemmas.def_en: characterized by profanity or cursing

examples.en: The monk was deeply offended by the profane graffiti scrawled on the temple wall.
examples.zh: 寺庙墙上乱涂乱画的亵渎涂鸦让这位僧侣感到十分气愤。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰 language, behavior，指亵渎神明的或粗俗下流的；亦可作正式学术用语表示“世俗的”（相对神圣而言）。

lemmas.def_zh: 玷污神圣, 不敬, 亵渎, 亵渎语言
lemmas.def_en: vulgar or irreverent speech or action

lemmas.def_zh: 渎神, 玷污, 亵渎
lemmas.def_en: blasphemous behavior; the act of depriving something of its sacred character

examples.en: desecration of the Holy Sabbath

lemmas.def_zh: 亵渎，玷污（神圣事物）
lemmas.def_en: [T] (formal) To treat something sacred, holy, or revered with irreverence or disrespect.

examples.en: The invaders profaned the ancient altar by using it as a butcher's table.
examples.zh: 侵略者竟把古老的祭坛当作屠宰台，玷污了这片圣地。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，书面语，后接 shrine, sanctuary, memory 等，指玷污、亵渎神圣或崇高之物。

lemmas.def_zh: 渎神地, 凡俗地
lemmas.def_en: with curses

examples.en: muttering profanely

family_guide.root_logic: 以 profane 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 背教者, 变节者, 脱党者
lemmas.def_en: someone who rebels and becomes an outlaw

examples.en: He was branded a political renegade after voting against his own party's flagship policy.
examples.zh: 他在投票反对本党的核心政策后，被斥为政治叛徒。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指背叛原有组织、政党或信仰的人，多用于政治或思想语境，含强烈的贬义色彩。

lemmas.def_zh: 背叛，叛变，脱离（信仰或组织）
lemmas.def_en: [I] (formal / dated) To abandon or renounce a religion, cause, or group, especially to become a traitor.

examples.en: Several faction members threatened to renegade from the alliance if their demands were ignored.
examples.zh: 几名派系成员威胁称，如果他们的诉求被忽视，就将脱离该联盟。

lemmas.usage_note: 罕用作不及物动词，指背弃原则或脱离既定组织，现多被 renege 或 defect 取代。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 renegade 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 摇摆，摇动（尾巴或手指等）
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To move rapidly back and forth or up and down, especially of an animal's tail or a finger.

examples.en: Her unexpected resignation set tongues wagging across the entire department.
examples.zh: 她的意外辞职让整个部门的人都开始交头接耳、议论纷纷。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指动物摇尾巴或摆动手指，也指舌头摆动以比喻饶舌、说闲话；常用于 tongues wag 等熟语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wag 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使过度拥挤，容纳过多的人
lemmas.def_en: [T] (often passive) To fill a place or vehicle with too many people or things.

examples.en: Tourists continue to overcrowd the historic district during the peak summer months.
examples.zh: 在夏季旅游高峰期，游客依然让这座历史街区显得过度拥挤。

lemmas.usage_note: 常以被动语态 be overcrowded (with) 出现，表示某一空间容纳了过量的人或物而极度拥挤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 overcrowd 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 双座四轮轿式马车, 小轿车, 双门轿式小汽车, (英)铁路客车尾部的分隔车厢
lemmas.def_en: a car with two doors and front seats and a luggage compartment

examples.en: He prefers driving a compact sports coupe rather than a bulky family SUV.
examples.zh: 相比笨重的家用SUV，他更喜欢开紧凑型的双门运动轿跑车。

lemmas.usage_note: 现代汽车术语中专指双门小轿车，通常具有流线型车顶；也可指历史上的双座封闭马车。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 coupe 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 游泳衣
lemmas.def_en: tight fitting garment worn for swimming

examples.en: Don't forget to pack your swimsuit because the hotel features an indoor heated pool.
examples.zh: 别忘了带上你的泳衣，因为酒店内设有一个室内温水泳池。

lemmas.usage_note: 游泳衣的通用称呼，常指女士连体泳装或统称泳服；日常高频搭配 put on 或 wear a swimsuit。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 swimsuit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使脱臼，使关节移位；使混乱，扰乱
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To force a bone out of its normal position in a joint. 2. [T] To disrupt or throw an established system, schedule, or organization into disorder.

examples.en: The nationwide transport strike threatened to dislocate the entire food supply chain.
examples.zh: 全国范围的交通罢工可能导致整条食品供应链陷入瘫痪。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学上指关节脱臼，引申指打乱交通、经济或日常运作秩序，常接 shoulder 或 system。

lemmas.def_zh: 脱臼, 转位, 混乱
lemmas.def_en: an event that results in a displacement or discontinuity

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dislocate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 颂诗, 赋
lemmas.def_en: a lyric poem with complex stanza forms

examples.en: The poet composed a moving ode to the fallen soldiers of the Great War.
examples.zh: 诗人创作了一首感人至深的颂诗，以缅怀一战中牺牲的士兵。

lemmas.usage_note: 文学文体名，指以庄重或激昂语言表达赞颂的抒情诗；常与介词 to 连用构成诗名或比喻。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ode 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 高的, 傲慢的, 崇高的, 高级的, 玄虚的
lemmas.def_en: of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style; ; - Oliver Franks

examples.en: Despite his lofty ambitions, he lacked the practical skills needed to execute the project.
examples.zh: 尽管他志向高远，却缺乏执行该项目所需的实际技能。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于书面语，可形容山峰建筑巍峨、志向理想崇高，亦可贬义形容人态度傲慢无礼。

lemmas.def_zh: 高尚地, 傲慢地
lemmas.def_en: in a lofty manner

examples.en: she bore herself loftily

lemmas.def_zh: 高尚, 崇高
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being high or lofty

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lofty 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无节制, 狂欢, 纵酒宴乐, 放荡
lemmas.def_en: any act of immoderate indulgence

examples.en: The holiday season triggered an unprecedented orgy of consumer spending across the nation.
examples.zh: 假日季引发了全国范围内史无前例的狂热消费潮。

lemmas.usage_note: 字面指纵欲狂欢聚会，更常以 an orgy of sth 结构比喻无节制、肆意放纵的某种行为或消费。

lemmas.def_zh: 狂欢的
lemmas.def_en: used of frenzied sexual activity

examples.en: The festival ended in an orgiastic burst of loud music, dancing, and wild celebration.
examples.zh: 音乐节在嘈杂的音乐、舞蹈和狂热的庆祝中陷入了狂欢的狂潮。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 orgy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 隐含，暗示，意味着
lemmas.def_en: [T] (of a word or idea) To suggest a feeling or meaning in addition to its literal meaning.

examples.en: In modern culture, the color white often connotes purity, peace, and innocence.
examples.zh: 在现代文化中，白色往往内涵着纯洁、和平与无辜的象征意义。

lemmas.usage_note: 语义学及学术词汇，指词语、符号暗示或内涵某种附加意义，与指称字面义的 denote 相对。

lemmas.def_zh: 含蓄, 内涵
lemmas.def_en: what you must know in order to determine the reference of an expression

family_guide.root_logic: 以 connote 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 规避，巧妙避开（规则、限制等）；绕行
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (formal) To find a clever or indirect way around a rule, obstacle, or restriction. 2. [T] To bypass or go around.

examples.en: They devised a clever strategy to circumvent the strict regulations imposed by the authorities.
examples.zh: 他们制定了一个巧妙的策略来规避当局施加的严格监管。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常与 rule, sanction, restriction 等搭配，指巧妙规避法律或限制，偏正式语体。

lemmas.def_zh: 陷害, 包围
lemmas.def_en: the act of evading by going around

family_guide.root_logic: 以 circumvent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 枝形吊灯
lemmas.def_en: branched lighting fixture; often ornate; hangs from the ceiling

examples.en: A magnificent crystal chandelier hung from the high ceiling of the ballroom.
examples.zh: 宴会厅高高的天花板上悬挂着一盏华丽的水晶枝形吊灯。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指枝形吊灯，常见搭配 crystal chandelier，多用于描述华丽装潢或盛大宴会场景。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chandelier 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 河口, 港湾
lemmas.def_en: the wide part of a river where it nears the sea; fresh and salt water mix

examples.en: The river estuary provides a vital breeding ground for countless species of marine life.
examples.zh: 这条河流的入海口为无数种海洋生物提供了至关重要的繁衍地。

lemmas.usage_note: 地理名词，指入海口或河口湾，常与 river 或具体地名连用，常见于自然地理与生态保护语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 estuary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （使）放气，（使）瘪掉；打消（气焰），挫伤（信心）；紧缩（通货）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To let air or gas out of something, or to become smaller by losing air or gas. 2. [T] To make someone feel less confident or proud. 3. [T] To reduce the level of economic activity or money supply.

examples.en: His sharp criticism completely deflated her confidence during the presentation.
examples.zh: 在报告展示过程中，他尖锐的批评彻底挫败了她的自信心。

lemmas.usage_note: 可作及物或不及物动词，指漏气、紧缩经济或挫伤信心，常见搭配 deflate one's ego/confidence。

lemmas.def_zh: 放气, 缩小, 通货紧缩
lemmas.def_en: (geology) the erosion of soil as a consequence of sand and dust and loose rocks being removed by the wind

examples.en: a constant deflation of the desert landscape

lemmas.def_zh: [经] 平减指数
lemmas.def_en: a statistical factor designed to remove the effect of inflation; inflation adjusted variables are in constant dollars

lemmas.def_zh: 通货紧缩的
lemmas.def_en: associated with or tending to cause decreases in consumer prices or increases in the purchasing power of money

examples.en: Persistent deflationary pressures forced the central bank to cut interest rates.
examples.zh: 持续的通缩压力迫使央行降低了利率。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 deflate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 边, 边缘, (河)边
lemmas.def_en: the top edge of a vessel or other container

examples.en: She filled the glass to the brim with fresh orange juice.
examples.zh: 她把玻璃杯倒满了新鲜的橙汁，几乎溢出边缘。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指杯碗边缘或帽檐，常用短语 to the brim（满到边缘），强调容器已充盈至极限。

lemmas.def_zh: 充溢，充满，溢出
lemmas.def_en: [I] To be full to the brim with liquid, or to be full of a particular emotion or quality.

examples.en: Her eyes brimmed with tears when she heard the touching story.
examples.zh: 听到那个感人的故事时，她的眼中噙满了泪水。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作不及物动词，常用短语 brim with，常接 tears, joy, confidence 等，形容情感或液体洋溢充盈。

lemmas.def_zh: 满到边的, 洋溢着...的, 满溢的
lemmas.def_en: filled to capacity

examples.en: a brimful cup
I am brimful of chowder

family_guide.root_logic: 以 brim 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （用绳或链）拴住，系住；束缚，限制
lemmas.def_en: [T] To tie an animal or object with a rope or chain to a fixed point so it cannot move far.

examples.en: He tethered his horse to a nearby wooden post before entering the inn.
examples.zh: 进入客栈前，他把马拴在附近的一根木桩上。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指用绳栓住牲畜或比喻束缚限制，也常用于数码领域指网络共享，常用搭配 tether to。

lemmas.def_en: not confined or restricted with a tether

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tether 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 混合画, 画面剪辑, 蒙太奇
lemmas.def_en: a paste-up made by sticking together pieces of paper or photographs to form an artistic image

examples.en: The film ends with an emotional photo montage illustrating the character's early life.
examples.zh: 电影以一段感人至深的照片蒙太奇剪辑结尾，展现了主角早年的生活。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，既可指影视蒙太奇剪辑手法，也可指照片或声音的拼接作品，常搭配 photo/film montage。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 montage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 仪表板, 挡泥板
lemmas.def_en: protective covering consisting of a panel to protect people from the splashing water or mud etc.

examples.en: A red warning light suddenly illuminated on the car's dashboard.
examples.zh: 汽车仪表板上的一个红色警示灯突然亮了起来。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，原指汽车仪表板，在数字软件中广泛借指数据控制看板，如 analytics dashboard。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dashboard 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 季风, 吹季风的季节, 雨季
lemmas.def_en: a seasonal wind in southern Asia; blows from the southwest (bringing rain) in summer and from the northeast in winter

examples.en: The annual monsoon brings heavy downpours that replenish the region's parched fields.
examples.zh: 一年一度的季风带来了大暴雨，滋润了该地区干涸的农田。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，专指季风或南亚等地的雨季，常与 rains, season 搭配，如 monsoon rains/season。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 monsoon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 出血
lemmas.def_en: the flow of blood from a ruptured blood vessel

examples.en: The surgeon worked swiftly to control the severe internal hemorrhage.
examples.zh: 外科医生迅速采取行动，以控制住严重的内出血。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学名词，指严重大量出血，常见搭配 cerebral/internal hemorrhage；亦可引申为大量流失。

lemmas.def_zh: 出血
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to a hemorrhage

lemmas.def_zh: 大出血，严重失血；（资金、人员等）巨额流失
lemmas.def_en: [I] 1. to bleed heavily and dangerously from a ruptured blood vessel. 2. to lose a large amount of money, personnel, or resources rapidly.

examples.en: The struggling company continues to hemorrhage cash after the failed acquisition.
examples.zh: 收购失败后，这家陷入困境的公司仍在持续大幅亏损现金。

lemmas.usage_note: 动词，除医学大出血外，高频用于商业语境比喻巨额亏损或人员急速流失，接 money, jobs 等。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hemorrhage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 摘要, 提纲, 课程表, 教学大纲
lemmas.def_en: an integrated course of academic studies

examples.en: The professor handed out the course syllabus detailing the weekly reading assignments and exam dates.
examples.zh: 教授分发了课程大纲，上面详细列出了每周的阅读任务和考试日期。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于教育语境，指学期或课程的教学大纲，复数形式为 syllabuses 或 syllabi，常见搭配有 on the syllabus。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 syllabus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 热区；热点
lemmas.def_en: a place of political unrest and potential violence

examples.en: This coastal city has become a major hotspot for young entrepreneurs and digital nomads.
examples.zh: 这座沿海城市已成为年轻创业者和数字游民的一大聚集热点。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指局势紧张的危险地区、热门旅游胜地，或提供无线网络连接的区域，常用搭配有 tourist hotspot、Wi-Fi hotspot。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hotspot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 挂毯, 绒绣
lemmas.def_en: something that resembles a tapestry in its complex pictorial designs

examples.en: The documentary celebrates the vibrant cultural tapestry woven by generations of diverse immigrants.
examples.zh: 这部纪录片赞颂了由数代不同族裔移民共同交织出的丰富文化画卷。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指厚重织锦挂毯，也常用于比喻复杂交织的文化、历史或生活画卷，常见搭配有 rich tapestry of...

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tapestry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 长臂猿
lemmas.def_en: English historian best known for his history of the Roman Empire (1737-1794)

examples.en: We could hear the distinctive morning calls of the gibbon echoing through the dense canopy.
examples.zh: 我们能听到长臂猿清晨独特的啼鸣声在茂密的树冠层中回荡。

lemmas.usage_note: 生物学与自然科普常用词，指栖息于热带雨林的小型长臂猿，常作可数名词使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gibbon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 用耙耕整（土地）；折磨，使极度痛苦
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To pull a harrow over ploughed land to break up clods of soil and level the surface. 2. [T] To cause deep distress or mental anguish to someone.

examples.en: The farmer hitched the equipment to his tractor to harrow the field before planting the seeds.
examples.zh: 农民把农具挂在拖拉机后面，以便在播种前耙松田地。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可指农业中用耙碎土（及物/不及物），也可比喻使心灵备受折磨，分词形容词 harrowing（令人揪心的）极为常见。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 harrow 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 共存，同时存在；和平共处
lemmas.def_en: [I] To exist together at the same time or in the same place, especially peacefully despite differences.

examples.en: Different religious and ethnic communities have managed to coexist harmoniously in this region for centuries.
examples.zh: 几个世纪以来，不同的宗教与族群一直在这个地区和谐共处。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，常指不同事物、群体或观点同时存在或和平共处，高频搭配为 coexist with 或 coexist peacefully。

lemmas.def_zh: 共存, 和平共处, 并立
lemmas.def_en: existing peacefully together

lemmas.def_zh: 同时共存的, 和平共处的
lemmas.def_en: existing at the same time

family_guide.root_logic: 以 coexist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 熟食店；熟食品（等于delicatessen）
lemmas.def_en: a shop selling ready-to-eat food products

examples.en: He grabbed a pastrami sandwich from the corner deli before heading back to the office.
examples.zh: 他回办公室前回拐角的熟食店顺手买了一个五香熏牛肉三明治。

lemmas.usage_note: 口语常用，delicatessen的缩写，指熟食店或店内冷切熟食，常见搭配为 local deli、deli counter。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 deli 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 祭典日, 喜庆日, 假日
lemmas.def_en: an elaborate party (often outdoors)

examples.en: The whole town burst into vibrant color and music during the annual summer fiesta.
examples.zh: 在一年一度的夏季狂欢节期间，整个小镇沉浸在绚丽的色彩与欢快的音乐中。

lemmas.usage_note: 源自西班牙语，多用于指宗教节日、民间狂欢节或盛大派对，常与 hold、celebrate 等动词搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fiesta 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 笨蛋；阴门；[贬]娘们儿
lemmas.def_en: a man who is a stupid incompetent fool

examples.en: He made a complete twat of himself by picking a fight with the bouncer.
examples.zh: 他竟然去挑衅保安，简直把自己弄得像个彻头彻尾的蠢货。

lemmas.usage_note: 极度粗俗且具冒犯性的下流俚语（英式尤其常见），严禁在正式场合使用，常用来辱骂极度愚蠢或令人讨厌的人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 twat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 封港令, 禁运
lemmas.def_en: a government order imposing a trade barrier

examples.en: The United Nations voted to impose an arms embargo on the warring factions.
examples.zh: 联合国投票决定对交战各派实施武器禁运。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式政经用语，指政府下达的贸易禁运或封港令，常见搭配有 impose an embargo on、lift an embargo。

lemmas.def_zh: 对……实行禁运；禁止出版（或播发）
lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. to impose an official ban on trade or commercial activity with a particular country. 2. to officially ban the publication or broadcast of information before a specified date.

examples.en: The government decided to embargo all trade with the hostile nation following the border clash.
examples.zh: 边境冲突发生后，政府决定禁止与该敌对国家的一切贸易往来。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指正式下令禁止商品进出口、限制船舶出港或暂缓发表信息，后直接接被限制的对象。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 embargo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 救济品, 失业救济金
lemmas.def_en: a share of money or food or clothing that has been charitably given

examples.en: After the factory closed, hundreds of local workers were forced to go on the dole.
examples.zh: 工厂倒闭后，数百名当地工人被迫领取失业救济金。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作单数与 the 连用，多用于英式非正式语体，常见搭配 on the dole（领救济金）。

lemmas.def_zh: 悲哀的, 忧郁的, 阴沉的
lemmas.def_en: filled with or evoking sadness

examples.en: the child's doleful expression
stared with mournful eyes

lemmas.def_zh: 悲哀地, 阴郁地
lemmas.def_en: with sadness; in a sorrowful manner

examples.en: his mother looked at him dolefully when he told her he had joined the Army

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dole 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 公驴, 愚蠢的人, 傻瓜
lemmas.def_en: a man who is a stupid incompetent fool

examples.en: Stop acting like a jackass and listen to what the teacher is saying.
examples.zh: 别再像个傻瓜一样胡闹了，听老师讲课。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指人时含强烈贬义，属非正式口语，常与 make a jackass of oneself 搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jackass 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 导管
lemmas.def_en: a thin flexible tube inserted into the body to permit introduction or withdrawal of fluids or to keep the passageway open

examples.en: The nurse carefully inserted a urinary catheter into the patient before the surgery.
examples.zh: 手术前，护士小心翼翼地为病人插上了导尿管。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学专业名词，指插入体内的医用导管，常与 insert、remove 等动词搭配使用。

lemmas.def_zh: 导管插入(术)
lemmas.def_en: the operation of introducing a catheter into the body

lemmas.def_zh: 将导管插入
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (medicine) To insert a thin flexible tube (catheter) into a body cavity or blood vessel to drain or inject fluid.

examples.en: catheterize the patient's bladder

family_guide.root_logic: 以 catheter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 风味极佳的, 可口的, 味香的
lemmas.def_en: morally wholesome or acceptable

examples.en: The chef prepared a selection of savory pastries filled with spiced minced lamb.
examples.zh: 主厨准备了几款包有香辣羊肉末的咸味酥皮点心。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于烹饪语境，常指咸味或辛辣开胃的食物（相对于甜食），也可形容香气诱人。

lemmas.def_zh: 没有味道的, 没有香味的, 难吃的, 难闻的, 令人不快的, 不可接受的
lemmas.def_en: morally offensive

examples.en: an unsavory reputation
an unsavory scandal

family_guide.root_logic: 以 savory 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 蹄, (人的)脚
lemmas.def_en: the foot of an ungulate mammal

examples.en: The blacksmith carefully inspected the horse's left hoof before fitting the new shoe.
examples.zh: 铁匠在装新蹄铁之前，仔细检查了马的左蹄。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，复数常为 hooves 或 hoofs，指马、牛等动物的蹄子，常用于解剖与畜牧语境。

lemmas.def_zh: 职业舞蹈家(尤指跳踢踏舞)
lemmas.def_en: a professional dancer

lemmas.def_zh: 疾跑，急步走（常作 hoof it）；踢
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] ('hoof it') (informal) To run or walk briskly somewhere. 2. [T] To kick a ball hard.

examples.en: Since we missed the last bus, we had to hoof it all the way home in the rain.
examples.zh: 因为错过了末班车，我们不得不冒雨一路走回家。

lemmas.usage_note: 口语动词，常与 it 连用构成 hoof it，意为“步行、走着去”；也可指用力踢球。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hoof 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 编年史, 活动年报, 历史
lemmas.def_en: reports of the work of a society or learned body etc

examples.en: His heroic deeds will be remembered forever in the annals of medical history.
examples.zh: 他的英勇事迹将被永远铭刻在医学史册之中。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常以复数形式出现，属于正式书面语，常见搭配 in the annals of（在……的史册上）。

lemmas.def_zh: 编年史作者
lemmas.def_en: a historian who writes annals

family_guide.root_logic: 以 annals 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 切碎，剁碎（肉或蔬菜）；装腔作势地迈碎步走；委婉含蓄地说
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To cut meat or other food into very small pieces. 2. [I] To walk with short, quick, affected steps. 3. [T] ('not mince words') To express thoughts directly without softening them.

examples.en: The recipe requires you to mince two cloves of garlic before frying the vegetables.
examples.zh: 这道菜谱要求你在炒菜前先把两瓣大蒜剁碎。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指把肉或蔬菜切碎，也常用于习语 not mince (one's) words（直言不讳）。

lemmas.def_zh: 碎肉器
lemmas.def_en: a kitchen utensil that cuts or chops food (especially meat) into small pieces

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mince 为核心的派生词族。
